description:
Do you enjoy working on Supply Chain projects?

Would you like the opportunity to work for oilfield services company?

Join our team

Our Oilfield Services business provides intelligent, connected technologies to monitor and control our energy extraction assets. Our team arranging technical expertise to meet our client expectation. We provide customers with the peace of mind needed to reliably and efficiently improve their operations.

Partner with the best

As the Supply Chain Localization Leader you will be responsible for leading and executing an integrated Supply Chain Localization strategy under UAE Unified ICV Program v4.0, targeting Goods Manufactured and Third-Party Spend to shift sourcing from import-heavy to locally optimized. You will drive measurable ICV uplift, ensuring compliance with MOIAT and ADNOC frameworks, and spearheading facility optimization projects across UAE to enhance operational efficiency and local value creation.

As a Supply Chain Localization Leader, you will be responsible for:
Developing and executing Supply Chain Localization Strategy for Baker Hughes business in the UAE. Targeting shift to UAE Based ICV-Certified Suppliers. Specific categories focus is needed on are Goods Manufactured as well as Third Party Spend.
Performing analysis of current supply chain Practices, conducting existing spend diagnostics, mapping high spend categories to UAE-Made alternatives.
Revamping Supply Chain for Local Sourcing, Partner with Local suppliers for active participation in Local Supplier Development programs.
Engaging with Suppliers to support their ICV Certifications and Scores, Conducting supplier training workshops in Conjunction with the ICV Leader.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams (Business Segments, GeoZones, Supply Chain) to drive UAE-based supply chain localization in alignment with the established localization strategy
Ensuring compliance with MoIAT and ADNOC ICV frameworks; Supporting with Internal / External ICV Audits specific to Third Party Spend and Goods Manufactured categories.
Identifying and leading facility cost optimization projects throughout the UAE Baker Hughes business.
To be successful in this role you will have:
Bachelors in supply chain, Engineering, Procurement or Business.
Minimum 5 Years with Supply Chain function, preferably within the Oil and Gas industry.
Thorough understanding of the MoIAT and ADNOC In Country Value frameworks (is preferred).
Proven Supply Chain Localization and/or Supplier Development experience.
Strong Analytical and Data Driven Decision making, ability to work within a matrix organization while leading with influence, executive communication Skills.

description:

•    Bachelor’s degree in engineering
•    Excellent leadership, strong interpersonal, influencing and planning skills
•    Ability to be on call outside of normal business hours
•    Ability to work in a global matrix organization
•    Excellent communication and presentation skills
•    Strong organizational, analytical and problem solving skills
•    Must have the ability to travel (potential for travel to rig sites, customer facilities, meetings, training, etc.)
DESIRED CHARACTERISTICS:
•    Significant operational experience
•    Comfortable presenting in front of an audience of experienced peers
•    Ability to manage, develop, coach, and mentor teams across organizational boundaries
•    Ability to learn and use various computer tools to prepare data and visualizations for analysis
•    Ability to work independently

Reports To: Service Delivery Technical Manager

description:
Driving Operational Excellence Through Engineering, Job Planning, and Technical Service Delivery

Partner with the Best

Baker Hughes delivers advanced energy technology solutions across more than 120 countries. The Service Delivery organization ensures flawless execution for our customers by leveraging engineering expertise, risk management, and optimized job planning. As part of this team, the Applications Engineer plays a critical role in ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient service delivery aligned with Baker Hughes’ standards and customer expectations.

Fuel Your Passion

The Applications Engineer – Service Delivery Applications supports the full job lifecycle by providing technical evaluations, job design, risk assessments, incident reviews, and operational support. This role ensures that engineering practices, process discipline, and technical governance are consistently applied across all projects. The engineer collaborates closely with Sales, Service Delivery Coordinators, and field teams to ensure customer objectives are met while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

As an Applications Engineer, you will be responsible for:

Ensuring compliance with the Manage the Job Cycle (MtJC) process.
Working with the assigned Service Delivery Coordinator/Salesperson to understand the client’s well construction or production objectives, along with associated commercial terms (e.g., outcome-based or line-item contracts).
Performing offset job analysis and conducting engineering modeling calculations to identify potential hazards and incidents.
Collaborating with all disciplines and stakeholders to ensure full consideration of application constraints and product/service requirements.
Designing job programs, including risk mitigation and contingency plans, to meet client objectives and maximize business potential.
Communicating any risks to client objectives through appropriate channels in alignment with defined processes.
Accurately documenting all calculations, simulations, revisions, and changes during the project lifecycle for visibility and audit readiness.
Providing on-demand support according to product portfolio or on-call rotation for job execution.
Comparing planned vs. executed job data, capturing lessons learned, and recommending improvements for continuous enhancement.
Working on field incidents involving products/services.
Participating in Incident Investigations, ensuring end-to-end evaluation (planning, preparation, execution) to determine root causes and corrective actions.
Enabling timely incident management to support customer issue resolution and cash collection.
Advising on product improvement opportunities for recurring component or equipment failures.
Providing sales support through technical recommendations and product application expertise.
Supporting product‑line‑specific responsibilities as applicable.
Handling special projects as assigned.


To be successful in this role, you will:

Hold a bachelor’s degree in science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM).
Demonstrate excellent leadership, interpersonal, influencing, and planning skills.
Be available for on‑call support outside normal working hours.
Be capable of working effectively in a global matrix organization.
Have strong communication and presentation abilities.
Possess strong organizational, analytical, and problem‑solving skills.
Be willing and able to travel, including to rig sites, customer facilities, meetings, and training.

Significant operational experience.
Confidence in presenting to experienced peer groups.
Ability to manage, coach, and mentor teams across organizational boundaries.

title: Mechanik jeřábové techniky (m/ž)
description:
Mechanik jeřábové techniky (m/ž)

Chcete se podílet na výrobě generátorů?

Chcete pracovat v Plzni?

Spolupracujte s těmi nejlepšími

Baker Hughes je přední globální energeticko‑technologická společnost, která poskytuje inovativní řešení zvyšující bezpečnost, čistotu a efektivitu energie napříč celým hodnotovým řetězcem. Společnost působí ve více než 120 zemích a kombinuje hluboké znalosti odvětví s pokročilým inženýrstvím a digitálními technologiemi na podporu výroby energie, její transformace a dekarbonizace. S více než stoletou tradicí spolupracuje Baker Hughes se zákazníky v ropném a plynárenském průmyslu, v průmyslových odvětvích i na rozvíjejících se energetických trzích, aby urychlila pokrok směrem k udržitelnější energetické budoucnosti.

Rozviňte svou vášeň

Jako mechanik jeřábové techniky budete zajišťovat provozuschopnost zdvihacích zařízení, provádět jejich opravy a poskytovat technickou podporu. Budete zpracovávat analýzy technického stavu strojů, navrhovat preventivní údržbu a podílet se na zvyšování efektivity správy majetku. Součástí práce je také technická spolupráce při objednávkách, účast ve výběrových řízeních a výkon funkce provozního technika zdvihacích zařízení s odpovědností za jejich bezpečný provoz.

Jako mechanik jeřábové techniky budete:

Provádět činnosti spojené se zajištěním chodu strojů a zařízení, a to včetně dodržování legislativních požadavků. Pozice je zaměřena především na zdvihací zařízení, jako jsou jeřáby, plošiny či vysokozdvižné vozíky.

Aktivně se podílet na realizaci oprav strojů a zařízení, řídit průběh oprav a poskytovat odbornou technickou podporu.

Zpracovávat přehledy a analýzy technického stavu strojů a zařízení a navrhovat postupy preventivní údržby i oprav.

Aktivně se účastnit procesů zlepšování a přispívat ke zvyšování efektivity a produktivity v oblasti správy a údržby majetku.

Technicky spolupracovat na objednávkovém procesu a podílet se na výběrových řízeních týkajících se údržby a oprav zařízení.

Abyste byli v této roli úspěšní, budete potřebovat:

SŠ technického směru (strojní nebo elektro).

Zkušenosti s prováděním údržby a oprav strojů

Zkušenosti s jednáním s dodavateli (výhodou)

Zkušenosti s obsluhou zdvihacích zařízení (výhodou)

Pracujte způsobem, který vám vyhovuje

Uznáváme, že každý je jiný a že každý chce pracovat a podávat nejlepší výkon jiným způsobem. V této roli můžeme nabídnout následující flexibilní pracovní uspořádání:

Možnosti flexibilní práce proberte prosím s náborářem.

Spolupráce s námi

Naši lidé jsou srdcem všeho, co v Baker Hughes děláme. Víme, že jsme lepší, když se všichni naši zaměstnanci rozvíjejí, jsou angažovaní a mohou být sami sebou. Investujeme do jejich zdraví a pohody, školíme je, odměňujeme talent a rozvíjíme lídry na všech úrovních, abychom ze sebe navzájem dostali to nejlepší.

Co nabízíme vám

Naše vynálezy mění energetiku už více než století. Abychom mohli pokračovat i zítra, musíme posouvat hranice už dnes. Odměňujeme ty, kteří přijímají změny, balíčkem benefitů, který odráží, jak moc si jejich přínosu vážíme.

Můžete očekávat:

Pracovní doba 7,5 hodiny denně

Příspěvek na doplňkové penzijní pojištění 15 600 Kč ročně

Zajímavé platové ohodnocení a čtvrtletní bonusy (dle splnění firemních a osobních cílů)

Pravidelné každoroční navyšování mzdy

Firemní vzdělávání (povinná školení i rozvoj hrazený zaměstnavatelem)

Vlastní jídelna, výběr z několika jídel

Stravenkový paušál 115 Kč za odpracovanou směnu

5 týdnů dovolené

Flexi passy (volnočasové poukázky)

Výborná dostupnost MHD

Stabilní zaměstnání ve firmě s dlouhou tradicí

El Well Engineer Drilling - Integrated Solutions ejecuta todas las actividades de ingeniería de pozos dentro de un proyecto o Centro de Excelencia, siguiendo los lineamientos del Integrated Solutions Management System, las regulaciones locales e internacionales y los requisitos del cliente. Este rol proporciona soporte técnico desde la etapa conceptual y de licitación, hasta el inicio, ejecución y cierre del proyecto.

Durante la fase de licitación, además de las actividades de ingeniería, el ingeniero apoya a los equipos comerciales y de adquisiciones. En las etapas de planificación y ejecución, interactúa con múltiples partes interesadas para garantizar seguridad, integridad del pozo y eficiencia operativa. El ingeniero asegura que el diseño del pozo, el programa operativo y los procedimientos detallados estén correctamente preparados y entregados al equipo de ejecución. Es un contribuyente clave durante la ejecución del proyecto, proporcionando seguimiento, soporte técnico y acompañamiento operativo.

Como Well Engineer Drilling - Integrated Solutions, serás responsable de:

• Desarrollar y preparar el diseño básico del pozo, los requisitos técnicos y los planes operativos para cumplir los objetivos técnicos y financieros de Baker Hughes y del cliente.
• Asegurar que todas las actividades de ingeniería cumplan con las políticas y procedimientos de HSE, promoviendo la cultura de seguridad mediante prácticas de trabajo seguras.
• Participar en el proceso de preparación de ofertas (tenders) aportando la ingeniería de pozos requerida.
• Participar en presentaciones y reuniones con clientes (incluye posibles viajes a otras ubicaciones).
• Preparar el diseño del pozo, el plan del pozo y los procedimientos operativos para construcción, completación, intervención y/o abandono.
• Definir los servicios técnicos y los requerimientos de terceros necesarios para la ejecución del proyecto.
• Preparar estimaciones de tiempo y costo operativo.
• Elaborar, junto con equipos internos y externos, el registro de riesgos y los planes de contingencia.
• Preparar y participar en revisiones técnicas, peer reviews, peer assists y actividades de aseguramiento de calidad.
• Monitorear el progreso diario de los trabajos y el gasto operativo.
• Evaluar la aplicación de mejores prácticas y nuevas tecnologías en las operaciones de Integrated Solutions.
• Comunicarse eficazmente con los equipos de sitio y stakeholders del proyecto, recomendando acciones para asegurar una ejecución impecable.
• Monitorear KPIs técnicos y operativos, comparándolos con pozos de referencia y objetivos definidos.
• Participar en investigaciones de análisis de causa raíz (RCA).
• Preparar reportes técnicos del proyecto, incluyendo End of Well Report, After Action Reviews y lecciones aprendidas.
• Cumplir con los lineamientos de gestión de datos establecidos por Integrated Solutions.
• Mantenerse actualizado sobre avances tecnológicos y de ingeniería mediante participación en sociedades profesionales, redes, talleres, seminarios y cursos.

Para tener éxito en este rol deberás:

• Contar con título universitario en Ingeniería de Petróleos, Ingeniería Mecánica o Ingeniería Química; idealmente con maestría en Petróleo/Gas o Ingeniería de Pozos.
• Tener más de 5 años de experiencia relevante en construcción de pozos, completaciones, intervención y/o optimización, incluyendo áreas como brocas, diseño de BHA, simulaciones de ingeniería, operaciones en campo o preparación de programas/diseños.
• Poseer habilidades interpersonales para trabajar con equipos multiculturales y multidisciplinarios, influir efectivamente y generar credibilidad con líderes senior.
• Demostrar excelentes habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas, incluso con información incompleta.
• Contar con excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita en inglés, capaces de sintetizar temas complejos en mensajes claros.
• Manejar MS Office, Power BI u otras herramientas analíticas, así como software de ingeniería de pozos (hidráulica, torque y arrastre, diseño básico de casing).
• Tener conocimientos o exposición a perforación rotatoria convencional, pozos horizontales o multilaterales, perforación en pads y no convencionales.
• Contar con conocimiento en control de pozos y fundamentos de geomecánica.

Trabaja de la manera que mejor funcione para ti

Reconocemos que cada persona trabaja de manera diferente y que todos buscamos condiciones que nos permitan rendir al máximo. En este rol, se pueden ofrecer patrones de trabajo flexibles según las necesidades operativas.

Uno de nuestros valores fundamentales es la colaboración y, aunque existen opciones de trabajo flexible, creemos que existe un gran beneficio en que nuestros equipos estén co‑localizados en una de nuestras oficinas.

Trabajar con nosotros

Nuestra gente está en el corazón de lo que hacemos en Baker Hughes. Sabemos que somos mejores cuando todos están desarrollados, comprometidos y pueden aportar su auténtico yo al trabajo. Invertimos en el bienestar de nuestra fuerza laboral, capacitamos y recompensamos el talento, y desarrollamos líderes en todos los niveles para sacar lo mejor de cada uno.

Trabajar para ti

Nuestras innovaciones han transformado la energía durante más de un siglo. Para seguir avanzando, sabemos que debemos impulsar el cambio hoy. Priorizamos recompensar a quienes lo impulsan, con un paquete que refleja cuánto valoramos su contribución. Al unirte, puedes esperar:

title: Customer Order Engineering - Mechanical
description:
Customer Order Engineering - Mechanical

Are you an experienced Customer Order Engineer looking for a new Role?

Do you enjoy being part of a successful team?

Baker Hughes is currently hiring a Customer Order Engineering - Mechanical to join the team. We are looking for an experienced industry expert with a background and experience in customer specifications in detail, understanding critical project requirements, and deriving all requirements for the design of various Mechanical Auxiliaries. Baker Hughes Cordant Process Optimization solution is based on a novel approach that combines process domain knowledge along with advanced machine learning techniques. In this role, you are expected to provide process and optimization domain expertise for extending existing product offerings in varied industrial processes.


Join our innovative Engineering Team!
You will be integrated in the multidisciplinary engineering team located in Bangalore & Hyderabad, working exclusively for Thermodyn business. Thermodyn is a French subsidiary of the worldwide company Baker Hughes, designing, producing, testing and installing centrifugal compressors and medium power steam turbines for the industrial and energy sector customers.

Innovation is part of our DNA. We provide steam turbines for propulsion of nuclear submarines of the French NAVY. We are worldwide leader of integrated compression with zero-emission, using state of the art technologies like high-speed induction motors and magnetic bearings.
The company exists since more than 100 years. We have a fleet of more than 1000 compressors and steam turbines, installed worldwide on which we partly provide maintenance, operational technical support and system upgrades.
Our goal is clear: we are taking energy forward.


Role Summary:
Baker Hughes has a new opportunity for Lead Auxiliary Mechanical Piping Engineer to join the team in Bengaluru, India.


Roles and Responsibilities
• Going through customer specifications in detail, understanding critical project requirements, and deriving all requirements for the design of various Mechanical Auxiliaries according to BH best practices
• Being responsible for the skid package design of Compressor & Steam turbine packages, including package piping & support design, locking assembly, et,c with due consideration to ergonomics, accessibility, and maintenance.
• Reviewing engineering drawings & 3D models. Also, Performing Structural analysis of baseplates using FEA tools [BDOT - BH Tool].
• Assigning & reviewing static and dynamic analysis when the same is performed with Ansys software by external suppliers, and creating drawings for the baseplate.
• Being responsible for the design of various external BOP skids that include Rundown oil tanks, and Seal gas treatment skids in collaboration with external OEM vendors
• Creating Piping line specifications using PUMA (BH Tool).
• Lead multiple complex projects and present to leadership on project status, risks and mitigations.
• Collaborating with external engineering suppliers in the creation of basic engineering drawings of various Mechanical Auxiliaries items, foundation drawings, and managing 3D models.
• Extending support to the Manufacturing Cell during machine assembly on the Shop floor and providing quick resolution to Non-conformity if generated.
• Extending support to FSE/ FPE during the installation & commissioning of the machine at the site
• Delivers products as part of a team. Works with cross functional teams.
 

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:
• Have a BE/BTech in Mechanical/Industrial Engineering
• Have 6+ years of experience in the Packaging of rotating equipment, auxiliary equipment design, piping & support design/ analysis, and structural analysis.
• Have knowledge of piping design for ASME B31.1 & 31.3, Lube oil System sizing to API 614 code requirement.
• Be Proficient in NX modules; modelling, drafting, routing & assembly.
• Have hands-on 3D modelling/detailing tools like UG NX, Autocad, and Analysis software like Ansys, Caesar, etc
• Be able to read & understand engineering documents (like Piping & Instrument diagram P & ID, technical data sheets, and O&M manuals) and site service requests.
• Knowledge in Materials Engineering and Turbomachinery.


Desired Characteristics
• Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Ability to influence others and lead small teams. Lead initiatives of moderate scope and impact. Ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously. Effective problem identification and solution skills. Proven analytical and organizational ability.
• Experience in O&G industry preferred, not mandatory.

title: Engenheiro de Manutenção Mecânica
description:
Você é Engenheiro de Manutenção Mecânica e está em busca de uma nova oportunidade?

Você tem paixão por fornecer todos os tipos de soluções em engenharia mecânica?

Be part of a successful team!

Na Baker Hughes nosso propósito é claro. Levamos a energia adiante – tornando-a mais segura, mais limpa e mais eficiente para as pessoas e para o planeta. Nossa equipe de Flexible Pipe Systems oferece soluções de produção confiáveis ​​e robustas para a vida útil do campo. Desenvolvemos e fornecemos risers de tubos flexíveis, jumpers, flowlines e linhas de transferência de fluidos que ultrapassam os limites operacionais de suas contrapartes de aço carbono.

Faça parceria com os melhores

O Engenheiro de Manutenção Mecânica será responsável pela estratégia para garantir a máxima disponibilidade, confiabilidade e segurança de ativos (máquinas e equipamentos), minimizando paradas não planejadas e reduzindo custos. Ele planeja, desenvolve e supervisiona estratégias de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, analisando falhas, liderando implementação de projetos e otimizando processos. Atuará com equipes multidisciplinares para garantir o sucesso das operações.

Como Engenheiro de Manutenção Mecânica, você será responsável por:

Planejar, coordenar e acompanhar atividades de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em equipamentos e sistemas mecânicos.
Analisar falhas recorrentes em equipamentos, conduzindo análises de causa raiz (RCA) e propondo ações corretivas e melhorias permanentes.
Desenvolver, revisar e otimizar planos de manutenção, rotinas, procedimentos técnicos e instruções de trabalho.
Garantir a disponibilidade, confiabilidade e performance dos ativos mecânicos, alinhados aos indicadores de manutenção (MTBF, MTTR, backlog etc.).
Atuar na engenharia de manutenção, propondo melhorias de projeto, modificações de equipamentos e padronizações técnicas.
Apoiar o planejamento e controle da manutenção (PCM) na elaboração de cronogramas, recursos, materiais e paradas programadas.
Gerenciar contratos e acompanhar atividades de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço, assegurando qualidade, prazo e segurança.
Elaborar e analisar relatórios técnicos, indicadores de desempenho e apresentações gerenciais.
Assegurar o cumprimento de normas técnicas, requisitos legais, padrões de segurança e meio ambiente aplicáveis às atividades de manutenção.
Participar de comissionamento, start-up e aceitação técnica de novos equipamentos e projetos.
Coordenar e liderar projetos mecânicos, desde a fase de concepção até a execução e entrega final, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos, orçamento e qualidade.
Contribuir para a gestão de sobressalentes, especificação técnica de materiais e suporte ao processo de compras.
Atuar no controle de custos de manutenção, buscando otimização de recursos e redução de custos operacionais.
Treinar e orientar equipes de manutenção quanto a boas práticas, procedimentos e uso adequado dos equipamentos.
Definir e revisar estratégias de manutenção (RCM, FMEA, manutenção baseada em condição, run-to-failure).
Avaliar criticidade de ativos, classificando equipamentos conforme impacto em segurança, produção, meio ambiente e custo.
Desenvolver e acompanhar KPIs de manutenção, promovendo planos de ação para melhoria de desempenho.
Liderar ou participar de investigações de falhas críticas e eventos de alto impacto operacional.
Elaborar especificações técnicas para aquisição, reforma ou substituição de equipamentos mecânicos.
Contribuir para programas de excelência operacional e melhoria contínua (Lean, TPM, Six Sigma).
Apoiar auditorias internas e externas relacionadas à manutenção, confiabilidade e integridade de ativos.
Realizar acompanhamento de projetos CAPEX.
Avaliar riscos técnicos associados a mudanças operacionais, apoiando processos de MOC (Management of Change).
Desenvolver estudos técnicos para aumento de disponibilidade, redução de falhas e melhoria da segurança operacional.

Alimente sua paixão

Para ser bem-sucedido nesta função você precisa:

Formação superior completa em Engenharia Mecânica.
Conhecimento avançado em projetos mecânicos.
Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos.
Experiência na gestão de projetos e cronogramas,
Experiência como facilitador na condução de análises de falhas e na aplicação de técnicas como 5 Por quês, Apollo, Ishikawa, árvore de falhas, metodologia A3 etc.
Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas
Conhecimento e habilidade em softwares como: Excel, AutoCAD, Ansys, SolidWorks, IBM Maximo e Power BI.
Inglês avançado.

Além disso, é extremamente importante possuir essas competências comportamentais:

Proatividade e autonomia para resolver problemas e liderar iniciativas.
Atenção aos detalhes e foco na excelência dos resultados.
Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e cumprir prazos rigorosos.
Facilidade para adaptação a novas tecnologias e ambientes dinâmicos.
Habilidades de comunicação para liderar e integrar equipes multifuncionais.

Trabalhe de uma maneira que funcione para você

Reconhecemos que cada pessoa é diferente e que a maneira como as pessoas desejam trabalhar e oferecer o melhor é diferente para cada pessoa também. Nesta função, podemos oferecer o seguinte padrão de trabalho:

Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente em horário administrativo.

Trabalhando conosco

Nosso pessoal está no centro do que fazemos na Baker Hughes. Sabemos que somos melhores quando todas as nossas pessoas são desenvolvidas, engajadas e capazes de trazer toda a sua autenticidade para o trabalho. Investimos na saúde e no bem-estar de nossa força de trabalho, treinamos e recompensamos talentos e desenvolvemos líderes em todos os níveis para trazer o melhor de cada um.

Políticas contemporâneas de equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal e atividades de bem-estar

description:
Lead Project Planner
 

Are you a Lead Project Planner who drives customer satisfaction?
 

Are you looking for your next Senior role?
 

Join our team!
 

At Baker Hughes, we are transforming the future of energy. With operations in over 120 countries, we are developing and deploying industry-leading technologies and services to take energy forward. For more than a century, our inventions have revolutionized energy. Today, we are bringing our expertise to make oil and gas safer, cleaner, and more efficient.
 

Partner with the best
 

As a Lead Project Planner, you will be responsible for flawless project execution through effective coordination of activities and resources. You will contribute to innovative technology projects in a complex and interesting technical environment. You will ensure every detail is meticulously planned to deliver successful projects to our customers.
 

As a Lead Project Planner, you will be responsible for:
 

Creating, monitoring & managing complex project schedules covering engineering, procurement, construction & installation of topside & subsea field equipment during tender & execution of both technology development & customer execution projects.
Collaborating with project teams, stakeholders and customers to ensure quality and accuracy of project schedules from tender through to execution.
Preparing and performing quantitative schedule risk analysis.
Recognizing opportunities and risks and working with stakeholders to identify and execute mitigations that will ensure project delivery, on time and on budget.
Preparing and presenting schedule reviews and providing schedule status updates and ensuring that key messages are communicated and understood at all levels of the business.
Reviewing planning and project administration specifications and working collaboratively with partners to ensure flawless execution of planning processes.
Contributing as a team member or leading small projects. Work goals will typically take 1-3 months to complete and the time horizon for results/impact is typically 6-18 months after the event.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED with at least 4 years of experience in Project Management).
Minimum of 3 years of experience in Subsea Oil & Gas Projects.
Minimum of 3 years of experience in Project Planning.
Experienced Primavera P6 User.
Fluent in English and Portuguese.

Preferred capabilities:

Experience in Oracle PRA or OPC Risk tools.
Experience in customer facing positions, contract review & negotiation.
Capable user of Microsoft Power BI and / or Power Apps.

Upínat a přesně ustavovat obrobky

Obrábět díly na karuselových strojích

Pracovat s technickou dokumentací a výkresy

Obsluhovat karusely o velikosti 5 m, 2,5 m a 1 m

Kontrolovat kvalitu provedené práce

Vyučení v oboru obráběč kovů (nebo odpovídající praxi)

Spolupracujte s těmi nejlepšími

Baker Hughes je přední globální energeticko‑technologická společnost, která poskytuje inovativní řešení zvyšující bezpečnost, čistotu a efektivitu energie napříč celým hodnotovým řetězcem. Společnost působí ve více než 120 zemích a kombinuje hluboké znalosti odvětví s pokročilým inženýrstvím a digitálními technologiemi na podporu výroby energie, její transformace a dekarbonizace. S více než stoletou tradicí spolupracuje Baker Hughes se zákazníky v ropném a plynárenském průmyslu, v průmyslových odvětvích i na rozvíjejících se energetických trzích, aby urychlila pokrok směrem k udržitelnější energetické budoucnosti.

Rozviňte svou vášeň

Jako Technolog/Process Engineer pro BOM tým budeš vytvářet technologické postupy a kusovníky, určovat časové normy a zajišťovat správnost dat v krátké i dlouhé struktuře kusovníků generátorů a náhradních dílů. Součástí práce je sledování nákladů, vyhodnocování reálných dat a následná aktualizace conventional postupů. Budeš spolupracovat na tvorbě nabídek pro výrobu generátorů a náhradních dílů, úzce komunikovat s dalšími útvary společnosti a připravovat technologické návody a předpisy. K práci patří také používání systémů Vault, Oracle a Monaco, které podporují správu dokumentace a výrobních dat.

Process Engieenering pro BOM team.

Tvorba technologických postupů a kusovníků, určování norem času.

Tvorba conventional postupů pro short and long strukturu kusovníků struktury generátorů a náhradních dílů.

Sledování nákladů, vyhodnocování dat a aktualizace conventional postupů dle reálných dat.

Spolupráce na zpracování nabídek na výrobu generátorů a náhradních dílů.

Spolupráce s ostatními útvary společnosti.

Tvorba technologických návodů a předpisů.

Práce se systémem Vault, Oracle a Monaco.

Vzdělání technického směru

Orientace ve výkresové dokumentaci

Orientace v systému výroby výhodou

Angličtina na střední úrovni - minimálně psaná (emaily)

title: Técnico em Manutenção Mecânica I
description:
Gosta de instalação e manutenção mecânica industrial?

Você gostaria de ter a oportunidade de trabalhar em uma empresa global de energia?

Junte-se à nossa equipe

Nossa equipe de reparos oferece serviço de alta qualidade para manutenção de equipamentos de acordo com as especificações operacionais. Fornecemos soluções inovadoras em várias geografias. Fornecemos aos clientes as soluções de excelência necessárias para melhorar de forma confiável e eficiente suas operações.

Faça parceria com os melhores

Como Técnico Mecânico JR, você será responsável por executar as  atividades estratégicas da área de manutenção mecânica Industrial, Assegurando que os ativos atendam, de forma consistente, às expectativas da Manufatura para executar a função ou as funções pretendidas em um determinado período de tempo sob condições especificadas, minimizando riscos, custos e melhorar a capacidade produtiva. É responsável por executar com qualidade a priorização de atividades planejadas programadas da Manutenção Fábrica, de forma que as ações realizadas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa.

Como Técnico Mecânico I, você será responsável por:

Realização de montagem mecânica, manutenção e revisão de equipamentos rotativos, visando a otimização dos recursos aplicados nas manutenções preventivas, preditivas e corretivas de manutenção;
Manutenção e reparos de equipamentos de produção, incluindo, mas não limitado a: redutores, equipamentos rotativos, bombas, motores elétricos, soldagem, etc.
Manutenção em unidades e equipamentos hidráulicos e pneumáticos ou qualquer outra máquina mecânica, conforme necessário.
Manutenção e reparação mecânica dos equipamentos das instalações das máquinas de produção manufatura.
Realização de Alinhamentos a laser de máquinas e equipamentos, interpretação de desenhos técnicos mecânicos.
Sólidos conhecimentos em instrumentos de medição mecânica e usinagem. Conhecimentos em lubrificação.
Conhecimentos em inspeções de campo.
Atuações direta em manutenções corretivas, preventiva e preditivas.
Garantir o cumprimento das políticas e procedimentos de HS&E Manter os registros do departamento conforme necessário e trabalhar em conjunto com o PCM e softwares operacionais de manutenção.
Atuação em projetos relacionados a melhorias e ao aumento da produção. Garantir e alimentar dados adequado e resultados esperados do software gerenciamento da Manutenção da companhia.
Fomentar e aplicar o uso de recursos adicionais que facilitem a gestão, acompanhamento/avanço e entregas das atividades da manutenção: dimensionamento de recursos, apoio e cronogramas;
Suportar a equipe de planejamento, programação e controle da manutenção dos ativos, equipamentos e peças de reposição, indicação e geração das necessidades de compras e recuperação de componentes, gerenciamento físico e contábil do estoque.
Realizar execução das paradas programadas conforme planejado, através de análise crítica de ordens de serviços.
Atender e disseminar aos requisitos de HSE (Segurança, Qualidade e Meio Ambiente), através do cumprimento das diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa e pelas normas vigentes e demais programas de gestão.
Consolidar as políticas de manutenção e garantir que elas estejam alinhadas com as melhores práticas para garantir ganhos em confiabilidade e disponibilidade de equipamentos e instalações;
Transmitir informações e conhecimento, habilidade em identificar e solucionar problemas, conhecer e entender o produto, vivência e experiência na área de manutenção mecânica, em processos produtivos industriais,
Conhecimentos técnicos em componentes industriais,  conhecimentos de técnicas preventivas e preditivas, tolerâncias e ajustes mecânicos, metrologia, lubrificação, bons conhecimentos de informática e noções de software de gerenciamento de manutenção; Influenciar e estabelecer forte parceria com a equipe de Manutenção, Eng Proc, Produção, Qualidade e demais áreas de apoio para assegurar a execução dos pilares de TPM;

QUALIFICAÇÃO OBRIGATÓRIA:

Formação:

Técnico em Mecânica e CFT ativo.

Experiências Desejáveis:

Possuir experiência anterior em indústria nas funções de técnico manutenção mecânica adquiridos em segmentos industriais diversos;
Conhecimentos de lubrificação industrial, circuitos hidráulicos e soluções de problemas.
Conhecimentos de manutenção de equipamentos rotativos (motores, redutores, bombas, elementos de transmissão, etc): desmontagem, ajustes/correções e montagem;
Conhecimentos técnicos em componentes industriais,  conhecimentos de técnicas preventivas e preditivas, usinagem, materiais de construção mecânica e aplicações, tratamento térmico, técnicas de soldagem, tolerâncias, ajustes mecânicos de precisão e metrologia;
Conhecimentos operacionais software manutenção – Sistema Máximo

Trabalhe de uma forma que funcione para você

Reconhecemos que cada pessoa é diferente e que a maneira como as pessoas desejam trabalhar e oferecer o melhor é diferente para cada pessoa também. Nesta função, podemos oferecer o seguinte padrão de trabalho:

Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos 4x4 e disponibilidade de trabalho no horário noturno.
Local: Niterói, RJ.

Trabalhando conosco

Nosso pessoal está no centro do que fazemos na Baker Hughes. Sabemos que somos melhores quando todos os nossos funcionários são desenvolvidos, engajados e capazes de trazer todo o seu ser autêntico para o trabalho. Investimos na saúde e no bem-estar de nossa força de trabalho, treinamos e recompensamos talentos e desenvolvemos líderes em todos os níveis para trazer à tona o melhor de cada um.

Trabalhando para você

Nossas invenções revolucionaram a energia por mais de um século. Mas para seguir em frente amanhã, sabemos que temos que ultrapassar os limites hoje. Priorizamos recompensar aqueles que adotam a mudança com um pacote que reflete o quanto valorizamos suas contribuições. Junte-se a nós e você pode esperar: 

Políticas contemporâneas de equilíbrio trabalho-vida e atividades de bem-estar 
Opções abrangentes de cuidados médicos privados 
Rede de segurança de programas de seguro de vida e deficiência 
Benefícios adicionais eleitos ou voluntários 

Sobre nós 

Com operações em mais de 120 países, oferecemos as melhores soluções para nossos clientes e oportunidades mais ricas para nosso pessoal. Como um parceiro líder da indústria de energia, estamos comprometidos em alcançar emissões líquidas de carbono zero até 2050 e estamos sempre procurando as pessoas certas para nos ajudar a chegar lá. Pessoas que são tão apaixonadas quanto nós por tornar a energia mais segura, mais limpa e mais eficiente. 

Junte-se a nós 

Você está procurando uma oportunidade de fazer a diferença em uma empresa com alcance global e serviços e clientes interessantes? Junte-se a nós e cresça com uma equipe de pessoas que irão energizar e inspirar você! 

A Baker Hughes Company prioriza oportunidades iguais para todos os candidatos. Todas as nossas vagas são destinadas também a pessoas com deficiência. As decisões de contratação são tomadas independentemente de raça, cor, religião, origem nacional ou étnica, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, idade, deficiência, ou outras características protegidas por lei. 

Alerta de Privacidade 

Os dados pessoais coletados como parte deste processo serão usados para fins de verificação de conformidade com a legislação. Tais dados serão armazenados de forma segura e com acesso limitado, sendo retidos de acordo com as políticas de retenção de documentos da Baker Hughes. Os dados pessoais serão processados de acordo com o Aviso de Proteção de Dados da Baker Hughes, e com o “Nosso Jeito: o Código de Conduta da Baker Hughes”, disponível aqui.

výroba cívek pro rotory generátorů

výroba statorových tyčí generátorů

SOU nejlépe technického směru výhodou

ochota pracovat na 3 směny

schopnost komunikace v češtině

praxe v oboru výhodou

Naši lidé jsou srdcem všeho, co v Baker Hughes děláme. Víme, že jsme lepší, když se všichni naši zaměstnanci rozvíjejí, jsou angažovaní a mohou být sami sebou. Naše vynálezy mění energetiku už více než století. Abychom mohli pokračovat i zítra, musíme posouvat hranice už dnes. Odměňujeme ty, kteří přijímají změny, balíčkem benefitů, který odráží, jak moc si jejich přínosu vážíme.

description:
Regional Customs Manager – North America (U.S. & Canada)

Role Summary

Lead the North America customs and import program for Baker Hughes, Industrial Energy Technology (IET). Own day-to-day operations execution, governance, broker performance, and post-entry accuracy. Implement and sustain CBP and Canada’s Customs programs. Manage and coach the import team and upskill stakeholders to ensure compliant, efficient cross-border flows.

Governance & Compliance
Own compliance with U.S. (CBP) and Canada (CBSA) laws and policies across classification, valuation, origin, admissibility, and partner government agency (PGA) requirements.
Establish and maintain internal controls that meet “reasonable care” standards, including procedures, work instructions, and periodic testing.
Lead recordkeeping controls: U.S. (5 years) and Canada (6 years), with complete audit trails and secure retrieval.
Run post-entry processes end to end: Post Summary Corrections (PSC), Reconciliation, duty refunds, prior disclosures, protests, and drawback coordination as needed.
Lead and manage internal audits, and CBP trade regulatory audits and verifications.
Programs & Certifications
Implement and sustain CBP CTPAT Security; partner with stakeholders on remediation and continuous improvement.
Build readiness and governance for CTPAT Trade Compliance (Trusted Trader modernization), including internal control design, risk assessment, and self-testing.
Lead Canada Trusted Trader programs (PIP/CSA): meet Minimum Security Requirements, prepare for validations, and manage action plans.
Operationalize Canada’s CARM requirements (Commercial Accounting Declarations, RPP, harmonized billing) with the import team and brokers.
Broker Operations & Performance
Customs broker management: SOPs, power of attorney, billing accuracy, performance scorecards, business reviews.
Ensure brokers meet regulatory requirements and changes, ACE data quality, and KPI targets.
Drive root cause analysis on entry errors and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
Tariff Strategy & Trade Programs
Cross-functional collaboration with BU’s engineering, supply chain, classification and trade-compliance for regulatory compliance.
Evaluating and executing duty-savings opportunities: FTA’s, Drawback, Tariff-rate quotas, and other strategic areas.
Monitoring Section 301/232/IEEPA trade remedies and other tariff actions; advise leaders on impacts and mitigations.
Providing tariff impact analysis, scenario modeling, and recommendations for strategic trade decisions.
Oversee quota planning and critical shipments; ensure timely and correct filings (ACE, portal, CAD/CARM).
Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement
Managing the NAM import team: set priorities, coach, mentor, and build career paths.
Providing clear training for procurement, logistics, finance, and business teams on customs basics and Incoterms.
Influencing to drive process adherence and systems adoption across product companies and functions.
Qualifications
Must have a Bachelor’s degree in International Trade, Supply Chain, Business, or related field.
Have 10+ years in U.S./Canada customs or trade compliance, including leadership of broker operations and post-entry.
Have U.S. Licensed Customs Broker strongly preferred; experience with Canadian customs (PIP/CSA, CARM) is a plus.
 Have working knowledge of export controls and sanctions interfaces (screenings/escalations).
Have deep knowledge of HTS classification, customs valuation, rules of origin, and partner government agency requirements.
Have hands-on experience with PSC, Reconciliation, audits/verifications, and internal control frameworks.
Have working knowledge of ACE (reports/portal) and CBSA CARM; proficiency with ERP (SAP/Oracle) and analytics dashboards.
Key Performance Indicators
First-pass entry accuracy and on-time clearance.
PSC/Reconciliation/protest cycle time and accuracy.
Audit/verification outcomes and issue-free rates.
Broker accuracy, timeliness, and cost-to-serve.
FTA claim accuracy and duty savings delivered.
Training coverage and policy/process adherence.
Work Setup
Location: Houston, TX (hybrid).
Travel: up to 5% across U.S. and Canada.
Relocation: not available

You will be eligible to participate in Company-sponsored benefit programs, including health & welfare programs and the Thrift Plan (401k). You will have a choice of coverage options that best suit your needs. Coverage options and contribution amounts are related to your benefit elections, base salary level, and specific requirements of each of these plans. 

This position is eligible for our comprehensive and competitive benefits package, which can be found here, and is further eligible for additional forms of compensation such as bonuses subject to the terms of the applicable benefit plans or policies.

Schedule Development & Management:

Maintain, and update detailed project schedules using Primavera P6 covering all phases: engineering, procurement, manufacturing, and delivery. Analyse variances, and escalate potential delays or deviations.

Work with engineering managers and global teams to allocate resources and monitor engineering hours. Adjust schedules based on actual progress and revised forecasts. Ensure resource loading in schedules is accurate and realistic.

Coordinate closely with the Product Delivery Planner to review MRP data with real-time scheduling needs. Ensure timely release and sequencing of materials per the project schedule and lead times. Collaborate with global project teams to gather inputs and provide updates on schedule status. Communicate clearly across time zones, maintaining regular cadence of updates and reports. Support internal and external project reviews with relevant scheduling data and dashboards.

Generate reports from Primavera P6 and MRP systems for progress reviews and risk assessments. Maintain audit-ready documentation of all schedule changes.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Supply Chain, or a related discipline. 3–5 years of experience in scheduling or project coordination, ideally in project industry or oil & gas sectors. Proficient in Primavera P6 and familiar with MRP systems (e.g. Oracle, SAP). Strong analytical and communication skills; able to interpret technical schedules and explain to non-technical audiences. Experience coordinating across global teams and time zones.

Preferred:

Exposure to subsea equipment or offshore oil & gas projects is a plus, not mandatory. Previous collaboration with planners or project controls teams.

title: Lead Sourcing Specialist - Buying/Procurement
description:
Lead Sourcing Specialist – Buying/Procurement

Are you passionate about driving sourcing excellence and optimizing material flow for manufacturing operations?

Do you thrive in a fast‑paced environment where supply chain performance directly impacts production success?

Partner with the best

Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company serving the oil and gas sector across more than 120 countries. The Commercial & Sales organization drives growth by building strong customer partnerships, commercializing hydrocarbons, and delivering integrated equipment and service solutions. With a focus on digital transformation and energy transition, the team leverages data‑driven insights to optimize sales performance and maximize customer value.

Fuel your passion

The Lead Sourcing Specialist – Buying/Procurement is supporting the industrial valve manufacturing site by managing master planning, purchasing activities, and material processes to ensure seamless production execution. The role is driving supplier performance, material alignment, and inventory optimization while ensuring compliance with nuclear, HSE, and organizational standards. By strengthening sourcing operations and improving visibility across the supply chain, the specialist is enabling on‑time delivery and operational excellence.

As a Lead Sourcing Specialist – Buying/Procurement, you will be responsible for:

Managing master planning, material processes, and systems for the industrial valve site in Houston, Texas

Preparing and updating production schedules based on purchasing needs and operational requirements

Driving process improvements to enhance visibility of material availability across product lines

Ensuring material alignment with production plans and KPIs through coordination with materials teams and suppliers

Optimizing inventory levels and improving processes related to inbound shipments from external suppliers

Exchanging data and information regarding product, process, and procedural improvements with cross‑functional teams

Starting and observing machine operation to detect malfunctions or out-of-tolerance
machining and adjusts machine controls as required.

Digital Marketing Specialist

Partner with the best

Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company serving the oil and gas sector across more than 120 countries

Fuel your passion​ 


The Digital services Marketing Specialist is responsible for promoting and positioning Baker Hughes’  Digital Services effectively in the market, building brand awareness and driving revenue growth. Their expertise in digital service positioning and messaging supports successful market penetration.


As a Digital Marketing Specialist, you will be responsible for:


- Supporting the development and implementation of the marketing plan in line with the business & strategic objectives 
- Working closely with the product management team and solution architects - planning and developing demand generation campaign plans and tactics, complete with supporting campaign assets 
- Developing and executing thought leadership and content development plans 
- Developing, executing, and supporting sales enablement, in collaboration with product management and commercial teams, through the creation of activation assets (external) and empowerment assets (internal readiness) 
- Conducting competitive analysis and monitor competitor activity to enrich sales enablement and identify competitive gaps and opportunities to inform the product management team. 
- Supporting market research and go-to-market planning to ensure Baker Hughes’ Gas services digital achieves a strong product-market fit to deliver success and market acceptance. 
- Experience working in a matrix structure and managing agency resources. 
- Experience in database marketing – nice to have. 



To be successful in this role:
 
- Have Master's degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma / GED with at least 5 years of experience in Marketing).
- Minimum of 5 additional years of experience in leading Commercial or Product Marketing initiatives.
- Have the expertise or good understanding of the various aspects of marketing is an advantage, including demand generation, content management, digital marketing, brand marketing, and communications.
- Strong oral and written communication skills.
- Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
- Ability to influence others.
- Lead initiatives of moderate scope and impact.
- Ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously. Effective problem identification and solution skills.
- Proven analytical and organizational ability.

description:
Field Service Electrical Engineer (Remote in Houston)
 

Are you an experienced Field Service Engineer motivated to deliver the best service to your customers?

Would you like the opportunity to further develop your career with a global energy technology company?
 

Join our Field Service team!
 

At Baker Hughes our purpose is clear; We take energy forward making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet. Our IET team provides industry-leading products and services that optimize the extraction, production and processing of energy. BRUSH power generation products enhances Baker Hughes portfolio of electromechanical equipment, including electric generators, synchronous condensers, electric motors, and associated control power management systems.
 

Partner with the best
 

The Electrical Engineer will carry out commissioning /installation/repair/maintenance and upgrading of large rotating electrical machines and their associated control equipment in the field at customer sites throughout the US and abroad.

As a Field Specialist-Electrical Commissioning, you will be responsible for:

Commissioning High Voltage Generators, Motors, Synchronous condensers, Power management systems (PMS), Electrical protection systems, Excitation Controllers (AVRs), and Synchronizing equipment.
Performing role while applying company health and safety procedures applicable to the job site. Typical examples are HV safety, lock out tag out, permit to work systems and risk and method statements.
Conducting upgrades to AVRS, PMS systems, Synchronizers, Protection relays and other control elements.
Carrying out electrical testing on high and low voltage equipment and machine windings in the field. Examples may include Polarization Index, Insulation resistance, and Ductor tests.
Practicing some degree of project management at site.
Delivering training on Brush products to clients and field service colleagues.
Interpreting technical drawings, specifications and technical requirements. Attend technical meetings on site and at customers’ premises. 

Fuel your passion
 

To be successful in this role you will have:

Degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering or completed  and/or a recognized craft apprenticeship in electrical engineering with demonstrated experience in the field.
High level knowledge of electrical power generation and distribution systems for industrial equipment. Ideally have knowledge of networking systems such as, Modbus, Ethernet, 61850, Fiber.
Be self reliant, resourceful and a problem solver with well developed commercial awareness
Experienced in representing the Company at customers’ sites and operating remotely on own initiative whilst observing the requirements set down in the Company’s Code of Conduct
Able to work with Company’s rules and guidance notes on health and safety, including operation of safe systems of work in relation to high voltage and medium voltage electrical systems and work in a heavy industrial environment.
Able and willingness travel when called upon and on short notice on a regular basis both domestically and internationally 75% - 85% of the time or as business needs dictate.

description:
Responsible for managing and executing the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process and the process outcomes

The sale & operation planning organization drives growth by building strong forecast planning partner with operation focus in 18 months period to foresee ahead business and operation outlook. With a focus on material number details forecast as well as Integrated Business Planning, the team leverages data-driven insights to optimize sales and operation planning.

Partner with the best.

Fuel your passion

The Sales & Operation planning specialist supports the effective operation of the materials by delivering analytical, administrative, and reporting across the sales and commercial plus operation planning function. This role drives continuous improvement of processes and systems, ensuring consistent, high-quality forecast planning aligned with organizational standards. By enabling data collection and following up with planning in advance, the specialist helps strengthen performance, efficiency, and planning across global CWI.

As the S&OP specialist will have the following responsibilities:

· Accountable and responsible for implementation of the S&OP process and compliance to Head Quarter governance including S&OP output graphs/datasets, KPI’s and S&OP actions

· Communicates with regional and product line S&OP planners to fully understand business trends, opportunities and demand forecast

· Works with the region sales and service delivery to create the regional forecast (12-18 month) for material level and unit of activity (UoA) level.

· Accountable for the aggregation of the region forecasts into a global product line forecast and Responsible to net the region demand plans against the inventory to create a region netted demand plan

· Responsible to net the region demand plan against regional supply plans and Works with operations to locate existing inventory or substitutions for open orders

· Schedule and lead Monthly S&OP Calls and Develop and prioritize continuous improvement projects to maximize value of S&OP

· Ensure demand, supply, and other signals are aligned and communicated to the proper end users and Ensure product life cycle management for new and obsolete products are incorporated into the S&OP process

· Ensure that the HFM COGS, supply and DP forecast are aligned. Identify key projects and what support is needed from Supply Chain.

To be successful in this role you will:

· Bachelor's degree in supply chain management or related field or equivalent experience (7+ years’ experience)

· Experience in S&OP and forecasting, inventory optimization and management, asset utilization and management. CWI knowledge is an advantage.

· Deep knowledge of SAP and MRP functionality

· Ability to work with and influence stakeholders

· Strategic thinking with tactical execution with a sense of urgency

Partner with the best.

Fuel your passion

The CAD manager is responsible for the management of the CAD system with the aim of ensuring its availability and compliance with the needs of the engineering offices. It participates both in the maintenance of the system and in the development necessary for the proper functioning of the engineering office.

As CAD manager, you will be responsible for, the mission of the CAD Manager is (evolving and non‑exhaustive list):

Managing the CAD base used by the engineering offices: family tables, CAD models, symbols, automation, etc.

Ensuring alignment between the CAD base and the ERP base.

Bringing CAD expertise to the staff of the engineering offices (problem‑solving and training).

Participating in the integration of calculation tools / ITO tools into the CAD system.

Participating in CAD standardization actions.

Participating in continuous improvement and implementation of engineering standards.

Participating in new product development by maintaining the adequacy of the CAD tool.

Supporting the implementation of the CAD tool strategy (hardware, software, license support, etc.).

Comparing, standardizing, and implementing good practices between the three engineering sites.

The CAD Manager is having the authority to define good CAD practices applicable to project execution and to implement the necessary procedures. The CAD Manager is defining in autonomy, with the IT department, the evolutions of the CAD system which are being submitted to the manager and engineering manager for approval.

The CAD Manager is getting the team leaders, manager, or engineering manager to validate the changes related to the continuous improvement process of the engineering department.

title: Technicien(ne) mécanique – contrôle et essais (F/H)
description:
Vous êtes à la recherche d'une opportunité intéressante et inspirante ?

Vous avez envie de faire partie d’une équipe performante ?

Faites partie d'une équipe performante !

Chez Baker Hughes, nous transformons l'avenir de l'énergie. Présents dans plus de 120 pays, nous développons et déployons des technologies et des services de pointe pour faire progresser l'énergie. Depuis plus d'un siècle, nos inventions révolutionnent l'énergie. Aujourd'hui, nous apportons notre expertise pour rendre le pétrole et le gaz plus sûrs, plus propres et plus efficaces.

Collaborez avec les meilleur(e)s

En tant que Technicien(ne) mécanique – contrôle et essais (F/H),  vous serez en charge de contrôler la conformité de fonctionnement d’un appareil en test ainsi que de l’instrumentation et des accessoires qui le compose suivant une spécification d’essai.

A ce titre, vous serez chargé(e) de :

Identifier les contrôles et les procédures de tests/essais à réaliser, à partir du cahier des charges et des dossiers techniques.

Sélectionner le matériel de contrôle ou d’essais et vérifier sa conformité client.

Installer les appareils sur le banc de test et les périphériques (Instrumentation, outillages, moteur, lubrification,)

Préparer et configurer tous les systèmes d’acquisition de données (Adre, eurotherme…)

Conduire l’essai afin de contrôler la conformité de fonctionnement d’un appareil en test ainsi que l’instrumentation et les accessoires qui le compose

Analyser les mesures, diagnostiquer les causes de dysfonctionnement et effectuer les modifications de mise en conformité du produit si besoin.

Réaliser les opérations de démontage et remontage des appareils sur le banc de test.

title: ITC Program Manager
description:
Responsibilities: 

Program Management & Governance 

Lead and continuously enhance Baker Hughes’ global trade compliance program in alignment with company standards, U.S. and international export control regulations (including EAR, ITAR, OFAC, and BIS), and applicable local laws. 

Develop, implement, and maintain global procedures and internal controls related to trade compliance activities, ensuring consistent execution across regions. 

Establish performance metrics and reporting dashboards to monitor program effectiveness and risk exposure. 

Support periodic compliance reviews, risk assessments, and management reporting to the Global Compliance & Legal leadership. 

Collaborate with digital and data governance teams to strengthen system-based compliance monitoring and reporting. 

Denied Party Screening (DPS) Oversight 

Coordinate enterprise-wide denied/restricted party screening program, ensuring timely screening of customers, suppliers, partners, and transactions in accordance with Baker Hughes policy and applicable law. 

Maintain and enhance partner screening programs and systems including workflows, escalation matrices, and documentation protocols. 

Provide day-to-day guidance to business teams on handling potential matches, licensing requirements, and release procedures. 

Coordinate periodic reviews to validate data accuracy and screening effectiveness. 

Liaise with IT and Digital Technology teams to ensure automation, system integrity, and data governance. 

Training, Awareness & Communication 

Design and implement comprehensive trade compliance training and awareness programs across global functions. 

Deliver targeted in-person and virtual sessions for high-risk roles such as logistics, sales, procurement, and operations. 

Partner with Corporate Communications to launch periodic campaigns and awareness initiatives aligned with Baker Hughes’ Integrity Forward culture. 

Track completion metrics and continuously enhance training content to reflect evolving regulatory expectations and business operations. 

Collaboration 

Work with Trade Compliance & Business Personnel to map and develop Trade compliance processes and procedures. 

Participate in industry working groups to stay current on global trade developments and emerging enforcement trends. 

Coordinate and harmonize processes and standards between segments, business lines, and functions. 

Continuous Improvement & Risk Mitigation 

Drive process improvement initiatives leveraging automation, data analytics, and best practices. 

Benchmark the program against industry standards and recommend enhancements to maintain best-in-class compliance. 

Support the integration of trade compliance controls within the Enterprise Policy Hub and other cross-functional compliance frameworks. 

Contribute to the broader Compliance & Integrity organization’s mission to foster trust, transparency, and accountability. 

Previous Experience and Competencies: 

Education: ​ Bachelor’s degree in International Business, Law, Supply Chain, or related discipline; Master’s or JD preferred. 

Experience:​ Minimum of 7–10 years of progressive experience in global trade compliance, preferably within a multinational industrial, energy, or manufacturing company. 

In-depth knowledge of U.S. export control and sanctions regulations (EAR, ITAR, OFAC) and experience managing global screening programs. 

Working knowledge of international sanctions and trade regulation, including EU, UK, and China regulation. 

Strong working knowledge of SAP GTS or equivalent global trade management system. 

Proven ability to develop training, manage cross-functional initiatives, and influence across a global matrixed organization. 

Exceptional analytical, communication, and project management skills. 

High level of integrity, sound judgment, and ability to navigate complex compliance issues.

Do you have a passion for delivering new technology, solving problems for our customers?

Are you passionate about building relationships and ensuring customer success?

Join our customer focused team

Our Industrial and Energy Technology (IET) operates across 120 countries and serves the entire energy value-chain and industrial sector. We hold an extensive portfolio of rotating equipment, process flow, transmission technology and lifecycle services. Our Engineering Transformation team work to improve the quality of our Engineering processes.

Partner with the best

As a Systems Technical Lead, you'll be a subject matter expert in the technical operations of Cordant Solutions™. This role supports project engineering and services through technical reviews, including system engineering design, network design, system integration, OT cybersecurity, explosive atmosphere design, functional safety design, and commissioning quality for machinery protection and condition monitoring hardware and software in OT environments. In addition, the role ensures compliance with regulatory and standards requirements for solutions engineered and serviced for specific customers and countries.

As a Systems Technical Lead, you will be responsible for:

•    Evaluating and reviewing project designs, including system architecture drawings, BoMs, and configurations, to ensure alignment with product capabilities, standards, and customer requirements.
•    Reviewing pre-commissioned CMS software configurations performed by the field services team.
•    Supporting field service engineers with site-related issues not directly attributable to products. Mentor project engineers and service engineers.
•    Supporting the NPI team with Alpha and Beta testing of both hardware and software.
•    Assisting the pre-sales team with non-standard technical requests, such as explosive atmosphere installations, OT cybersecurity, third-party system integration, technical regulations and standards, maritime applications, etc.
•    Driving continuous improvement in design, processes, and support initiatives such as variable cost reduction. Conduct training on products for internal functions as needed.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

•    Have a Bachelor’s degree in computer science, electrical, electronics, or instrumentation engineering.
•    Have a minimum of 10 years of experience in Bently Nevada or similar OEM environments, including hands-on project engineering, field commissioning, industrial networking, system integration, and OT cybersecurity.
•    Have CompEx, IECEx certification for hazardous area applications or related credentials.
•    Have Strong knowledge of Bently Nevada products. Have In-depth understanding of API 670 standard.
•    Have Solid foundation in computer networking and OT cybersecurity principles. Have Experience with explosive atmosphere installation standards such as IEC 60079-14 and functional safety standards such as IEC 61508 and IEC 61511
•    Have Working knowledge of IEC general safety standards: 61010, 61439, 62406, and 61000-6-X. Have Good understanding of technical regulations and standards processes.
•    Have Strong knowledge of OT protocols (e.g., Modbus, OPC) and APIs. Have Proficiency in network segmentation, firewall configuration, and secure remote access.
•    Have Hands-on experience with OT/ICS-specific security tools and backup systems. Have Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and regulatory standards (e.g., NIST CSF, NERC CIP).

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

•    Occasional remote working as required
•    Flexibility within the day or week to get the job done
•    Compressed hours

We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

•    Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration, or related field; or equivalent experience in Field Service operations.

Knowledge of generator or rotating equipment services preferred.  

Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Word, Teams).  

Experience with ERP systems such as Workday, Oracle or SAP preferred.  

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.  

Excellent communication and teamwork skills across multiple departments and time zones.  

Strong customer service skills. 

Fluency in English required, Portuguese or Spanish a plus. 

Our Americas team is growing to support the demand in the region, and this includes a hub in Houston and Brazil that will support our growing demand for more Field Service Engineers.

Field Service Engineer- Winding
 

Are you a Winding Engineer motivated to deliver the best service to your customers?

Would you like the opportunity to further develop your career with a global energy technology company?
 

Join our new BRUSH Power Generation team!

At Baker Hughes our purpose is clear; We take energy forward making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet. The Field Winding Engineer is generally responsible for providing electrical and winding repair services to customers operating a wide range of original equipment, which includes: generators, motors and ancillary systems.

As a Field Service Engineer, you will be responsible for:

Performing Winding inspection, electrical testing, maintenance and repairs on Generator HV windings on customer sites globally.

Driving Enterprise Financial Stability Through Strategic Funding, Hedging, and Liquidity Oversight

Enabling Baker Hughes’ Treasury Excellence Through Insightful Risk Analytics and Operational Governance

Partner with the best

Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company serving customers worldwide with innovative solutions across the energy value chain. Our Treasury organization ensures the financial resilience of the enterprise through robust liquidity management, disciplined exposure mitigation, and effective capital markets execution. By safeguarding the company’s financial resources and optimizing funding strategies, Treasury enables operational agility, regulatory compliance, and long‑term enterprise strength.

Fuel your passion

The Lead Treasury Analyst plays a critical role in developing and executing enterprise‑wide funding, liquidity, and exposure management strategies. This position manages key analytical processes that safeguard Baker Hughes’ balance sheet, including FX and interest rate risk analytics, hedging execution, and Treasury Management System (TMS) governance.

As a Lead Treasury Analyst, you will be responsible for:

• Assessing company‑wide asset and liability exposures and entering into appropriate hedging or offsetting transactions to mitigate risks.

• Managing and conducting analytical work to identify FX, interest rate, and other market risks embedded in Baker Hughes’ balance sheet exposures.

• Employing advanced analytics to determine appropriate hedging strategies and conducting trade execution in line with Treasury governance.

• Ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, internal risk frameworks, and corporate Treasury policies.

• Serving as operational owner for Treasury Management System governance, including exposure management modules, workflows, and related process controls.

• Advising functional managers and business partners on Treasury impacts related to projects, processes, and procedures.

• Coordinating with Treasury colleagues, investors, banks, and liquidity providers on exposure positions and funding activities.

• Contributing as a team member or leading small projects with 3–6‑month delivery horizons and 2–12‑month impact timelines.

To be successful in this role you will:

• Have a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college (or a high school diploma/GED with at least 4 years of Finance experience).

• Bring a minimum of 3 additional years of experience in exposure management or related Treasury disciplines.

• Demonstrate strong oral and written communication skills.

• Possess excellent interpersonal and leadership capabilities.

• Lead initiatives of moderate scope and coordinate multiple projects simultaneously.

• Exhibit strong analytical thinking, problem‑solving ability, and organizational discipline.

title: Technik testovania a opráv
description:
Technik testovania a opráv

Máte skúsenosti s testovaním elektrotechnických výrobkov a prácou s meracími prístrojmi, napríklad s osciloskopom?

Vykonávali ste vo svojej predchádzajúcej praxi opravy, nastavovanie alebo funkčné skúšky elektrotechnických výrobkov?

Spolupracujte s tými najlepšími 

Spoločnosť patrí do medzinárodnej korporácie Baker Hughes, ktorá poskytuje rozsiahle služby a technické riešenia v oblasti tažby a spracovania ropy a plynu. Má pobočky vo viac než 120 krajinách a zamestnáva viac ako 60,000 ľudí po celom svete.

Spoločnosť Baker Hughes Slovakia patrí do divízie Digital Solutions, ktorá je dynamickou divíziou celej korporácie a jej hlavným poslaním je poskytovanie riešení pre maximalizáciu ekonomickej výkonnosti prevádzkových aktív zákazníkov prostredníctvom rôznych inovácií, metód moderného riadenia, sensorových a inšpekčných technológií, zberu dát, informačného manažmentu alebo odborných kontrolných riešení.

Samotná spoločnosť Baker Hughes Slovakia, s.r.o. so sídlom v Novom Meste nad Váhom sa zaoberá výrobou ultrazvukových sond používaných v nedeštruktívnej defektoskopii, ako aj strojárskou výrobou častí do priemyselných testovacích zariadení používaných v petrochemickom priemysle.

Rozviňte svoju technickú zručnosť

Technik testovania a opráv zohráva zásadnú úlohu pri zabezpečení kvality a spoľahlivosti elektrotechnických výrobkov. Na tejto pozícii budete testovať ultrazvukové sondy, pracovať s meracími prístrojmi a vykonávať kontroly, ktoré sú kľúčové pre bezchybný priebeh výroby. Vašou úlohou bude vyhodnocovať parametre výrobkov, zaznamenávať výsledky meraní a vykonávať jednoduché opravy či nastavenia podľa interných špecifikácií.

Presná práca s technickou dokumentáciou, dôsledné merania a schopnosť identifikovať odchýlky priamo prispievajú k vysokej kvalite finálnych produktov. Vďaka vašej odbornosti podporíte plynulý chod výroby, spoľahlivé dodávky a neustále zlepšovanie procesov.

Vaše zodpovednosti budú zahŕňať: 

 vykonávať kontroly v elektrotechnickej výrobe pomocou bežných merných nástrojov, skúšobných pomôcok a meracích prístrojov - práca s osciloskopom

zaznamenávať výsledky meraní

Vykonávať jednoduché opravy a nastavenia polotovarov a výrobkov na základe interných špecifikácií

Vykonávať funkčné skúšky, overovanie a vyhodnocovanie predpísaných parametrov elektrotechnických výrobkov a montážnych skupín, hodnotenie ich kvality, vypracovávanie skúšobných protokolov

Vyhodnotenie výsledkov kontrol, formulácia záverov a vydávanie posudkov

Osobnostné predpoklady a zručnosti

Technické myslenie

Čítanie technickej dokumentácie

PC MS Office

SAP - výhoda

Obsluha 2D meracích zariadení

Možnosti flexibilnej práce prosím preberte s náborárom.

Naši ľudia sú srdcom všetkého, čo v Baker Hughes robíme. Vieme, že sme lepší vtedy, keď sa všetci naši zamestnanci rozvíjajú, sú angažovaní a môžu byť sami sebou.
