title: Estágio em Sales & Commercial - Campinas
description:
Você gostaria da oportunidade de estagiar em uma empresa Global de Energia e Tecnologia? Você gosta de embarcar em projetos desafiadores? 

Venha fazer parte do nosso Programa de Estágio! 

Previsão de Início: Março 2026.

O nosso Estágio é pensado para permitir que estudantes de Nível Superior tenham a oportunidade de ter experiências práticas de trabalho formando uma base sólida para suas vidas profissionais. Nossos estágios lhe darão percepções de primeira mão sobre os processos, sistemas e práticas que estão alinhados para garantir que as necessidades do cliente sejam atendidas por meio de execução impecável e aplicação de tecnologia de ponta. 

Esteja ao lado dos melhores!

Nosso Estágio vai te proporcionar a oportunidade de participar em Treinamentos técnicos e de desenvolvimento, reuniões de equipe e participar de projetos para apresentar seus resultados! Durante seu estágio, você terá todo suporte da equipe, gestão e um Buddy designado especialmente para suas necessidades, garantindo que você tenha uma experiência de aprendizado valiosa!  

 

Como estagiário, você será responsável por: 

Receber treinamento e mentoria, que permitirão que você complete suas tarefas e projetos que aperfeiçoarão seu aprendizado e habilidades;  

Engajar, conhecer e aprender sobre sua área designada, mas não limitando-se à;  

Participar e Entregar projetos internos para entregar resultados aos clientes (internos e externos) e identificar oportunidades de melhorias no negócio e área 

Aprender o Sistema Operacional interno (incluindo softwares e aplicativos) que te ajudarão no processo de desenvolver e entregar seus projetos e tarefas diárias 

Colaborar e Conectar com diferentes times, estagiários e áreas da Baker Hughes para ter um amplo conhecimento e rede de networking global 

Aplicar os conceitos de HSE (Saúde, Segurança e Meio-Ambiente) garantindo e mantendo os procedimentos em todas as situações para um ambiente mais seguro, íntegro e saudável. 

Participar e Engajar em grupos de integração para estagiários e outros Hubs de voluntariado, Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão que alavancarão seu networking e desenvolvimentos de habilidades por todo o Globo. 

 

Alimente sua paixão: 

Para ter sucesso e ser considerado no nosso estágio, você precisa: 

Estar regularmente matriculado em cursos de: Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Química, Petróleo, Elétrica, Naval), Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, e relacionados; 

Ter interesse e afinidade em: marketing, habilidades de negociação, contato com clientes, e correlatos 

Possuir Inglês de nível Intermediário para Avançado; 

Conhecimento em Excel e Power Bi; 

Ter disponibilidade para estagiar pelo período de 02 anos, 30h por semana;  

Possuir o direito de estagiar legalmente no Brasil; 

 

Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação: 

Dentro da Baker Hughes temos diversas áreas de oportunidade para estagiar, então confira abaixo mais detalhes para a área de: 

 

Sales & Commercial 

O estagiário da área de Sales & Commercial terá diferentes oportunidades de explorar seus conhecimentos dentro da área que for designado, e você pode conferir abaixo quais são as possíveis áreas de atuação na Baker Hughes: 

Vendas: O estagiário de vendas dará suporte em iniciativas comerciais, planejamento de vendas e interação entre diferentes áreas impactadas dentro da linha de produto. Durante o estágio, terá contato direto com lideranças financeiras, comerciais e operacionais da empresa, auxiliando com relatórios, apresentações e discussões estratégicas para a região.  

Área Comercial: o estagiário da área comercial irá suportar em atividades do uso estratégico de dados de mercado, cliente e competidores e da construção eficiente de dashboards gerenciais como: Construção de estratégias comerciais ganhadoras para as oportunidades identificadas e prospectadas no mercado, Gerenciamento dos processos e stakeholders envolvidos no processo comercial, Elaboração do orçamento dos projetos e apresentação do business case para a alta gestão regional e global. 

Customer Care: O estagiário da CC geralmente contribuirá com a equipe de atendimento ao cliente para fornecer as metas operacionais do dia a dia. Espera-se pensamento apropriado e inteligência aplicada ao lidar com questionamentos de clientes, processos de simplificação ou outras situações, e certamente, o estagiário pode se beneficiar de um histórico de engenharia ou qualificação técnica para apoiar cotações e consultas mais tecnicamente orientadas e pode ser capaz de acessar uma carreira em potencial na equipe de Engenharia de Aplicações Comerciais ou Gestão Comercial com a experiência apropriada. 

​Localização:

description:
¿Te gustaría tener la oportunidad de trabajar en una empresa energética global? 

 

¿Te gusta asumir proyectos desafiantes? 

 

Únete a nuestro innovador Programa de Pasantías 

 

La pasantía Baker Hughes está diseñada para permitir que los estudiantes que cursan una licenciatura o maestría obtengan experiencia laboral práctica como base de sus vidas profesionales. Nuestras pasantías le brindarán información de primera mano sobre los procesos, sistemas y prácticas que están alineados para garantizar que se satisfagan las necesidades del cliente a través de una ejecución impecable y la aplicación de tecnología de vanguardia. 

 

Fecha de inicio: Marzo del 2026 

 

Asóciate con los mejores 

 

Participarás en capacitaciones enfocadas y reuniones de equipo, trabajarás en proyectos y presentarás tus resultados. Durante tu pasantía, contarás con el apoyo de un compañero y tu gerente que se asegurarán de que tengas una valiosa experiencia de aprendizaje. Puedes esperar recibir entrenamiento y tutoría que te permitirá completar tareas y proyectos para desarrollar tu aprendizaje y habilidades. 

También tendrás la oportunidad de familiarizarse con la salud, la seguridad y el medio ambiente (HS&E) y la cultura de Baker Hughes. así como nuestro fuerte compromiso con la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión.  

 

Como pasante de ingeniería de campo, serás responsable de: 

Completar proyectos internos para ofrecer resultados a los clientes e identificar mejoras comerciales 

Colaborando junto a ingenieros experimentados para ayudar en diversas operaciones de campo, como perforación, pruebas de pozos o mantenimiento de equipos. 

Recopilar datos de las actividades de campo y ayudar a analizarlos para identificar tendencias o problemas y solucionar problemas a través de tareas de resolución de problemas relacionados con las operaciones y el equipo de campo. 

Inspeccionar y mantener el equipo para asegurarse de que esté en buen estado de funcionamiento.  

Mantener registros detallados y documentación de las actividades de campo, las inspecciones de equipos y las medidas de seguridad es esencial para el cumplimiento y las referencias futuras. 

Aplicar las normas y procedimientos de Salud, Seguridad y Medio Ambiente (HS&E) en todas las situaciones para garantizar que se mantenga el cumplimiento. 

 

Alimenta tu pasión 

Para tener éxito en este rol, deberás: 

 

Estar actualmente inscrito en un grado de licenciatura en Ingeniería, Tecnología, Mecánica, u otro programa relacionado con STEM. 

Hablar inglés oral y escrito con fluidez y tener habilidades de comunicación efectivas 

Ser capaz de reubicarte durante la duración de tu pasantía (las ubicaciones varían) 

Tener derecho legal a trabajar dentro del país en el que se está solicitando matrimonio sin patrocinio ni restricciones de tiempo  

Trabaje de una manera que funcione para usted 

Reconocemos que cada persona es diferente y que la forma en que las personas quieren trabajar y dar lo mejor de sí mismas es diferente para todos. En este rol, es posible que podamos ofrecer patrones de trabajo flexibles. Habla con nosotros sobre las opciones de trabajo que deseas cuando presentes tu solicitud. 

 

Trabajar con nosotros 

Trabajar en Baker Hughes significa estar a la vanguardia de la transición energética. Nuestra gente es diversa, ambiciosa y colaborativa. Tenemos la misión de redefinir el sector energético liberando el poder de la ingeniería, los datos y la ciencia.

title: Emerging Talent: Payroll Intern 2026 Opportunities (Budapest)
description:
Would you like the opportunity to work in a global energy company?

Do you enjoy taking on challenging projects?

Join our innovating Internship Program

The Baker Hughes Internship is designed to enable students either pursuing a Bachelors’ or Masters’ degree or recently graduated to gain hands-on work experience as the foundation of their professional lives. Our internships will give you first-hand insights into the processes, systems, and practices that are aligned to ensure customer needs are met through flawless execution and the application of leading-edge technology.

Partner with the best

You’ll participate in focused training, and team meetings, work on projects, and present your results. During your internship, you will be supported by a buddy and your manager who will ensure you have a valuable learning experience. You can expect to receive coaching and mentoring to enable you to complete assignments and projects to develop your learning and skillset.

You will also have the opportunity to become familiar with the Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) and culture of Baker Hughes. as well as our strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.

As an Intern, you will be responsible for:

Organizing and maintaining payroll files and documentation

Collecting and analyzing payroll-related data

Assisting in the creation and maintenance of a comprehensive payroll catalog

Supporting the development and documentation of the wage type catalog

Helping to create and regularly update process maps for payroll workflows

Acting as a key role between various departments, including Total Rewards, HR, Payroll, and Treasury

Taking a part in a pilot project to oversee the end-to-end payroll process for one specific country

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you should:

Be fluent in oral and written English and have effective communication skills
Be able to legally work in the country that you are applying in, without company sponsorship or time restriction
Be available to work a minimum of 24 hours per week
Be studying in a relevant field such as HR, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or Business development
Have an active student status with at least two years remaining in your studies
Be getting familiar with payroll processes and procedures
Be proficient in Excel, Visio, and other Microsoft Office applications

Desired skills:

· Strong team player with excellent collaboration skills

· Ability to work independently and manage tasks efficiently

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone. In this role, we may be able to offer flexible working patterns. Talk to us about your desired working options when you apply.

Working with us

Working at Baker Hughes means being at the forefront of the energy transition. Our people are diverse, ambitious, and collaborative. We're on a mission to redefine the energy sector by unlocking the power of engineering, data, and science.

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, were committed to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and were always looking for the right people to help us get there. People who are as passionate as we are about making energy safer, cleaner, and more efficient.

Join us

Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.

title: Usineur CN F/H
description:
Vous êtes à la recherche d'une opportunité intéressante et inspirante ?

Vous avez envie de faire partie d’une équipe performante ?

 

Rejoignez nos équipes

Baker Hughes est une entreprise internationale, présente dans plus de 120 pays. Nous développons et déployons les technologies les plus avancées pour servir les entreprises énergétiques et industrielles à la recherche de solutions plus efficaces, plus fiables et plus propres

 

Faites équipe avec les meilleurs

En tant qu'Usineur CN (F/H), vous serez chargé(e) de réaliser l’usinage de pièces de révolution sur tour parallèle et/ou vertical, et/ou CN, et d’appliquer les instructions de fabrication.

 

A ce titre, vous serez chargé(e) de :

Prérégler les outils de coupe en conformité avec les fiches d'instructions des Méthodes et/ou un plan d'après un plan, une gamme d’usinage établi par le Bureau Méthodes.
Réaliser l'usinage de diverses pièces, sur machines traditionnelles et/ou à Commande Numérique d’après le programme d’usinage établi par le bureau méthodes,
Réaliser la programmation en suivant les instructions sur gamme BM.
Réaliser et/ou modifier les programmes du bureau Méthodes si besoin.
En cas d'erreur, rechercher la cause du dysfonctionnement
Assurer le suivi de la maintenance premier niveau de la machine (fiches maintenance)
Assurer l'entretien préventif et le remplacement des éléments usés "courants" des outils et outillages mis à disposition du poste
Assurer la traçabilité des pièces et valider (visa + date) des gammes
Veiller au respect des temps gamme
Appliquer toutes les instructions ou modes opératoires liés à l’opération d’usinage (qualité, HSE, production)
Nettoyer votre machine, tenir votre poste propre et rangé
Surveiller le bon état de fonctionnement de votre machine et du banc de préréglage
Prévenir votre hiérarchie en cas de dysfonctionnement de la machine ou en cas de difficultés rencontrées
Réaliser la vérification de votre usinage et l’état globale de la pièce
Former les nouveaux arrivants (apprentis, stagiaires, nouveaux embauchés)
Peut être appelé(e) à participer à un groupe de travail et faire des propositions d’amélioration
Faciliter le déroulement des audits internes.
Analyser les documents associés à la pièce.
S’adapter aux aléas techniques du poste

 

Alimentez votre passion

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :

Être titulaire d’un diplôme technique spécialisé dans les métiers de l’usinage
Justifier d'une expérience significative sur une fonction similaire dans un environnement industriel exigeant, de préférence en rectification cylindrique.
Savoir lire une gamme d’usinage, un plan de pièce…
Savoir calculer / programmer les conditions de coupe pour sa machine
Savoir utiliser une Commande Numérique
Être rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et méthodique
Faire preuve d’autonomie et être en mesure de prendre des initiatives
Être curieux(se) et avoir un esprit d’analyse et de réflexion
Être en mesure de travailler en 3*8

 

Travaillez de la manière qui vous convient

Nous sommes conscients que chacun est différent et que la manière dont les gens veulent travailler et donner le meilleur d'eux-mêmes est également différente pour chacun. À ce titre, nous pouvons proposer les modèles de travail flexibles suivants :

Ce rôle est un modèle de travail en 3*8

 

Travailler avec nous

Notre personnel est au cœur de ce que nous faisons chez Baker Hughes. Nous savons que nous sommes meilleurs lorsque tous nos employés sont développés, engagés et capables de mettre toute leur authenticité au travail. Nous investissons dans la santé et le bien-être de notre personnel, formons et récompensons les talents et formons des leaders à tous les niveaux afin de faire ressortir le meilleur de chacun.

 

Nous travaillons pour vous

Nos inventions révolutionnent l'énergie depuis plus d'un siècle. Mais pour continuer à avancer demain, nous savons que nous devons repousser les limites dès aujourd'hui. Notre priorité est de récompenser ceux qui s'engagent dans le changement grâce à un package qui reflète à quel point nous apprécions leur contribution.

title: Quality Control Specialist
description:
Are you a hands-on Quality Inspector with experience in quality control and auditing?

Would you like to join a world class, multidisciplinary engineering team?

Join Our Subsea Production Team!

We devise smarter systems to control and monitor oil and gas extraction. Innovating in the energy industry, our subsea and surface pressure capabilities are industry leading. Our global team is responsible for the successful delivery of innovative product and system designs for our customers.

Partner with the best

The Quality Inspector will perform quality assurance activities as required by manufacturing/engineering specifications and ISO requirements. You will carry out product and process surveillance, including the liaison with manufacturing personnel to ensure that any problems identified and recorded are dealt with effectively. You will also Raise non-conformance records related to product build problems.

As a QC Inspector, you will be responsible for:

Carrying out specialist inspection techniques in accordance with build requirements to ensure Piece Part Acceptance.

Ensuring all aspects of production are carried out in accordance with company procedures relating to HSE and relevant quality Codes of Practice.

Ensuring Purchase Order documentation is correct and completed to date before, during and on completion of the build process.

Providing the verification and sign off of process generated documentation related to the manufacture of subsea controls and ancillary equipment

Ensuring safe working practices are adhered to at all times and general working order is maintained to a high standard

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

Have a background in Mechanical or Quality Engineering, ideally as an apprentice or with a relevant qualification plus industrial experience

Be a self-starter who is driven to learn and develop their skillset further

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

title: Commercial Proposals Specialist
description:
Would you like to contribute to the success of our commercial team?
 

Join the Team!
 

Baker Hughes’ high-performance gearbox solutions and services to solve the most complex power transmission challenges. Our gearboxes transmit power from engines, servos, motors, turbines, and compressors in mechanical drive, turbo, industrial, and marine propulsion applications around the world. Our products and services are known for dependability and high performance, boosting uptime, and improving reliability while driving down maintenance costs.
 

Partner with the best
 

The Commercial Proposals Specialist will be responsible for preparing proposals/bids, contract negotiation and compliance with contract commitments and commercial risk assessment.

As a Commercial Proposals Specialist, you will be responsible for:

Coordinating end-to-end proposal development by reviewing customer inquiries, analyzing technical specifications, selecting appropriate equipment, and generating tailored proposals.
Collaborating cross-functionally to secure internal approvals, negotiate contract terms, and ensure compliance with commercial and legal requirements.
Translating customer needs into actionable solutions, guiding the process from initial inquiry to final order approval.
Navigating complex sales cycles involving technical evaluation, contract negotiation, and procurement coordination to deliver customer-centric outcomes.
Managing relationships with strategically targeted clients to drive engagement and business growth.
Developing and executing tailored customer engagement strategies.

Fuel your passion
 

To be successful in this role you will:

Hold a Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline from an accredited university or college such as Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, or Industrial Engineering. Industrial Distribution or equivalent will also be considered.

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

title: Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Specialist
description:
Health and Safety (HSE) Specialist 

Do you enjoy being part of a successful team? 

Are you excited by the prospect of working for industry leader in Health and Safety? 

Innovate and shape our HSE strategy. 

The HSE Specialist offers expert knowledge and skills to generate and promote a positive health and safety culture. This represents a key role in helping control occupational risk on the rig. 

Partner with the best 

In this role, you will be ensuring the well-being of our workforce and compliance of HSE on-site. You will build relationships with cross-functional teams and customers to ensure requirements are met. You will provide solutions and help to develop your team and continuous improvement of our HSE. 

As a Health and Safety Specialist, you will be responsible for: 

Managing, applying and ensuring adherence with Aramco and Baker Hughes HSE policies and procedures, and assist the contracted services to comply with the same. 

Promoting, with the management, a safety culture within the workplace in accordance with the industry best practices 

Leading / participating effectively in the site various HSE meetings, present safety data and statistics, communicating HSE alerts and lessons learnt, and discussing issues related to HSE with the crew. 

Performing, verifying, and following up with site inspections to ensure compliance with internal and external HSE standards. 

Monitoring the work environment and watching out for the safety of all workers to protect them from entering hazardous situations. 

Reporting all incidents, accidents and near misses immediately and leading the investigation and analysis process. Compiling incidents reports and communicating the investigation results as required. 

Conducting site HSE inductions for all crew and visitors 

Ensuring all crew are certified as per Aramco and Baker Hughes training matrixes and conducting refresher training as required. 

Fuel your passion. 

To be successful in this role you will: 

Have a NEBOSH IGC certification  

Have 3 years’ experience in rig site  

Familiar with rig Aramco HSE requirements  

Have a good communication skills (Arabic & English)  

 

Work in a way that works for you. 

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. 

Working with us 

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other. 

Working for you 

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect: 

Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities 

Comprehensive private medical care options 

Safety net of life insurance and disability programs 

Tailored financial programs. 

Additional elected or voluntary benefits

description:

We devise smarter systems to control and monitor oil and gas extraction. Innovating in the energy industry, our subsea and surface pressure capabilities are industry-leading. Our team provides technical guidance, support and successful project deployment of customer projects, including, planning, testing, deployment and delivery of our cutting-edge, world-class surface wellhead products.

Take ownership for leading challenging projects
As an Engineer - Engineer to Order (ETO), you will create the final Surface Wellhead and Tree as well as Test Fixtures engineering design from conceptual/proposal design approved by customer. You will be collaborating across multiple teams globally to assure requirements are captured in drawings and the design is finalized on time.

As an Engineer – ETO – Product Design and Engineering, you will be responsible for:

Developing Surface Wellhead and Tree final engineering design which fit the needs of the client while emphasizing proven technologies and existing solutions.
Generating designs, machine detail drawings, stack up drawings, Bill of Material, calculations, engineering part information, and Field Service Manual, to meet customer requirements and industry standard (API6A), with guidance from senior engineering resources.
Ensuring Engineering deliverables are completed within the agreed timeline.
Designing test fixtures for pressure/load test following company standards.
Performing Technical Publishing activity related to Field Service Manuals.
Involved in analytical and design activities using proven technologies and vested approaches and methods.
Employing the best combination of all preliminary information and contributing data to develop final design.

Fuel your passion

Have a bachelor’s degree in engineering preferably Mechanical/Industrial/Petroleum.
Have a minimum of 3 years of experience in Design Engineering.
Be Familiar with applying knowledge from Industry standards (ASME, ASTM, ISO, API, .) when designing product
Have a minimum of 3 years of experience with 3D models and 2D machine detail drawings using CAD software.
Have good oral and written communication skills.
Have good interpersonal and leadership skills.

title: Ausbildung Mechatroniker (d/m/w)
description:
Job Description

Bist Du auf der Suche nach einer Ausbildung in einem innovativen und abwechslungsreichen Umfeld?

Hast du Spaß an der Instandhaltung von (elektro-)pneumatischen und elektronischen Anlagen?

Werde Teil unseres erfolgreichen Teams

Wir suchen zum 1. August 2026 einen engagierten und motivierten Auszubildenden zum Mechatroniker (d/w/m) für unseren Standort in Celle.

Die jahrelangen Erfahrungen im Bereich der Ausbildung und die hochqualifizierten Ausbilder:in sind ein Garant für das erfolgreiche Erreichen des Ausbildungsziels. Wir können auf mittlerweile stolze 17 Jahre zurückblicken, in denen Baker Hughes in jedem Jahr bei den Besten Ehrungen der IHK mit seinen verschiedenen Berufen vertreten war. Bereits 5 Bundesbeste kamen aus unserem Hause. Solche Erfolge können nur wenige andere Betriebe in Deutschland verzeichnen. Die Ausbildung findet sowohl in der Ausbildungswerkstatt als auch innerbetrieblich statt.

Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten für diesen Beruf sind: Techniker (d/w/m), Ingenieur (d/w/m), Meister (d/w/m)

Während der 3 ½ Jährigen Ausbildung zum Mechatroniker (d/f/m) lernst du alles, um in den folgenden Bereichen erfolgreich zu sein:​

Inbetriebnahme, Einstellung, Wartung, Demontage und Montage von industriellen Maschinen und Anlagen

Entwicklung von Lösungswegen in verschiedensten Aufgabengebieten, die die Tätigkeiten der Materialbearbeitung, Messen und Prüfen, Pneumatik und Hydraulik, additive Fertigung sowie EDV-Wissen erfordern

Instandhaltung von (elektro-)pneumatischen und elektronischen Anlagen

Unsere Mitarbeiter stehen im Mittelpunkt unserer Arbeit bei Baker Hughes. Wir wissen, dass wir besser sind, wenn alle unsere Mitarbeiter entwickelt, engagiert und in der Lage sind, ihr ganzes authentisches Selbst zur Arbeit zu bringen. title: Field Engineer - Summer Internship (Tallmadge, OH) 2026 Opportunities
description:
University Internships: Field Engineering – 2026 opportunities

Would you like the opportunity to work in a global energy company?

Do you enjoy taking on challenging projects?

Join our innovative Internship Program

The Baker Hughes Internship is designed to enable students pursuing a Bachelors’ or Masters’ degree to gain hands-on work experience as the foundation of their professional lives. Our internships will give you first-hand insights into the processes, systems, and practices that are aligned to ensure customer needs are met through flawless execution and the application of leading-edge technology.

Partner with the best

You’ll participate in focused training, and team meetings, work on projects, and present your results. During your internship, you will be supported by a buddy and your manager who will ensure you have a valuable learning experience. You can expect to receive coaching and mentoring to enable you to complete assignments and projects to develop your learning and skillset.

You will also have the opportunity to become familiar with the Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) and culture of Baker Hughes. as well as our strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.

The internship duration is a 12 – weeks starting May 2026 – August 2026.

As a Field Engineer Intern, you will be responsible for:

Completing internal projects to deliver customer outcomes and identify business improvements
Collaborating alongside experienced engineers to assist in various field operations, such as drilling, well testing, or equipment maintenance.
Collecting data from field activities and assist in analyzing it to identify trends or issues and troubleshooting through problem-solving tasks related to field operations and equipment.
Inspecting and maintaining equipment to ensure it is in proper working order.
Keeping detailed records and documentation of field activities, equipment inspections, and safety measures is essential for compliance and future reference.
Applying Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) standards and procedures in all situations to ensure compliance is maintained.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

Be currently enrolled in a Bachelors’ or Masters’ level degree in Engineering, Technology, Mechanics, other STEM-related program.
Have maintained a GPA grade greater than or equal to 2.75 out of 4.0 or the equivalent in your country
Be fluent in oral and written English and have effective communication skills
Be able to relocate for the duration of your internship (locations vary)
Applicant must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or temporary resident, and will not need employment sponsorship now or in the future

The hourly rate range for this position is $22-$44

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone. In this role, we may be able to offer flexible working patterns. Talk to us about your desired working options when you apply.

Working with us

Working at Baker Hughes means being at the forefront of the energy transition. Our people are diverse, ambitious, and collaborative. We're on a mission to redefine the energy sector by unlocking the power of engineering, data, and science.

title: Estágio em Gerenciamento de Projetos - Campinas
description:
Você gostaria da oportunidade de estagiar em uma empresa Global de Energia e Tecnologia?  

Você gosta de embarcar em projetos desafiadores? 

Venha fazer parte do nosso Programa de Estágio! 

 

O nosso Estágio é pensado para permitir que estudantes de Nível Superior tenham a oportunidade de ter experiências práticas de trabalho formando uma base sólida para suas vidas profissionais. Nossos estágios lhe darão percepções de primeira mão sobre os processos, sistemas e práticas que estão alinhados para garantir que as necessidades do cliente sejam atendidas por meio de execução impecável e aplicação de tecnologia de ponta. 

Esteja ao lado dos melhores 

Nosso Estágio vai te proporcionar a oportunidade de participar em Treinamentos técnicos e de desenvolvimento, reuniões de equipe e participar de projetos para apresentar seus resultados! Durante seu estágio, você terá todo suporte da equipe, gestão e um Buddy designado especialmente para suas necessidades, garantindo que você tenha uma experiência de aprendizado valiosa!  

 

Como estagiário, você será responsável por: 

Receber treinamento e mentoria, que permitirão que você complete suas tarefas e projetos que aperfeiçoarão seu aprendizado e habilidades;  

Engajar, conhecer e aprender sobre sua área designada, mas não limitando-se à;  

Participar e Entregar projetos internos para entregar resultados aos clientes (internos e externos) e identificar oportunidades de melhorias no negócio e área 

Aprender o Sistema Operacional interno (incluindo softwares e aplicativos) que te ajudarão no processo de desenvolver e entregar seus projetos e tarefas diárias 

Colaborar e Conectar com diferentes times, estagiários e áreas da Baker Hughes para ter um amplo conhecimento e rede de networking global 

Aplicar os conceitos de HSE (Saúde, Segurança e Meio-Ambiente) garantindo e mantendo os procedimentos em todas as situações para um ambiente mais seguro, íntegro e saudável. 

Participar e Engajar em grupos de integração para estagiários e outros Hubs de voluntariado, Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão que alavancarão seu networking e desenvolvimentos de habilidades por todo o Globo. 

 

Alimente sua paixão: 

Para ter sucesso e ser considerado no nosso estágio, você precisa: 

Estar regularmente matriculado em cursos de: Administração ou Sistemas da Informação;

Possuir Inglês de nível Intermediário para Avançado; 

Ter disponibilidade para estagiar pelo período de 02 anos, 30h por semana; 

Possuir o direito de estagiar legalmente no Brasil; 

 

Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação: 

Dentro da Baker Hughes temos diversas áreas de oportunidade para estagiar, então confira abaixo mais detalhes para a área de: 

 

Gestão de Projetos: O estagiário da área de Gestão de Projetos terá diferentes oportunidades de explorar seus conhecimentos dentro da área que for designado, e você pode conferir abaixo quais são as possíveis áreas de atuação na Baker Hughes: 

 

Gestão de Projetos: O Estagiário do time de Gerenciamento de Projetos possui função chave na execução do projeto, pois é responsável pelo entendimento do short plan com o Project Planner e garantir que as atividades planejadas do departamento de Engenharia, Planejamento, Manufatura, Montagem & Testes, Qualidade e Logística ocorram dentro das datas planejadas. Tais interações ajudam no desenvolvimento do estagiários nas rotinas de cada departamento, sendo um forte treinamento para que o mesmo desenvolva senso crítico em cada etapa do projeto. 

Aftermarket: Auxiliar na coordenação das atividades de serviços de pós-venda, para assegurar progressos nos projetos programados. Auxiliar na preparação de relatórios de projetos para a gerência, clientes ou outros. Auxiliar na elaboração de procedimentos, na logística de materiais, na preparação das requisições e nos embarques de material. Auxiliar, também, no acompanhamento junto ao cliente e ao financeiro o recebimento dos pagamentos agendados. 

Engenharia de Projetos: O estagiário trabalhará em assuntos relacionados à novos contratos/projetos do setor, devendo realizar análises críticas de documentações técnicas e minutas, elaborar documentações técnicas, organizar as informações recebidas/atualizadas, analisar/levantar soluções, possíveis riscos ou possíveis gaps técnicos, além de levantar custos relacionados às soluções. Este escopo demanda de um perfil comunicativo, analítico e organizado. 

 

Localização 

Confira a localização da vaga no momento da sua candidatura, já que temos diferentes escritórios espalhados entre as cidades do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo e Bahia. 

 

Formas de Trabalho 

Nós sabemos que todos são diferentes e que a maneira de trabalhar e entregar resultados no seu melhor é diferente para cada um. Na Baker Hughes, temos diferentes ambientes de trabalho, que dependem da localização e área de atuação. Sendo um estágio, os Modelos Presencial e Híbrido são as melhores opções, focando em um desenvolvimento mais amplo, diverso e rodeado de oportunidades para Networking. 

 

Working with us 

Working at Baker Hughes means being at the forefront of the energy transition. Our people are diverse, ambitious and collaborative. We’re on a mission to redefine the energy sector by unlocking the power of engineering, data and science.

description:
Vous êtes à la recherche d'une opportunité intéressante et inspirante ?
Vous avez envie de faire partie d’une équipe performante ?

Rejoignez nos équipes

Chez Thermodyn, filiale du groupe Baker Hughes, basée au Creusot en Bourgogne (71), nous concevons et fabriquons des machines tournantes pour l’industrie de l’énergie. Nous innovons pour rendre l’énergie plus sûre, plus propre et plus efficace pour les personnes et la planète. Nous sommes leader mondial pour la compression intégrée, sans rejet de gaz et nous utilisons les dernières technologies à la pointe (paliers magnétiques, moteur à grande vitesse). Nous servons aussi notre flotte historique qui intègre différents types de compresseurs centrifuges, compresseurs alternatifs et turbines à vapeur

Collaborez avec les meilleur(e)s

Vous serez intégré(e) au sein de l'équipe de support technique rattachée à la fonction Engineering au service de la flotte Thermodyn (plus de 1000 compresseurs à gaz et turbines à vapeur dans le monde entier, fabricant depuis plus de 100 ans). Le poste est sédentaire avec éventuellement des missions ponctuelles sur sites client.

Dans le cadre de ces activités autour de la compression industrielle, Thermodyn utilise très fréquemment des ensembles moteur/variateur de vitesse électronique moyenne tension, d’une puissance de 500 kW à 20 MW, pour la réalisation des projets pour ses clients. Thermodyn a en outre une ligne de produit moto-compresseur grande vitesse, basée sur des moteurs haute vitesse à attaque directe et des variateurs pilotant des fréquences de sortie jusqu’à 300-400 Hz

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) Support Technique sites Clients (expertise moteurs électriques et variateurs) (F/H), vous serez responsable de :

Répondre techniquement aux équipes chantier (superviseurs mécanicien et/ou ingénieurs de démarrage) et aux clients opérateurs des machines Thermodyn pour tous les domaines liés aux turbomachines en s’appuyant éventuellement sur les experts des bureaux d’études.

Anticiper le support : préparer la mise en service des unités et les maintenances de façon proactive.

Assurer le suivi de paramètres, assistance et tests à distance pour la flotte connectée.

Coordonner les investigations techniques complexe (pilotage d’analyse des causes racines)

Participer activement aux tâches d'amélioration continue et de qualité (création/amélioration de la documentation de chantier et manuel, mise à jour de la documentation après mise en service).

Se développer pour enrichir son expertise avec de nouvelles techniques, méthodes ou savoir-faire.

Alimentez votre passion

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :

Être titulaire d'un Diplôme d’Ingénieur généraliste (ou équivalent) ou à dominante Electrique / Électrotechnique

Justifier d'une expérience significative en industrie dans le domaine de l’électrotechnique, l’électronique de puissance et des variateurs de vitesse industriels

Démontrer un engagement pour l’excellence opérationnelle, la qualité et l’intégrité

Faire preuve d’une grande curiosité technique et d’une ouverture a l’innovation

Posséder de solides aptitudes interpersonnelles et de leadership (aptitude à guider et influencer les autres)

Avoir a minima un niveau professionnel en anglais (lire, écrire, parler) avec une bonne maîtrise des termes techniques est indispensable

Posséder un esprit d’analyse et de synthèse

Travaillez de la manière qui vous convient

Nous sommes conscients que tout le monde est différent et que la manière dont chacun souhaite travailler et donner le meilleur d'lui-même est également différente pour chacun. Dans le cadre de ce rôle, nous pouvons proposer les modèles de travail flexibles suivants :

·       Horaires de travail flexibles : adaptez les heures de travail de la journée pour vous aider à tout intégrer et à travailler au moment où vous êtes le plus productif

Travailler avec nous

Nos collaborateurs(trice)s sont au cœur de ce que nous faisons chez Baker Hughes. Nous savons que nous sommes meilleur(e)s lorsque tou(te)s sont engagé(e)s et capables d'apporter leur véritable identité au travail. Nous investissons dans la santé et le bien-être de notre personnel, formons et récompensons les talents et formons des leaders à tous les niveaux pour faire ressortir le meilleur de chacun(e).

Nous travaillons pour vous

Nos inventions révolutionnent l'énergie depuis plus d'un siècle. Mais pour continuer demain, nous savons que nous devons repousser les limites aujourd'hui. Nous accordons la priorité à récompenser celles et ceux qui adoptent le changement avec un ensemble qui reflète à quel point nous apprécions leur contribution.

title: Ausbildung Mechatroniker (d/w/m)
description:
Tritt unserem erfolgreichen Team bei 

 

Als weltweit führender Anbieter von zerstörungsfreien Prüfungen (ZfP) bietet Waygate Technologies das breiteste Portfolio an industriellen Inspektionslösungen. Unsere Lösungen umfassen Radiographie und Computertomographie (CT), visuelle Ferninspektion, Ultraschall und Wirbelstromtechnologien. Wir gewährleisten Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität für unsere Kunden in wichtigen Branchen auf der ganzen Welt. 

 

Arbeite mit den Besten zusammen 

Wir suchen zum 01. August 2026 für unseren Standort in Wunstorf einen Mechatroniker (d/m/w/) 

Wähle einen Ausbildungsberuf nach deinem persönlichem Interesse. Mit dieser Ausbildung wählst du einen Beruf für die Zukunft. Die Zukunft mit uns. 

 

Während der Ausbildung 

Das lernst du in der Mechatroniker Ausbildung bei uns: 

Bearbeitung von verschiedenen Werkstoffen und Maschinenteile manuell sowie maschinell 

Messung und Prüfung von Werkstücken 

Erstellung und lesen von technischen Zeichnungen/Schaltplänen, sowie Arbeitsabläufe planen 

Installation von elektrische Baugruppen und Komponenten 

Planung und Aufbau von elektrischen und pneumatischen Steuerungen sowie Inbetriebnahme und Dokumentation 

Verknüpfung, Montierung und Programmierung von elektrischen, mechanischen und pneumatischen Bauteilen. 

Installierung und Testung von Hardware- und Softwarekomponenten 

Fehlerursachen und Qualitätsmängel feststellen, beheben und optimieren 

 

Folge deiner Leidenschaft 

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein: 

Bringst du einen erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Sekundarabschluss 1 mit 

Verfügst Du über gute Leistungen in Mathematik und Physik 

Zeichnet Dich Interesse an Technik aus 

Besitzt Du gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen 

Bringst Du englische Grundsprachkenntnisse mit 

 

Mit uns arbeiten 

Unsere Mitarbeiter stehen im Mittelpunkt unserer Arbeit bei Baker Hughes. Wir wissen, dass wir besser sind, wenn alle unsere Mitarbeiter entwickelt, engagiert und in der Lage sind, ihr ganzes authentisches Selbst zur Arbeit zu bringen. Wir investieren in die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden unserer Mitarbeiter, bilden Talente aus und belohnen sie und entwickeln Führungskräfte auf allen Ebenen, um das Beste auseinander herauszuholen. 

Unsere Erfindungen haben die Energie seit über einem Jahrhundert revolutioniert. Aber um morgen weiterzumachen, wissen wir, dass wir heute die Grenzen verschieben müssen. Wir legen großen Wert darauf, diejenigen, die sich der Herausforderung stellen, mit einem Paket zu belohnen, das widerspiegelt, wie sehr wir ihren Beitrag schätzen. 

Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Qualifikation bevorzugt berücksichtigt. 

 

Die guten Dinge 

Folgende Benefits erwarten dich bei uns: 

Zeitgemäße Work-Life-Balance-Richtlinien und Aktivitäten zum Wohlbefinden 

Attraktive Vergütung 

30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr und am 24.12. und 31.12. bezahlt frei 

Wöchentliche Arbeitszeit von 37h/Woche 

Unterstützung bei angestrebtem Fachabitur 

Angestrebte Übernahme 

Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld sowie eine variable Bonuszahlung im Jahr 

Kostenerstattung für Prüfungsvorbereitungskurse, Schulbücher und ÖPNV-Monatskarten 

Fitnesszuschuss 

Du gestaltest die Ausbildung mit! 

 

Weitere Bildungsmöglichkeiten

title: Marine Section Leader
description:
Responsible for the operational safety and efficiency of marine systems on board the drilling unit. Provide supervision and monitoring for MODU stability and ballasting systems during rig moving and stationary drilling operations and maintain the MODU within Noble programs, policies and procedures. Functions as Deck Officer on location and supervises all cargo transfers, ballasting adjustments, and loading compensation. Responsible for operation, maintenance and repair of all MODU marine and safety related systems. Implements and upholds safety and environmental compliance requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

High School Diploma or equivalent.
2+ years of experience in operation and management of offshore marine systems, including jacking systems, anchoring, mooring, ship handling, basic seamanship, damage control equipment and procedures, and environmental safety.
USCG MODU Barge Supervisor License or equivalent.
Complete all training requirements for the position within designated time period.
Experience in department management, scheduling, inventory control and budgeting.
Offshore technical background including stability, fluid dynamics and loading.
Experience in cargo operations and effects on vessel ballast and loading.
Experience in managing personnel.
Experience in rig towing and movement operations.
Knowledge of ocean weather and sea state conditions affecting rig operations.
Knowledge of all regulations and laws as related to offshore drilling operations in the area of operations.
Excellent leadership, communication and management skills.
Proficient computer skills in office software and company proprietary software.
Experience in marine environmental and hazardous material regulations and procedures.
Ability to handle multiple tasks on a daily basis and to follow-up on all tasking to completion.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

         OPERATIONS

Plan, organize, coordinate and control marine and barge maintenance operations.
Ensure rig in compliance with all state, federal, and international laws and regulations.
Supervise and monitor rig stability and ballasting systems during rig movement and placement operations.
Prepare and/or secure the unit for towing operations and performs all Variable Deck Load (VDL), ballasting/preloading operations when required at location.
Calculate and document all stability and load calculations before, during, and after rig moving operations.
Assist in the rig’s jacking system maintenance and operation. Must ensure all equipment is operated as required my manufacturer and Noble Standards.
Provide technical support and assist the operations as necessary during casing jobs, cementing, transferring of bulk materials, etc., to ensure these operations are carried out in a continuous uninterrupted manner.
Monitor daily weather information at the rig site for wind direction, wind speed, visibility, and sea state.
Maintain all rig damage control equipment at proper inventory levels and in working order.
Supervise all cargo transfers, rig ballast/preloading adjustments and VDL loading compensation.
Supervise the Crane Operator and Roustabouts, painters and miscellaneous maintenance crew.
Ensure deck crew is maintaining the rig in proper state of repair and preservation, keeping the deck clean, orderly, and having equipment prepared for drilling.
Coordinate with the Driller to organize and plan all deck operations to ensure drilling operations are not delayed by material and equipment requirements.
Coordinate stowage of drilling equipment in proper locations consistent with ongoing drilling operations to ensure personnel safety and prevent equipment damage.
Supervise the deck crew during cargo operations to ensure personnel and equipment safety.
Supervise all connections when transferring bulk fluids from or to supply boats.
Supervise safe tank entry procedures ensuring 100% compliance.
As HLO (Helicopter Landing Officer), supervise crew change by boat or by helicopter. Must coordinate all activity on the helideck.
Ensure complete compliance with the Engineering Requirements established in Section VIII of the Environmental Compliance Plan (“ECP”) (as applicable to his/her MODU), if applicable.
Measure, monitor and manage shipboard machinery space generated wastes and the conditions of any equipment having oil to sea interfaces on a daily basis.
Timely resolve (through repairs and/or applicable EMS procedure) engine room, machinery space, drill floor, or pump room related environmental concerns, such as inoperative or ineffective pollution prevention equipment, waste handling or monitoring equipment, leakages (except those necessary for packing cooling) stemming from pump seals, packing glands or line breaks, or due to any other causes contributing to the accumulations of bilge fluids, oily mixtures and sludge type wastes.
Ensure that all Engine Room, Machinery Space and Drill Floor wastes that are subject to special handling requirements are properly managed.
Ensure that the Chief Engineer’s and Chief Mate’s handover notes shall include an environmental component and description of the current status of operation, maintenance, and repair, for the Incinerator, Oily Water Separator, Oil Content Meter, Oil Discharge Monitor, and other pollution prevention procedures or equipment for which they are responsible, the status of spare parts for the aforementioned equipment, and an estimation of the day-to- day bilge loads and accumulations. If a company-specified format for handover notes is used, this shall require descriptive entries as stated above, not solely answers marked as “Yes” or “No”.
Ensure that all Ballast Logs, Deck Logs and Engine Room records, soundings and tank measurements are accurate and recorded truthfully.
Report to the HSE all instances of excessive waste stream development.

         MAINTENANCE & REPAIR

Supervise and assist in the maintenance, function testing and/or repairs of all aspects of the units ballasting/preloading and/or related rig systems and controls to ensure that the unit is maintained in an operable state at all times.
Ensure the availability, proper functioning, general maintenance and/or the recommended quantity of the unit’s safety systems and equipment at all times.
Supervise maintenance on all tanks, e.g. water, cement, ballast and mud.
Supervise and assist in all preventative maintenance on damage control equipment.
Supervise all preservation and repair work to the vessel hull and marine systems.
Ensure that all shipboard engine room personnel have appropriate training on environmental policies and procedures, including but not limited to training on the operation and use of pollution prevention equipment, waste-water storage tanks, bilge pumps, bilge and ballast pumps, incinerator, ballast tanks, Oil Water Separator and the making of entries in the Oil Record Books, Garbage Record Book, Ballast Logs, or any other records and logs required by this ECP or other maritime environmental protection requirements.

         MANAGEMENT

Attend daily staff meetings with all department heads to plan daily operations, take requests, and get equipment and crew organized.
Complete daily report on weather, balance of stock/inventory on board and tank loads.
Calculate, evaluate, and record and/or report daily or as often as necessary the changing VDL load conditions to ensure that the unit’s design criteria is maintained within the load limits in either the operating, survival or floating condition.
Complete the proper documentation to dispose of waste materials, and monitor hazardous material and waste stowage on the rig.

title: International Tax Manager
description:
Noble is hiring for a International Tax Manager to work out of our corporate office in Houston, while working a hybrid work schedule. Noble is a leading offshore drilling contractor. We own and operate one of the most modern and technically advanced fleets. Noble has been engaged in the contract drilling of oil and gas wells since 1921. Noble performs, through its subsidiaries, contract drilling services with a fleet of offshore drilling units focused largely on ultra-deepwater and high specification jack-up drilling opportunities in both established and emerging regions worldwide. Our vision is to be the leading offshore driller by being first choice for employees, customers, and investors. Our mission is drilling to power the world responsibly. This role is responsible for overseeing international income tax provisions in compliance with ASC 740, ensuring accurate host-country tax filings, and driving strategic tax planning initiatives. You will lead tax audit management and design robust internal processes to mitigate tax risks, positioning the organization for global compliance and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Review quarterly and annual foreign countries’ income tax accruals in accordance with ASC 740 and present any relevant observations to the Tax Director and/or the Vice President of Tax.
Work closely with Region Controllers and other departments (Accounting, Marketing, Operations, Treasury, and Legal) on any issues that may have a material tax impact.

title: Manager, Maintenance Process & Solution
description:
Job Requirements:

Manage and support Noble’s Asset Integrity program to ensure the safety, reliability, and efficiency of all offshore and onshore rigs and equipment, in order to support Noble’s operations in the oil and gas industry.

Oversee current usage, future development continuous improvement projects and systems checks of Noble’s Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS), IFS, and associated business processes.

Establish and monitor the Company’s Corporate and Department annual goals.

Responsible for the global CMMS and associated processes within the Asset Integrity Department as appointed by the Business Process Owner (BPO), Senior Manager, Maintenance Process and Solutions.

Serve as the Business Process Expert (BPE) and Business Document Owner (BDO) for relevant documentation related to Noble CMMS and associated business processes.

Ensure that Asset Integrity processes in the Management system (P2R/SIRIUS), are kept updated.

Ensure ongoing optimization of Asset Integrity processes as well as the CMMS solutions to support business goals and to gain the best business value overall.

Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts to ensure that detailed maintenance of Equipment is governed according to company processes and solutions.

Develop Power BI/KPI reports monitoring Asset Integrity performance and Asset Integrity process compliance.

Ensure training material in processes and solutions within Asset Integrity is available and updated.

Ensure that training in processes and solutions within Asset Integrity is provided to employees according to business needs.

Responsible for exploiting CMMS system and other systems supporting business needs with Maintenance and Asset Integrity, including enabling mobile solutions.

Secure collaboration with other business process areas, always striving for well-integrated and uniform solutions across.

Keep process and systems knowledge up to date to include in innovative solutions and system capabilities supporting business processes as per best business practice.

Update policies, procedures, audits, etc. associated with Noble’s Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and five (5) years of experience in technical maintenance and asset integrity with an international operating Oil & Gas Drilling Contractor with offshore vessels, including experience managing subordinates

Experience using industrial Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) as well as Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Systems

Experience applying applicable industry and regulatory codes, standards, and recommended practices (API, IADC, NORSOK, CFR, etc)

Knowledge of maintenance strategies and planning as well as experience in applying these on a large scale within a CMMS

Experience with use of Microsoft applications and applicable software programs.

Alternate Requirements

Seven (7) years of experience in technical maintenance and asset integrity with an international operating Oil & Gas Drilling Contractor with offshore vessels, including experience managing subordinates

Experience using industrial Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) as well as Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Systems

Experience applying applicable industry and regulatory codes, standards, and recommended practices (API, IADC, NORSOK, CFR, etc)

Knowledge of maintenance strategies and planning as well as experience in applying these on a large scale within a CMMS

Experience with use of Microsoft applications and applicable software programs.

Travel Requirements: 

Up to 10% domestic and international travel required, including offshore.

title: Technical Superintendent – Electrical Marine Systems
description:
Provide direct supervision and technical expertise relating to maintenance and repair work performed on rig electrical equipment and control systems. Review maintenance tasks and schedules within the Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) SAP/AMPS to ensure that the equipment functionality, reliability, availability and performance are optimized. Advise rig and regional personnel on troubleshooting, maintenance and repair of rig electrical systems to maximize uptime. Develop and distribute repair standards for electrical equipment, assist in developing Noble Standards for repair and replacement of equipment. Review and update Master Data Change Request (MDCR) and alerts and bulletins.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS 

Provide immediate trouble shooting assistance via phone, internet, web-based applications until the support team arrives on site or the issue is resolved.
Provide technical assistance and troubleshooting of Automation, Navigation, Power & DP Systems for floater and jack-up fleet.
Review SAP / IFS (CMMS) maintenance tasks & update where required.
Demonstrate the ability to effectively use a root cause analysis program/protocol such as Taproot, 5 Why, Cause Mapping, Fishbone, etc.
Lead and/or participate in Root Cause investigations and prepare reports and action items from the findings.
Review alerts and bulletins (TAB); prepare recommendations for the fleet and assist with the distribution across the fleet.
Provide direct and indirect supervision and technical expertise to rigs and regional maintenance teams for technical, maintenance, repair and installation activities. .
Assist with technical support through review of technical drawings and documentation, witnessing Factory Acceptance Testing, and Vendor Quality / Technical Capability Audits.
Visit Noble rigs and audit quality and methods of maintenance being performed and provide formal reports to management.
Provide technical consultation for rig shipyard / upgrade projects, marine system start-up / commissioning and service agreement as required.
Meet with outside vendors to investigate failures, research upgrades, develop repair and maintenance procedures/protocols
Keep abreast of equipment costs and obtain equipment quotes as required.
Leads marine electrical technical support in the absence of the manager.
Interface with all departments in the performance of job functions and assist as directed.
Other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS 

Bachelor’s degree in electronic / electrical engineering from a recognized University or institution with 10+ years plus of experience in a technical support function.
As an alternative, an Electrical or Electronics Technician Trade School Diploma with 15 years progressive experience and responsibility in electronic / electrical control, networks and instrumentation systems specific to DP (Dynamic Positioning), power generation, power distribution, power electronics, power management system and marine operations.
10+ years’ experience with DP2 and 3 rig control systems specific to DP FMEA and Kongsberg or GE power management system with 11KV split and/or closed bus operations.
Working knowledge of computer networks and network components used in control systems, Vessel Management, Fire and Gas detection and alarm, and UPS systems.
Knowledge and experience with electrical equipment in hazardous areas and regulation IEC, IEEE, API etc.
Familiar with electrical engineering and installation standards including IEC, IEEE, API, IMO MODU, SOLAS, and class regulations (ABS, DNV).
Good understanding and working knowledge of API requirements and recommended practices for drilling units as applicable to electrical, electronic, electro-hydraulic control systems.
Good understanding of commonly used condition monitoring techniques (CMS / CBM) such as: thermographic, ultrasound and vibration analysis.
Participate in Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), vendor site visits & evaluations, and equipment construction and repair surveillance as directed.
Experience with installation, start-up, and upgrade of Electrical / Electronic systems for the entire vessel. The project experience in a closed bus system design / implementation is preferred.
Good knowledge and understanding of Reliability, Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), Predictive and Preventive Maintenance, and Condition-based Maintenance; CMRP/SMRP preferred.
Fully acquainted with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS); IFS preferred.
Experience in a supervisory role directing maintenance personnel and support organization a plus as Chief technical supervisor lever or above.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and other appropriate software.
Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Demonstrate the ability to use common test equipment, hand tools, and safety equipment.
Travel is an essential job function (est. 35%, domestic, international and offshore); expectations can be up to 40 days on location on a 12/7 schedule while deployed.

title: Engine Roon Responsible
description:
Serves primarily as an engine room watch stander. Works under the direction of the Maintenance Engineer in regard to the maintenance department to ensure that operation of all mechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic equipment, machinery and propulsion plan, as well as all other controlling systems and equipment on the vessel are maintained to the highest level of operational standards.
Responsible for implementing and upholding safety and environmental compliance requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

6+ months of experience as a 3rd Engineer or Oiler, maintenance experience in an offshore drilling operation preferred.
Valid Unlimited 3rd/Assistant Engineer Steam, Gas Turbine, or Diesel national license, if applicable.
Completion of all training requirements for the position within designated time period.
Experience reading and interpreting electrical and mechanical drawings.
Strong experience with pneumatic and hydraulic systems is required.
Must have basic Preventive Maintenance Systems knowledge.
Must have strong experience with mechanical and electrical systems and equipment.
Complete understanding and use of the Noble Maintenance System.
Must be able to work without constant supervision.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Ensure through observation, records and inspections, that all mechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic equipment and systems meet regulatory as well as Noble’s requirements.
Ensure all mechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic maintenance is performed in accordance with Noble’s Maintenance System, equipment manufacturer’s recommendations, the Vessel Operating Manual and regulatory requirements and codes.
Monitor or perform repairs. Repair and rebuild mechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic systems and equipment, ensuring they are performing properly, safely and economically.
Oversee modifications to mechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic systems and equipment as directed by the 2nd Engineer.
Maintain updated vessel drawings.
Perform troubleshooting and repair of equipment.
Perform daily visual inspections of equipment and diagnose actual and potential malfunctions, ensuring potential hazards and abnormal operating conditions are addressed quickly and that any deteriorating conditions are reported.
Initiate analysis and identify the root cause of failures on the vessel’s mechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic equipment and systems.
Ensure logs, preventive maintenance records, and documentation for general maintenance, operation and repairs.
Monitor equipment logs, ensuring operating and maintenance standards are maintained.
Make recommendations on repair priorities.
Implement the Preventive Maintenance System for the mechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic equipment. Maintain PMS records, ensuring the quality and timeliness of preventive maintenance.
Review and report discrepancies in equipment and spare parts inventories, ensuring adequate and accurate inventory. Investigate and resolve discrepancies as necessary.
Requisition spare parts, tools and materials for mechanical, pneumatic and hydraulic equipment repairs.
Maintain test records, calibrating combustion control.
Direct the activities of unlicensed engineering personnel.
Ensure conformance to Company policies, local and international regulations relating to the operation of the rig, and current pollution regulations.
Perform daily inspections and maintenance on mechanical equipment.
Ensure that reports for repair and maintenance of equipment are accurate and complete.
Aboard Diesel or Gas Turbine vessels, responsible for the proper operation, maintenance, and repair of auxiliary boilers and appurtenances, propulsion and auxiliary diesel engines, and auxiliary system machinery and equipment. Also responsible for the operation and condition of the fuel oil system, including transfer pumps, strainers, heaters, heating coils and storage tanks.
Assist with maintenance and repair of power plants, cooling water system, lube oil system, and fuel system.

Ensure that service, maintenance and other operational reports are accurate and complete.
Inform supervisor and other department heads of any technical problems or limitations that may affect the safe operation of the rig.
Carry out classification society surveys as part of continuous survey of machinery.
Manage the cooling water treatment of main propulsion engines and auxiliary generators and any other water-cooled engineering systems.
Manage potable water, testing and treatment, storage of bulk lube oil and performs routine testing of lube oils in various engineering systems.
Perform machinery overhauls, dismantle machinery and equipment, effect repairs to same by replacing or fabricating components, perform subsequent reassembles, operational testing of controls, safeties, shutdowns, and place equipment in service.
Ensure that all personnel assigned to watch are aware of their duties during scheduled drills and participate in same.
Monitor power plants controls and power distribution; ensure that power is available at all times.
Operate, maintain and repair as necessary the engine cooling water system, lube oil system, and fuel system.
Operate and maintain oily water separators and water makers.
Operate and maintain Sewage Treatment Plan.
Other duties as assigned.

title: Assistant Rig Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY
The Assistant Rig Manager supports the Rig Manager by providing drilling expertise and leadership to ensure rig operations are carried out safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with contractual and operator requirements. This role involves daily collaboration with offshore leadership, operator representatives, and onshore support teams to deliver operational excellence.
At Noble, our core values—Honesty and Integrity, Safety, Environmental Stewardship, Respect, and Performance—guide every decision. In this position, you will champion these values by fostering a strong safety culture, promoting environmental responsibility, and driving performance through teamwork and respect.

QUALIFICATIONS

5+ years of offshore experience.
Effective drilling operations management and leadership skills.
Ability to promote a “ safe and efficient” culture.
Good working knowledge of general drilling systems for offshore based operations.
Working knowledge of HSE practices common to the company and the industry.
Leadership and teamwork skills and behaviors which support a team based organization.
Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to understand and react with diverse groups and operations.
Ability to recognize and resolve conflict.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications
Travel is an essential job function (domestic, international and offshore).


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Apply effective and efficient well execution plans and ensure rig crews are properly inspecting, maintaining and operating assigned drilling rigs.
Responsible to ensuring the Noble Maintenance Program is properly implemented and maintained on each assigned rig.
Guide rig personnel in pre-planning upcoming jobs with materials on hand to ensure that all planned and unplanned opportunities are maximized.
Maintain competent and capable rig crews and provide leadership in fostering the “safety-is-a-value” culture.
Assist in annual budget preparations and cost control procedures and be accountable for rig operating budget results.
Responsible for safe team work with respect to all rig operations.
Promote the principles of continuous improvement.
Maintain good two way communication with team members, both onshore and offshore.
Ensure that standards of supervision and employee performance are monitored and communicated to rig crews through verbal communication and contionous conversations.
Ensure equipment repair and returns are monitored and expedited and certification requirements are met.
Perform audits and rig inspections as necessary to maintain the highest operational standards.
Coordinate the development of newly appointed senior team members offshore.
Ensure regulatory compliance is properly maintained.
Participate in company required and recommended training.
Provide guidance and support to onshore and offshore personnel as required.
Ensure compliance with Noble’s HSE Management System.
Ensure that interfaces to operator HSE programs are defined and understood by rig crews.
Perform a necessary key leadership role for the assigned region.
Support the provision of consulting and specialist services related to all aspects the operation of assigned MODU’s.
Support the provision of offshore drilling services including HSE performance, operation and maintenance of assigned region drilling units and performance of all ancillary operations and services which are provided within the region.
Work to keep personnel turnover to a minimum.
Ensure the application of Noble’s policies and procedures to create effective work practices.
