title: Special Operations Physical Therapist (19th SFG(A) Camp Williams Draper, UT)
description:
Title:

Special Operations Physical Therapist (19th SFG(A) Camp Williams Draper, UT)

THIS POSITION OFFERS RELOCATION. 

 

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!  

KBR is a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers; but we all share one goal: to improve the world responsibly and safely.  We maintain a highly qualified workforce to help care for service people and astronauts across the world.  We attract the best minds because our expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness, and collaboration. That is how we supply our clients with cutting-edge solutions and services. 

 

We are seeking a stellar Special Operations Physical Therapist who will provide evaluation, treatment, and rehabilitation of musculoskeletal conditions. They are licensed independent practitioners and credentialed as direct care providers in specific military HP settings. At KBR we maintain a highly qualified workforce to help care for service people and astronauts – Could this be you? 

 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities: 

Evaluate and treat patients with or without referrals.  

Refer patients to other POTFF staff members as needed.  

Provide and perform the following services in support of POTFF’s HP program for SOF personnel, with the priority on SOF Operators and Direct Combat Support personnel: Provide neuro-musculoskeletal injury care, utilizing approved supplemental clinical privileges including the ordering of images, laboratory tests, pharmaceuticals, dry needling, acupuncture, joint injections and aspirations, and referrals to specialty providers. 

If directed by HP Program Manager and/or Coordinator, directly supervise the PT Tech, PT Assistant, and/or Certified Athletic Trainer (ATC) within their scope of practice.  

Participate in periodic meetings with HP and POTFF for reasons such as, but not limited to, reviewing care provided to patients. Identify opportunities for improvement.  

Serve as an advisor to the HP program Manager and/or Coordinator in matters related to Sports Medicine (SM), injury prevention, rehabilitation, and relevant human performance research. 

Serve as an advisor to the HP program Manager and/or Coordinator for administrative matters, purchasing of supplies and equipment, and supplemental fiscal requests.  

Conduct equipment, product, and literature reviews to ensure the HP program stays current with the provision of care.  

Provide input for the development and utilization of required databases.  

Conduct peer (record) reviews for the HP Staff as directed by governing credentialing body and local medical oversight process. 

Assists the HP program Manager and/or Coordinator in developing and updating criteria-based job descriptions and performance standards.  

Assist the HP program Manager and/or Coordinator in developing and maintaining clinical practice guidelines to ensure consistency of care across all HP Training Centers (HPTCs) and associated facilities.  

Assist with the preparation of short and long-term fiscal plans; submits input to the HP program Manager and/or Coordinator.  

Attend and participate in meetings with other POTFF staff members and medical providers as requested and/or required.  

Ensure safe and effective operation of equipment used for patient care and contribute to a safe working environment. 

Participate in periodic in-service training for members of the HP staff or POTFF staff as appropriate. 

Attend required training in accordance with guiding instructions. Commands will allow for attendance at necessary conferences and/or courses to complete continuing education units required to maintain certification. 

Maintain 100% compliance with local mandatory command training requirements. 

Document care in the Military’s Electronic Health Record ) i.e., AHLTA, GENESIS, etc.) and/or the HP Enterprise-wide database (e.g., Smartbase, etc.) as required per DODI 6040.45, USSOCOM HQ and POTFF Staff, and as directed by local HP program manager and/or coordinator. 

Document work performed, utilization, encounters, referrals, and all other information in the Military’s Electronic Health Record (i.e., AHLTA, MHS GENESIS, etc.) and/or the HP Enterprise-wide database (e.g., Smartbase, etc.), as directed by HP program manager and/or coordinator and/or required by USSOCOM HQ and its POTFF staff. 

Perform other tasks, within the scope of the PT position description, as assigned by the HP program Manager and/or Coordinator and/or required by USSOCOM HQ and its POTFF staff. 

Collect and report all data as requested by the HP program Manager and/or Coordinator and required by USSOCOM HQ and its POTFF staff. 

Proficiently utilize computers, software, and technologies as required and requested by the HP program Manager and/or Coordinator and required by USSOCOM HQ and its POTFF staff. 

 

Required Education/Experience/Skills/Training:  

This position requires U.S. Citizenship. 

This position requires a Secret Clearance or Top Secret Clearance, or the ability to obtain a clearance. 

Master’s degree in Physical Therapy. 

Certification through the American Board of Physical Therapy Specialties (ABPTS) as either an OCS or SCS, or certification through the National Athletic Trainers Association (NATA) as a certified athletic trainer (ATC).  

Maintain credentialing requirements in good standing at the local MTF.  

Capable of meeting physical demands of training with SOF including the ability to hike over rough terrain, function in austere environments, and observe SOF training evolutions.  

May be required to assist with strength and conditioning testing and training protocols and lift and manipulate loads or weights up to 25 kilograms. 

Minimum of five (5) years or more of demonstrable, accumulated experience (continuous and sustained experience preferred) of performing manual therapy in the sports medicine field with individual athletes and groups of athletes (experience at the levels of NCAA Division I, Olympic, professional, and/or SOF Operators preferred) in the accompanying, respective settings.  

Fluent oral and written communication skills in English. 

Must maintain current certification in Basic Cardiac Life Support (BCLS) by the American Heart Association; must provide front and back proof of all training/certs/documentation. 

 

 

Desired Education, Experience, Skills or Training:  

Doctoral degree in Physical Therapy.  

Prior military and/or SOF experience.  

Additional credentials such as a Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS) through the National Strength and Conditioning Association (NSCA).  

 

Standard Company Requirements:  

Must comply with Safety, Health and Environmental plan, policies and procedures.  

Must comply with the Quality Assurance plan, policies and procedures.  

Must maintain regular and acceptable attendance.  

Responsible for completing all required training.  

Perform other assignments and duties, as required.

description:
Title:

Heavy Truck Driver

Program Summary

KBR’s Missile, Aviation, and Ground Systems (MAGS) division delivers mission engineering solutions for critical U.S. Army programs, specializing in aviation and ground systems, integrated air and missile defense, and threat and target systems. As a trusted partner of the U.S. Department of War, MAGS provides innovative, technology-driven solutions to enhance national security. With a global presence and a strong ethical framework, KBR ensures secure, effective, and mission-ready capabilities worldwide.

Job Summary

As a Truck Driver – Distribution supporting ground operations, you will be responsible for safely operating various wheeled vehicles and equipment across diverse terrains to support logistics and training missions. You will transport materials, personnel, and equipment between facilities, conduct vehicle inspections and minor repairs, and ensure cargo is secured against damage or theft. This role requires knowledge of military vehicle operations, including handling hazardous materials, convoy participation, and vehicle recovery procedures. Flexibility, attention to safety, and readiness to work in challenging environments are essential. If you're excited to make your mark in a dynamic environment, apply now and let's create something remarkable together!

Roles and Responsibilities 

Operate wheeled vehicles and equipment over varied terrain and roadways
Transport materials, equipment, and personnel between warehouses, training areas, and other facilities
Secure cargo against weather, pilferage, and damage
Load and unload vehicles with or without assistance; tie down cargo to prevent shifting
Perform minor mechanical repairs and maintain vehicles in good working order
Operate Material Handling Equipment (MHE) as required
Use radios for communication and perform vehicle self-recovery and towing operations
Report vehicle deficiencies and support mechanics as needed
Organize and participate in convoys
Dispatch vehicles and verify logbooks
Receive and fulfill motor support requests from authorized personnel
Compile time, mileage, and load data for reporting
Operate specialized vehicles such as HEMTT, HET, and PLS
Maintain certifications for CDL, Ammo Awareness, and Hazardous Materials Transport
Work flexible shifts, travel as needed
Operate in extreme weather conditions
Safely navigate maintenance environments
Perform physical tasks such as sitting, standing, squatting, and walking for extended periods

***Candidate must have the ability to work flexible shifts and travel on Fort Hood and Training Sites**

Basic Qualifications 

High School Diploma
Minimum of 3 years of experience operating military or commercial wheeled vehicles
Possess a valid Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) with appropriate classification
Completion of Ammo Awareness and Hazardous Materials Transport Certification
Ability to operate Material Handling Equipment (MHE)
Familiarity with vehicle self-recovery and field expedient towing procedures

Preferred Qualifications

Physically capable of sitting, standing, squatting, walking, and talking for extended periods
Able to work in extreme weather conditions and noisy environments
Prior military experience in transportation or logistics (e.g., MOS 88M or equivalent)
Experience operating specialized vehicles such as HEMTT, HET, and PLS
Knowledge of Army motor pool operations, dispatch procedures, and logbook verification
Strong understanding of safety protocols and convoy operations

title: Senior Manager, Sales - Nuclear
description:
Title:

Senior Manager, Sales - Nuclear

KBR is a global provider of differentiated, professional services and technologies delivered across a wide government, defense and industrial base. Drawing from its rich 100-year history and culture of innovation and mission focus, KBR creates sustainable value by combining engineering, technical and scientific expertise with its full life cycle capabilities to help our clients meet their most pressing challenges today and into the future.

We deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 80 countries and operations in over 29 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results. At KBR, We Deliver.

KBR is seeking a Senior Manager, Sales to lead business development and sales activities within the civil nuclear sector, based out of Leatherhead. This role will focus on driving growth across the UK and international civil nuclear markets, with particular emphasis on early-phase project opportunities including feasibility studies, concept development, pre-FEED, FEED, and owner’s engineering services, as well as technology- and advisory-led engagements.

The role is centred on client relationship development, opportunity origination, and front-end positioning, working closely with KBR’s global nuclear, engineering, technology, and project delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute sales and business development strategies for civil nuclear markets, aligned with KBR’s global growth and nuclear strategy.
Identify, originate, qualify, and mature civil nuclear opportunities, encompassing new build, existing fleet support, decommissioning, waste management, fuel cycle, and nuclear infrastructure programs.
Lead front-end engagement for early-phase nuclear projects, including feasibility studies, concept development, pre-FEED/FEED, owner’s engineering, and advisory services.
Build and sustain strong, senior-level relationships with nuclear operators, government bodies, regulators, developers, supply chain partners, EPCs, and strategic alliance partners.
Act as a commercial ambassador for KBR’s civil nuclear capabilities, enhancing client engagement, market visibility, and thought leadership within the sector.
Collaborate closely with KBR’s global nuclear technology, engineering, licensing, delivery, and account teams to shape differentiated, value-driven solutions.
Lead opportunity qualification, capture planning, bid shaping, and sales strategy development for priority pursuits.
Support commercial alignment and contract negotiations, working in coordination with legal, commercial, and risk teams.
Provide market intelligence on nuclear investment programmes, policy and regulatory developments, supply chain trends, and competitive dynamics.
Mentor and support junior business development resources and contribute to continuous improvement of sales processes within the nuclear business.

Key Requirements

Proven experience in sales, business development, or commercial leadership within the civil nuclear, energy, infrastructure, or highly regulated industrial sectors.
Strong understanding of early-phase project development and the conversion of front-end studies into downstream engineering, procurement, construction, and programme delivery.
Demonstrated experience working with public and private sector clients, complex stakeholders, and long-cycle capital projects.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate client challenges into compelling, value-based solutions.
Excellent communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills at executive and programme levels.
Experience operating effectively within a global, matrix organisation with diverse technical and cultural interfaces.

Experience & Background

A relevant number of years’ experience, with flexibility for exceptionally strong candidates.
Background may include sales leadership, business development, project development, commercial management, or senior technical-commercial roles within nuclear or adjacent sectors.
An engineering or technical degree is advantageous but not mandatory; commercial, business, or blended technical-commercial backgrounds are equally acceptable.
Experience with nuclear technology-led solutions, programmatic delivery, or advisory services is highly desirable.

KBR Company Information

When you become part of the KBR team, your opportunities are endless. Through collaboration with our customers, we’re defining tomorrow’s challenges, then providing the solutions and services to overcome those challenges, always maintaining our commitment to total safety and reliability.

At KBR, we partner with government and industry clients to provide purposeful and comprehensive solutions with an emphasis on efficiency and safety. With a full portfolio of services, proprietary technologies and expertise, our employees are ready to handle projects and missions throughout their entire lifecycle, from planning and design to sustainability and maintenance. Whether at the bottom of the ocean or in outer space, our clients trust us to deliver the impossible on a daily basis.

Working at KBR means being rewarded for your contributions. In addition to competitive benefits and professional development, our people are empowered to use all their potential, creating meaningful change for themselves and our clients. We attract the best minds in the world because our expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness and collaboration. That is how we supply our clients with cutting-edge solutions and services.
 

As the needs of the world change, we’re ready to respond and guide the way forward with strategic, sustainable, and technological advancements grounded in more than a century of practical application and execution.

description:
Title:

Business Analyst

About KBR:

At KBR – We do things that matter. 

We deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 38,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 80 countries and operations in over 29 countries. 

KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results. At KBR, We Deliver. 

Think.KBR.com

KBR in Australia 

With over 65 years working on some of Australia’s largest and most complex projects, KBR has unmatched experience supporting the nation’s critical infrastructure, energy transition and national security priorities. KBR has around 2,000 employees throughout Australia, who are focused on delivering innovative technology and engineering solutions for a safer, more secure and sustainable future.

Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR 

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together.

The Opportunity:

As the Business Analyst, you will play a critical role in shaping, analysing, and delivering business and digital transformation initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, improve user experience, and embed sustainable change across the organisation.

Working closely with the Change Specialist and Digital Transformation Specialist, you will lead business analysis activities across the project lifecycle — translating business needs into functional and non-functional requirements, mapping current and future state processes, assessing change impacts, and ensuring transformation programs deliver measurable value.

You will apply strong analytical capability, business acumen, and change management expertise to support process redesign, digital enablement, and automation using tools such as UiPath, Nintex, Power Platform, and Power BI. Your work will help streamline workflows, uplift digital maturity, and improve adoption of new systems and processes across Australia Defence & Security Solutions (ADSS).

As part of the Business Improvement Team, you will contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and collaborative problem-solving, helping uplift organisational capability and engagement across the business.

This is a 12-month fixed-term, full-time position.

Responsibilities

The key responsibilities of the role will include, but is not limited to:

1. Business Analysis & Change Strategy

Lead business analysis activities to understand business needs, assess current state, and define future-state processes.

Support the development and implementation of enterprise change strategies aligned to digital transformation goals.

Partner with Change and Digital Transformation Specialists to define requirements, success measures, milestones, and value outcomes.

Conduct business process analysis, change impact assessments, and gap analyses; identify improvement opportunities and process re-engineering needs.

Integrate data insights into transformation planning to support prioritisation and evidence-based decision-making.

2. Digital Transformation Implementation

Translate business needs into well-defined requirements, user stories, process maps, and documentation.

Support the delivery of digital initiatives, including new systems, workflow automation, and process optimisation.

Work closely with technical teams to support solution design, testing, validation, and deployment.

Assist with rolling out digital tools (Nintex, Power Automate, Power Apps, UiPath) and monitor adoption, risks, and change readiness.

Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aligned with the GS APAC Business Improvement Plan.

Provide integration and transformation support for new business acquisitions, system upgrades, and technology transitions.

3. Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration

Build strong relationships with stakeholders across ADSS to understand needs, manage expectations, and gain alignment.

Facilitate workshops, interviews, and co-design sessions to gather requirements, validate findings, and identify pain points.

Collaborate with Communications, People & Culture, IT, and Program Teams to co-design change and engagement strategies.

Act as a trusted liaison between business users, technical teams, and leadership to ensure consistent messaging and aligned outcomes.

Foster a supportive, inclusive, and collaborative environment that strengthens digital and change capability.

4. Change Impact, Readiness & Assessment

Conduct business, people, and system impact assessments to identify risks, dependencies, and required interventions.

Analyse digital readiness, adoption needs, and workforce capability requirements.

Provide insights and recommendations to inform targeted change and training activities.

5. Communication, Learning & Support

Develop clear and engaging communication materials, change artefacts, and visual presentations using PowerPoint, Canva, or similar tools.

Translate complex technical information into user-centred, accessible language.

Support the development and delivery of training, learning, and reinforcement materials to embed new behaviours and processes.

Ensure consistent, accurate, and timely communication across all phases of transformation.

6. Culture, Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

Champion continuous improvement across business processes, systems, and ways of working.

Identify opportunities for process automation, workflow optimisation, and data-driven decision-making.

Support initiatives that strengthen digital capability, change resilience, and innovation culture.

Assist in maintaining a Change Management Community of Practice across ADSS.

7. Measurement, Insights & Reporting

Develop reporting frameworks and dashboards to measure performance, benefit realisation, and adoption rates.

Analyse performance data, stakeholder feedback, and value metrics to evaluate transformation effectiveness.

Prepare clear, concise, and insight-driven reports for stakeholders and leadership.

Qualifications, Skills and Experience

Essential:

Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst supporting digital transformation, organisational change, or continuous improvement.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data, identify insights, and propose practical business solutions.

Ability to understand and analyse the impact of business and technology change, including process, people, and data implications.

Understanding of change management principles and frameworks (e.g., ADKAR); Prosci Certification beneficial.

Experience with workflow automation tools such as UiPath, Nintex, Power Automate, Power Apps, and/or Power BI.

Proven ability to facilitate workshops, gather requirements, and document processes effectively.

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all organisational levels.

Proficiency in creating professional documentation, visuals, and presentations using Microsoft Office tools.

Highly organised, proactive, and adaptable to shifting priorities.

Passion for collaboration, problem-solving, and driving meaningful business improvement.

Desirable

Experience working within Defence, government, or large, complex environments.

Familiarity with Lean Six Sigma, Agile delivery frameworks, or Design Thinking methodologies.

Experience working with geographically dispersed teams or multi-site environments.

Job Title: Senior Project Engineer-Site

Location: Basra Iraq

About Company

"Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR!

The KBR team delivers future-forward science, technology and engineering solutions and mission-critical services that help governments and companies around the world accomplish their most important objectives, while also helping achieve their sustainability goals.

KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions provides holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design and engineering capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets."

Job Purpose

The Senior Project Engineer is responsible for leading site‑based engineering and construction activities for onshore oil and gas projects, ensuring safe, compliant, and high‑quality execution. The role requires close coordination with multidisciplinary teams to manage technical and execution issues and to support project delivery from engineering through construction, commissioning, and handover. The position will also act as the primary technical and coordination interface with the Company’s Abu Dhabi office.

Job Responsibilities

Project Execution & Site Leadership: Lead and oversee on‑site engineering activities, including planning, scheduling, and execution, ensuring works are delivered in line with approved scope, budget, schedule, and Company requirements.
Client interface and communication: Serve as the primary technical and coordination interface with the Client, leading client meetings, site inspections, and technical discussions. Proactively manage and respond to client queries, instructions, and comments, ensuring clear, timely, and accurate communication and alignment with approved scope, technical specifications, and overall project objectives
Engineering & Technical Oversight: Provide technical review and guidance on engineering deliverables, construction drawings, work packs, and specifications to ensure compliance with project requirements, applicable codes, and industry best practices.
Coordination & Interface Management: Act as the primary coordination focal point between construction, engineering, procurement, HSE, and project management teams, including effective interfacing with international engineers and contractors.
Risk Identification & Resolution: Identify potential technical and execution risks at site level; propose practical mitigation measures and resolve emerging construction or engineering issues promptly to avoid delays.
Quality, Safety & Compliance: Ensure all site activities comply with Company standards, QA/QC requirements, HSE regulations, and relevant Iraqi laws and environmental requirements.
Contractor & Stakeholder Management: Liaise with contractors, vendors, local authorities, and Company representatives to ensure smooth execution and effective resolution of technical or site‑related issues.
Team Supervision & Mentorship: Supervise and mentor junior engineers, technicians, and site staff; promote a strong safety culture, knowledge transfer, and continuous improvement among local teams.
Reporting & Documentation: Prepare and review technical reports, progress updates, method statements, and handover documentation; ensure accurate and timely reporting to Company management.
Continuous Improvement: Support lessons‑learned initiatives and contribute to improving engineering practices, site coordination, and execution efficiency.

Technical Skills

Strong experience in onshore oil and gas project execution, particularly in site‑based engineering and construction support roles.
Working knowledge of engineering and project tools such as AutoCAD, SAP, PDMS, or equivalent systems used for mechanical, civil, or project management activities.
Good understanding of international engineering standards, codes, and best practices relevant to oil and gas facilities.
Hands‑on experience with construction sequencing, mechanical completion, commissioning support, and handover activities.
Familiarity with local Iraqi regulations, site permit systems, and coordination with local stakeholders is an advantage.

Soft Skills

Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both local and international teams.
Practical problem‑solving and decision‑making capability in a site‑based, execution‑focused environment.
Ability to manage priorities, adapt to changing site conditions, and work under schedule and operational pressure.
Demonstrated commitment to safety, teamwork, and professional integrity..

Qualifications

Masters or Bachelor’s in Engineering or a related discipline; advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., PMP, PE) are advantageous.
Minimum of 12+ years of relevant experience in onshore oil and gas projects, emphasizing and project execution.
Proven track record of managing large, complex projects with a focus on safety and quality.

Work Environment

This position will be based on-site in Iraq, engaging with international and local teams. The senior role emphasizes leadership in fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing work environment, with a focus on mentorship, safety culture, and stakeholder relations.

description:
Title:

V-22 Aircrewman (Assistant Platform Coordinator)

KBR’s Mission Engineering Division delivers complex technical solutions and expert support to the U.S. Department of War, specializing in modeling and simulation, cyber transformation, air vehicle mission integration, and lifecycle support. As a trusted partner with a proven history in mission technology, KBR collaborates closely with clients to develop innovative and effective solutions. With a strong ethical framework, KBR prioritizes data security, privacy, and responsible information management to ensure mission success. 

KBR is seeking a MV‑22/CMV‑22 Test Aircrewman to serve as an Assistant Platform Coordinator supporting Air Test and Evaluation Squadron Two One (HX‑21) at NAS Patuxent River, MD. This role contributes directly to the developmental flight test and evaluation of rotary‑wing and tilt‑rotor aircraft for Navy and Marine Corps missions. The selected candidate will support test planning, execution, and reporting while working alongside government, military, contractor, and industry partners. This position offers the opportunity to influence high‑visibility test efforts within the world’s largest independent flight test organization. The mission of Air Test and Evaluation Squadron Two One (HX-21) is to execute developmental flight test and evaluation of rotary-wing and tilt-rotor aircraft, and their associated airborne systems in support of all United States Navy and Marine Corps training, combat, and combat support missions. HX-21 provides the highest quality evaluation and reporting in support of the aircraft program managers and the fleet warfighters. Exemplifying the Navy and Marine Corps' ethos, the pride and professionalism inherent in everything HX-21 does has established it as the "World's Greatest Test Squadron." As a long-term incumbent and leader in flight test, the selected applicant will work within the NAVAIR test community composed of government, military, contractor and industry personnel while supporting flight test.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Supports the V-22 Test Team as part of HX-21, a Developmental Test and Evaluation squadron at the Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division (NAWCAD), NAS Patuxent River, MD.
Performs the ground and flight duties of a MV-22/CMV-22 Test Aircrewman/Crew Chief.
Supports a wide range of NAWCAD test and evaluation activities to include: ground/flight event scheduling and coordination, test plan/test procedure development and review, flight briefings, test execution, and post event support.
Duties of Assistant Platform Coordinator include assisting the MV-22/CMV-22 Test program in long-term efforts to include test project prioritization, coordination of aircraft configuration, maintenance, instrumentation, and utilization.

Basic Qualifications:

Education: High school diploma or GED; must be a graduate of  the U.S. Naval Aircrew Candidate School (NACCS), USAF Basic Helicopter Flight Engineer (BHFE), or USMC US Marine Enlisted Aircrew Training (MEAT) Program is required. 
Certification(s): Must be able to pass the physical and training qualification requirements to provide contract aircrew support, including Navy aviation physiology, water survival, and maintain an FAA Class II flight physical.
Experience: Minimum of 500 hours of crew chief experience. Current or recent (within 3 years) MV‑22/CMV‑22 crew chief qualification.
Clearance & Citizenship: Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance; U.S. citizenship required. Applicant selected may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or active enrollment in a bachelor’s program (engineering preferred).
USNTPS Fundamentals of Flight Test Short Course completion.
Developmental Test or Operational Test experience.
NVD/NVG qualification.
Navy V‑22 experience.

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!  

KBR is a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers; but we all share one goal: to improve the world responsibly and safely.  We maintain a highly qualified workforce to help care for service people and astronauts across the world.  We attract the best minds because our expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness, and collaboration. Design, administer, evaluate, and document the effects of physical training protocols under the supervision of the HP program Manager and/or Coordinator.

Refer all personnel with an apparent new or undiagnosed medical condition to a medical provider for evaluation and treatment.

title: Sustainability Lead
description:
Title:

Sustainability Lead

About KBR and the Project

KBR’s Estates Intelligence is a leading force in public sector Assurance, providing cutting-edge technical platforms and professional services. We support central government and specialist departments in effectively managing delivery, to achieve their strategic goals.

Estates Intelligence offers a compelling market proposition, delivering expertise and solutions to optimise data and information, supporting clients to achieve their objectives. Using our VIAverse platform, our people, processes, knowledge and technology, we integrate validated data and cutting-edge technology to streamline operations, maximise efficiency and value for money.

About the Role

We are seeking a Sustainability Lead to provide expert guidance, develop robust delivery plans, and ensure compliance with regulations and standards. The ideal candidate will identify and implement data-driven solutions to help clients meet targets in energy, carbon, waste, circular economy, water, heritage, community engagement, nature, and supply chain sustainability. The Sustainability Lead will use data, procedures, and best practice to drive improvement and embed sustainability across the EI portfolio.

Role Responsibilities:

Use data analytics to identify sustainability improvement opportunities and best practices.

Undertake Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions accounting and reporting in accordance with GHG Protocol.

Model net-zero pathways and conduct scenario analysis.

Support risk management for sustainability-related risks and opportunities.

Lead sustainability audits of client facilities and estates.

Design and review compliance dashboards and building performance analytics.

Benchmark estate sustainability performance against industry standards.

Develop ROI business cases for energy and resource efficiency initiatives.

Drive delivery of energy efficiency projects and highlight efficiency opportunities across energy, waste, and water.

Design and review reporting tools for waste, water, transport, ESG, and supply chain transparency.

Advise clients on environmental legislation, standards, and sustainability training.

Collaborate with the EI management team on individual projects as required.

Work collaboratively across EI and with clients to deliver efficiency savings and reduce environmental impact.

Model collaborative and influential working styles, negotiating for optimal outcomes and embedding best practices.

Professional Experience Required

Extensive experience in estate/facilities/real estate sustainability, energy management, or environmental operations.

Proven track record in delivering multi-site energy or carbon reduction programs and data-driven performance management.

Experience with environmental/energy standards (e.g., ISO 14001, ISO 50001) and operational audits.

Strong business case development skills, including CAPEX/OPEX planning.

Experience with UK regulations (e.g., SECR, ESOS, climate-related financial risk) and asset ratings (e.g.,BREEAM, LEED, EPCs, DECs).

Familiarity with building services (HVAC, BMS, lighting), sub-metering, and analytics platforms.

Experience with climate risk assessment and biodiversity net gain.

Technical Skills Required

description:
Title:

Technical Intelligence Subject Matter Expert – Modeling & Simulation

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!

KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

Why Join Us?

Innovative Projects: KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.
Collaborative Environment: Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.
Impactful Work: Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense.

Key Responsibilities:

KBR is seeking a Technical Intelligence Subject Matter Expert (SME) – Modeling & Simulation to join a team of quantitative analysts and modelers dedicated to conduct modeling, simulation, and analysis (MS&A) of emerging concepts for the Defense Advanced Projects Research Agency (DARPA) using advanced MS&A techniques and tools and to support further enhancement thereof. This role is at the nexus of defense intelligence, military systems analysis, and computational modeling, enabling high-fidelity representations of real-world forces, capabilities, and behaviors. The candidate will:

Support the collection, curation, validation, and structuring of information and/or technical intelligence related to US, allied, and adversary military organizations, systems, and equipment for use in advanced analytical, simulation, and AI-supported environments.
Collect, curate, and maintain authoritative datasets describing military organizations, force structures, platforms, weapons systems, sensors, C2 architectures, and operational capabilities across U.S., allied, and adversary forces.
Translate data from OSINT, IC reporting, foreign military studies, technical assessments, and technical military system and organizational materials into structured, model-ready formats.
Define system attributes, performance parameters, constraints, and behaviors relevant to mission- and engagement-level simulations.
Ensure intelligence data is traceable, validated, and annotated for use in modeling and simulation environments.
Support the development of taxonomies, ontologies, and schemas for representing military entities and interactions.
Advise on assumptions, uncertainties, and intelligence gaps that affect simulation outcomes.
Provide expert input on threat evolution, emerging military technologies, and future force concepts.
Brief program leadership, DARPA PMs, and government stakeholders on intelligence-driven insights and modeling implications.
Contribute to white papers, technical reports, and program deliverables.

Work Environment:

Location: On-site
Travel Requirements: Minimal 0-20%
Working Hours: Standard

Qualifications:

Required:

Bachelor’s Degree with 10 years of relevant experience, or
Master's Degree with 8 years of relevant experience
Deep familiarity with U.S. and non-U.S. military organizations, platforms, and systems (air, land, maritime, space, cyber, or multi-domain).
Experience supporting modeling & simulation, wargaming, force analysis, or systems analysis efforts.
Demonstrated ability to structure unclassified and classified intelligence into data-driven, model-ready formats.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including briefing senior technical and government audiences.
TS/SCI is required for this role.

Desired:

Master’s degree in International Security, Engineering, Data Science, Systems Engineering, Military Studies, or a related field, with 12 years of relevant experience
Prior experience supporting DARPA, DoD R&D, FFRDCs, or defense labs.
Familiarity with AI/ML-enabled modeling, digital engineering, or synthetic environments.
Experience developing or working with order of battle (OOB) databases, force posture models, or equipment catalogs.
Knowledge of ontologies, data schemas, or knowledge graphs in a defense or intelligence context.

40hrs

KBR sustains the operational well-being of U.S. armed forces at Djibouti, Africa, Camp Lemonnier Naval Base. Our services encompass program management, contingency and expeditionary, asset management and recreation support, postal operations, safety services, logistics, and more. KBR ensures the base operates smoothly, allowing deployed personnel to focus on mission execution.

Job Summary

Under the general direction of the Fire Services Chief, responsible for planning, organizing, directing, and coordinating the Fire and Emergency Services (F&ES) training and certification program on a full-time basis. This position advises senior leadership, Fire Managers, Fire Chiefs, Project Managers, clients and other supervisors on Department of Defense (DoD) F&ES subjects.

Roles and Responsibilities 

Leads directs and supervises the F&ES department in delivering professional F&ES to clients and customers within the Area of Responsibility served by KBR F&ES. Prepare consolidated F&ES Departmental Reports.
Reviews and validates F&ES training and personnel actions.
Reviews and evaluates Performance Work Statement (PWS) requirements as they relate to training requirements and provides recommendations to the Fire Chief.
In the absence of the F&ES Chief, we shall represent F&ES by providing reports, briefings, attending meetings, inspections and presentations representing F&ES to KBR, customer(s), and client(s). Assist the Fire Chief in developing and implementing an overall company long-term strategic plan involving fire protection. Plans, administrators, and supervises the training function.
When needed, assumes duties and responsibilities of the Fire Chief, Assistant Chief of Operations, or any other position qualified to perform.
Plans a comprehensive program of on-the-job and proficiency training for all fire protection personnel.
Coordinate and train all fire personnel to maintain the required certification and recertification standards.
May be assigned to fill in for Operations personnel assigned to apparatus crews

Assessing all services provided by F&ES department that are associated with the protection and preservation of life, property and the environment, consistent with KBR approved policies, KBR BOSS (PWS), and in accordance with national recognized standards for safety, personnel, and equipment.
Writes routine reports and correspondence using Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook software
Provide guidance and input to facilitate resourcing F&ES for success through staffing, training and equipping as required to maintain levels of readiness and response
Recommends administrative personnel actions lAW KBR policies. Reviews and files reports, monthly summaries, and vehicle and personnel rosters.

Basic Qualifications 

The candidate must have a minimum of three years’ experience as an Assistant Fire Chief for Training in a fire department similar to the size and scope of Camp Lemonnier, Djibouti, Africa.
The candidate must have current IFSAC, ProBoard, or Department of Defense (DoD): Fire Officer III, Fire Instructor III, Fire Inspector II, Hazmat Incident Commander, and Airport Firefighter. HazMat Awareness and Operations. CPR and Emergency Medical Responder.
Position requires U.S. Citizenship and security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain ONE.
Must possess passport book (not passport card) with at least 12 months of remaining validity AND with at least 6 blank visa/stamp pages remaining.
Must possess a driver’s license with at least 6 months of remaining validity.

Preferred Certifications Driver Operator Pumper, Driver Operator ARFF, Driver Operator MWS, Driver Operator Aerial, NIMS/FEMA 100, 200, 300, 400, 700, 800, HazMat Technician
Rescue Technician (Rope / Confined Space / Trench / Structural Collapse / Vehicle)
Knowledge of department computer systems and software applications (ESAMS)
Ability to communicate clearly in oral and written form and to make effective public presentations
Ability to work effectively in a high-pressure environment with multiple interruptions/distractions.

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR! 

Program Summary

KBR supports the operational needs of U.S. armed forces at Morón Air Base in Spain and several bases in Turkey. Our services ensure smooth operations, allowing Air Force and government personnel to focus on their missions. We provide program management, civil engineering, morale, welfare, and recreation support, among other essential services. Job Summary

The UABOS (Turkey) Corrosion Control and Cathodic Protection Engineer is responsible for Corrosion Control and Cathodic Protection Systems, developing design solutions to rectify deficiencies. The role involves ensuring metal structures' and pipelines' integrity and longevity through effective corrosion control measures. This position offers an opportunity to work on complex infrastructure projects and contribute to protecting critical assets.  We are seeking an experienced and certified Electrical Engineer with the qualifications of Cathodic Protection (CP3 and/or CP4) to join our team to perform engineering and planning activities aligned with U.S. Air Force standards.

Create systems to protect metal structures, fuel pipes, etc. from corrosion.
Perform corrosion surveys and inspections to assess the condition of structures.
Oversee the installation of cathodic protection systems, ensuring they are correctly set up.
Monitor and maintain systems, ensuring they continue to function effectively.
Collect and analyze data to monitor system performance.
Prepare reports documenting the status of corrosion protection systems and any necessary adjustments.
Plan and manage cathodic protection projects, including budgeting and scheduling.
Ensure all designs and operations comply with relevant safety and industry standards (like NACE/AMPP standards).

Provide technical advice to clients and in-house maintenance personnel on corrosion issues and protection strategies.
Other duties, as assigned.

Minimum 2 years of Electrical Engineering experience

Strong understanding of electrical and corrosion control principles.

6 years of project engineering experience for major real property facilities

DoD installation-level experience
Familiarity with American and Turkish facility design standards
Familiarity with engineering principles, materials, specification writing, USAF contracting procedures, engineering equipment, and surveying essential

description:
Title:

Special Operations Psychological / Mental Health Technician (Camp Lejeune / Sneads Ferry, NC,)

THIS POSITION OFFERS RELOCATION.

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!  

KBR is a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers; but we all share one goal: to improve the world responsibly and safely.  We maintain a highly qualified workforce to help care for service people and astronauts across the world.  We attract the best minds because our expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness, and collaboration. That is how we supply our clients with cutting-edge solutions and services. 

The Psychological Mental Health Technician shall assist with the management and treatment of outpatient behavioral health activities.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Primarily responsible, under the supervision of a licensed psychiatrist, social worker, psychiatric nurse or psychologist, for providing a wide range of behavioral health interventions from prevention to treatment to individuals and who assigns work by defining objectives, priorities, and deadlines, and provides guidance on assignments that do not have clear precedents.

Under the supervision of a credentialed provider, conduct intakes, assist with care and treatment of psychiatric, drug and alcohol patients, and counsel clients/patients with personal, behavioral or psychological problems.

Accomplish work on a substantially independent basis, performing a full range of standard and nonstandard work assignments and resolving a variety of non-recurring problems encountered on own initiative. Extensive guidelines are available; however, the contractor must use judgment in locating and selecting the most appropriate guideline for application to the work situation at hand. Unusual matters, which may not be specifically covered by policy statements or published regulations, shall be referred to the Government supervisor.

Observe patients to detect behavior patterns and reports observations to licensed behavioral health staff.

Lead prescribed individual or group therapy sessions as part of specific therapeutic procedures under the guidance of a licensed mental health professional.

As needed, complete initial intake interviews and complete required forms for new patients on behalf of the licensed mental health provider.

Collect and maintain monthly statistical data assigned work place.

Conduct intake interviews under the supervision of a licensed mental health professional.

Administers psychological tests, compiles data and prepares reports for psychological testing under the supervision of a licensed psychologist.

Administer psychophysiological tests and assessments under the supervision of a licensed medical/mental health professional

Populate and maintain a computerized database that will contain the listing of all units within the HQ organization and identify the number of service members assigned to each unit/Directorate in order to compile monthly training statistics.

Prepare daily correspondence (i.e., training agendas, meeting agendas, purchase orders, clinical appointments).

Collect and maintain monthly statistical data assigned work place.

Prepare and maintain attendance rosters and statistical data for all active duty personnel who attended Social Work/Behavioral Health services.

Assist in developing program-operating instructions, works with providers to uncover inefficiencies, and makes recommendations for corrective action.

Make comparison reviews, to include office time sheets, to ensure program operations are managed within budget.

Be responsible for the development and implementation of appointment templates for clinical providers.

Place physical maintenance work orders and maintain hand receipts for physical property and inventory. Ensure proper supply stock levels and reorder as necessary including specialized behavioral health forms and tests.

Duties also involve assisting or independently gathering data for various presentations such as process improvements initiatives, longitudinal statistical tracking, hospitalizations, and discharges. Interface frequently with the Command’s family support organizations.

Maintain competency folders in accordance with program policy.

Coordinate attendance and agenda at Case Review Committee with military and civilian agencies.

Coordinate and reserve meeting location, verifies attendance and prepares current and tentative following weeks agenda.

Prepare open and closed case reports for required special handling of outpatient medical records in accordance with regulations.

Maintain a resource library for use by professional staff and customers. Library materials are selected with the intent of providing knowledge, ideas and support to practitioners in the fields of education, clinical social work and family studies.

Provide services to families desiring information on healthy family life and parenting skills.

Required Education/Experience/Skills/Training: 

Must be a US Citizen.

This position requires a Secret Clearance or Top Secret Clearance, or the ability to obtain a clearance.

EEG Tech experience desired. 

Candidates with military experience desired.

An associate degree or commensurate level of training, e.g. military mental health technician, for a psychiatric technician or mental health program assistant. Education requirement may be met by military or comparable training. If military trained, the individual’s specialty must be as a mental health technician / specialist.

The contractor shall have no less than 3 years’ experience as a psychiatric technician.

Must attend psychiatric technicians’ training which will provide a sound foundation / basis to psychology and/or social work to ensure the tech is prepared for the types of individuals and potential illnesses that they will likely deal with. This training shall also address the basics of conflict management, how to de-escalate crisis situations and individuals who are agitated, violent or potentially violent and/or suicidal.

description:
Title:

Motor Vehicle Mechanic

Program Summary

KBR’s Missile, Aviation, and Ground Systems (MAGS) division delivers mission engineering solutions for critical U.S. Army programs, specializing in aviation and ground systems, integrated air and missile defense, and threat and target systems. As a trusted partner of the U.S. Department of Defense, MAGS provides innovative, technology-driven solutions to enhance national security. With a global presence and a strong ethical framework, KBR ensures secure, effective, and mission-ready capabilities worldwide.

Job Summary

At KBR/Fort Hood, we're seeking a driven Motor Vehicle Mechanic candidate to join our Ground Operations Team to help support Aviation, Ground, and Maintenance Operations. Your contributions will be instrumental in efficiently executing ground vehicle maintenance for U.S. Army Tactical vehicles and Foreign Military Tactical vehicles to include the associated rolling stock. Your efforts will ensure Aviation and Ground Operations training stay on schedule. Join a team committed to excellence, where collaboration and innovation thrive. If you're excited to make your mark in a dynamic environment, apply now and let's create something remarkable together! 

Roles and Responsibilities 

The Motor Vehicle Mechanic will repair, rebuild, or overhaul major assemblies of internal combustion automobiles, buses, trucks, and tractors.  
Work involves the following: 
Diagnosing the source of trouble and determining the extent of repairs required 
Replacing work or broken parts such as piston rings, bearings, or engine parts,  
Ground Maintenance work will also include grinding, adjusting valves, brake systems, changing tires, rebuilding carburetors, and overhauling transmissions. 
Must follow a maintenance schedule and check fluids. 
Requires rounded training and experience. 
Must be a good problem solver, mechanically inclined, pay attention to detail, have an ability to multi-task, properly communicate, and follow detailed instructions. 
Conduct other duties as assigned by the Lead Motor Vehicle Mechanic. 
Must be able to work different shifts as required, be able to travel as needed, and be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance if required. 
 Must be able to move safely about in a maintenance environment (open bay and outdoors) and be able to sit, stand, squat, and walk for extended periods of time. 
The candidate will be exposed to extreme weather conditions (heat, cold, rain) and will be subject to loud noises, exhaust fumes, and dust. 

Basic Qualifications 

High School Diploma

Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!  

 

Around here, we define the future.

 

We are a company of innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers. But we all share one goal: to improve the world responsibly and safely.

The Mission Systems Operations Contract (MSOC) at the Johnson Space Center is seeking a Voice Engineer with a working knowledge of voice communication systems, video processing and distribution, and GPS timing systems. The applicant will be required to support mission, simulation, and testing activities in the Mission Control Center (MCC), Mission Training Complex (MTC), and Space Vehicle Mockup Facility (SVMF). Some activities may be considered Mission Critical/Complex and require support during off nominal (M-F, 8-5) hours, weekends, or holidays. This position may require business travel. 

The selected applicant will be required to support project design working groups, develop critical design review inputs to system engineering, perform project material and labor cost assessment/estimates, and support design presentations to contract management and the NASA customer. The selected applicant will be required to perform implementation of approved designs, support development of project schedules, provide status to contract management and project engineering, and coordinate implementation efforts with the integration and maintenance teams as well as other project stakeholders. The selected applicant will be required to initiate material requests for procurement of system hardware prior to implementation and provide status of the material delivery. The selected applicant will be required to generate/update configuration management documents as part of the implementation process including cabinet/console drawings, facility floor plans, cable running lists, cross-connect wire lists, Engineering Instructions (EIs), and Subsystem Readiness Tests (SSRTs). The applicant will work in a team environment, and must possess good interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written. The ideal candidate will have a strong drive to apply themselves and continually update his/her skill base, is team oriented, and works to develop and apply good problem-solving skills.

Responsibilities may include:
• Assist in the design, development, sustaining, and maintenance of engineering documentation (databases and drawings) and generation of instructions to change (install, modify, update) the various Mission Control Center (MCCS), Mission Training Complex (MTC), and Space Vehicle Mockup Facility (SVMF) voice, video, and timing systems, including MCCS flight control rooms and Ops Suite consoles and Training Systems Instructor Operator System rooms
• Support the design, development, testing, and deployment of Video, Voice, and Timing Systems
• Respond to and resolve technical issues as needed
• Report on technical work progress, issues, impediments, etc.
• Support integration of engineering hardware into the MCC, MTC, and SVMF environments
• Translate NASA customer operations concepts and functional requirements into engineering design details.
• Identify hardware components, develop parts lists, and generate material procurement requests for acquisition of equipment and materials.
• Support project level planning activities and provide project schedule inputs
• Be able to communicate effectively with internal team members and external NASA customer
• Generation of technical instructions for implementation
• Communicate and coordinate with team leader, as well as MSOC management as needed
• Comply with the MSOC contract and NASA/JSC/MSD direction, policies, and procedures
• Make improvements and suggestions to advance the overall engineering processes in place

Education:
• BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering Technology, or related discipline
 

Desired Qualifications
• An understanding of voice, video, and timing systems
• 3+ years or more of experience in these systems is a plus
• Good problem solving and analytical skills
• Strong communication skills inclusive of low level technical details with peers and summary level to management
• Master Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent is a definite plus
• Cisco CCNA or CCNP certification is highly desirable
• CTS or CompTIA certification would be beneficial
• Demonstrated work experience to receive task assignments, work autonomously and provide periodic status to team members
• Demonstrated experience working system anomalies during mission-critical periods of operation through problem resolution
• Familiarity with IP-based Voice and Video system architectures
• Familiarity with Time Division Multiplexed (TDM) voice systems
• Familiarity with audio codecs (G.711, G.729)
• Familiarity with telephony system (Loop/Ground Start, SIP, Asterisk)

description:
Title:

LCV EUCOM Kosovo: Food Service Worker

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR! 

Program Summary

KBR leads the government services world contingency market by providing responsive, full-service logistics support to forces deployed around the world under the Logistics Civil Augmentation Program contract (LOGCAP). KBR’s enduring mission support of the LOGCAP program dates back to 1992 when we served as the contract’s original prime contractor. Today, we have a workforce of over 6,000 people representing 40 nationalities who perform work on the contract in 10 countries.

Job Summary

The Food Services Worker will perform various tasks related to kitchen and dining area operations. The primary responsibilities include preparing dining and serving areas, cleaning and maintaining kitchen spaces, and ensuring a high standard of sanitation and cleanliness. 

Roles and Responsibilities

Prepare dining and serving areas by arranging counters, stands, and tables.

Set up food containers in serving order, fill salt and pepper shakers, and place linen and silverware on tables.

Clean and work in the scullery, responsible for general kitchen cleaning, including floors, equipment, walls, and light fixtures.

Store cleaned items and cleaning materials in an organized manner.

Collect, scrape, soak, wash, rinse, and sanitize dishes, pots, pans, and utensils.

Dispose of food waste in garbage disposal or trash receptacle.

Pick up and store non-food items, cleaning solutions, and paper products.

Perform machine and manual washing of kitchen items.

Conduct perimeter cleaning functions to maintain overall cleanliness.

Set up, serve, break down, and replenish serving lines, beverage refrigerators, and juice dispensers.

Sweep, mop, and clean serving lines, warmers, refrigerators, beverage dispensers, and coffee machines after each meal.

Assist with salad and bar preparation.

Serve main course, speed line items, meats, vegetables, starches, and short-order items during daily serving hours.

Wash and sort dishes, glassware, and silverware.

Clean and sanitize kitchen equipment, pots, pans, counters, and tables.

Sweep and mop floors in designated areas.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Must have a High School Diploma or equivalent and a minimum of 1 year of experience in food services.

Requires the ability to read, write, understand, and speak clearly in English.

Must be able to comprehend verbal and written instructions and effectively communicate instructions to others.

Fluency in Albanian and possessing an unrestricted right to work and reside in Kosovo.

Preferred Qualifications (Preferred Education, Experience, Skills, and Certifications)

Culinary certification or degree. 

Military food service experience.

description:
Title:

OPIR Analyst (Overhead Persistent Infrared)

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR! 

Program Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Overhead Persistent Infrared (OPIR) Analyst to support critical national security missions by exploiting OPIR sensor data to detect, characterize, and report on missile events, thermal signatures, and other time-sensitive activities. The ideal candidate will apply advanced remote sensing techniques and geospatial intelligence (GEOINT) methodologies to produce actionable intelligence in support of the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA), National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA), and other interagency partners.

Key Responsibilities

Exploit OPIR and other remotely sensed data to identify facilities, infrastructure, and features of interest using PIR (Priority Intelligence Requirements)-driven imagery analysis to satisfy DIA and NGA mission requirements.
Detect, track, and characterize thermal events, missile launches, industrial activity, and other phenomena visible in the infrared spectrum.
Produce high-quality intelligence reports and briefings for multi-agency customers, including senior policymakers and operational customers.
Maintain and update an enterprise geodatabase containing 170,000+ features to support multiple analytic teams and enable consistent, repeatable exploitation.
Develop and maintain ArcGIS Portal Web Apps/Sites to disseminate intelligence products and support collaborative analysis.
Generate metrics-based intelligence products to quantify mission impact, analytic throughput, and product quality.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate OPIR-derived insights with other GEOINT sources (e.g., EO, SAR, MASINT).
Stay current with evolving OPIR sensor capabilities, processing techniques, and analytic tradecraft.

Required Qualifications

Active TS/SCI security clearance.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Remote Sensing, Geospatial Intelligence, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Astronomy, or related STEM discipline); Master's degree preferred.
5+ years of professional experience in OPIR analysis, missile warning/tracking, or related infrared remote sensing exploitation (additional experience may substitute for advanced degrees).
Demonstrated expertise in exploiting remotely sensed infrared data to produce intelligence reports for multi-agency customers.
Strong proficiency with ArcGIS suite, including:
ArcGIS Pro / ArcMap for advanced geospatial analysis.
ArcGIS Portal administration and Web App/Site development.
Enterprise geodatabase management and feature editing.
Experience producing metrics-based intelligence products and dashboards to communicate analytic performance.
Solid understanding of PIR-driven analysis and requirements satisfaction processes within the IC.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills for authoring intelligence reports and briefing senior stakeholders.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-tempo environment with time-sensitive deliverables.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with OPIR-specific tools and platforms (e.g., Advanced Geospatial Intelligence Environment (AGIE), RemoteView, ENVI, or equivalent).
Familiarity with missile event detection, characterization, and reporting workflows.
Knowledge of additional sensor modalities (multispectral, hyperspectral, SAR) and multi-INT fusion.
Scripting experience in Python (ArcPy) or MATLAB for automation and custom processing.
Prior military, DIA, NGA, or IC analytic experience.
Relevant certifications (e.g., NGA GEOINT certifications, Certified Mapping Scientist – Remote Sensing).

APS-3:Logistics Analyst Planner

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR!

KBR maintains and manages Army stocks at the Army Field Support Battalion - Charleston (AFSBn-CHS) land site to include all logistics and maintenance operations. The KBR APS-3 Program is managed and executed at Goose Creek in support of the Army’s power projection doctrine and resources.  The contract provides maintenance of Army stocks (Class II, IIIP, IV, VII, IX) to ensure that unit sets stored at APS-3 are configured and maintained at optimal readiness. title: Mechanical or Materials Engineers
description:
Title:

Mechanical or Materials Engineers

KBR is a global provider of differentiated, professional services and technologies delivered across a wide government, defense and industrial base. Drawing from its rich 100-year history and culture of innovation and mission focus, KBR creates sustainable value by combining engineering, technical and scientific expertise with its full life cycle capabilities to help our clients meet their most pressing challenges today and into the future.

We deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. KBR employs approximately 37,000 people worldwide with customers in more than 80 countries and operations in over 29 countries. KBR is proud to work with its customers across the globe to provide technology, value-added services, and long-term operations and maintenance services to ensure consistent delivery with predictable results. At KBR, We Deliver.

This is an ideal opportunity to join KBR, a company completing exciting projects at the forefront of the energy transition and traditional energy markets. We work on some of the biggest and most complex energy industry projects around the world and our teams are some of the best and brightest in the industry.

The energy industry is at a pivotal point in history. With traditional energy such as oil and gas needing to become more sustainable and the world looking to alternative energy sources, our engineers are at the forefront of this energy transition for some of the biggest clients in the industry.

KBR requires engineers in the following specialties to develop their skills collaborating with outstanding engineers across a variety of exciting projects and clients.

Machinery – Rotating machinery including compressors, pumps, and gas turbines.

Static – Pressure vessel, tanks, and heat exchangers.

Package equipment – process and utilities packages including water treatment plants, utilities systems, nitrogen generators, flares and similar.

Materials, selection of materials to meet the safety and lifecycle requirements of the plant.

The ideal candidate will have mechanical or materials engineering design experience in the energy sector or a comparable industry.

When you become part of the KBR team, your opportunities are endless. Through collaboration with our customers, we’re defining tomorrow’s challenges, then providing the solutions and services to overcome those challenges, always maintaining our commitment to total safety and reliability.

With a full portfolio of services, proprietary technologies and expertise, our employees are ready to handle projects and missions throughout their entire lifecycle, from planning and design to sustainability and maintenance. Whether at the bottom of the ocean or in outer space, our clients trust us to deliver the impossible on a daily basis.

Working at KBR means being rewarded for your contributions. In addition to competitive benefits and professional development, our people are empowered to use all their potential, creating meaningful change for themselves and our clients. We attract the best minds in the world because our expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness and collaboration. That is how we supply our clients with cutting-edge solutions and services.
 

As the needs of the world change, we’re ready to respond and guide the way forward with strategic, sustainable, and technological advancements grounded in more than a century of practical application and execution.

Title:

Commissioning Manager

KBR is a global provider of differentiated professional services and technologies across the asset and program life cycle within the Government Services and Hydrocarbons sectors. KBR employs approximately 34,000 people worldwide (including our joint ventures), with customers in more than 80 countries, and operations in 40 countries.

Job Requirement

We are looking for a Commissioning Manager to work on EPCM portfolio of projects under a general service agreement to be based in Basra, Iraq for 28/28 rotation.

Job Responsibility and Requirement

The Commissioning Manager shall be responsible for the Commissioning deliverables of KBR Majnoon projects, managing team and resources to ensure the scope or work is executed in a safe timely manner in line with project schedule and milestones.
Manage and lead Commissioning team and vendors, monitoring progress and ensuring work execution is both safe and best practices.
Development of Commissioning execution plans, schedules and procedures.
Focal Start Up and Operational readiness communications with Management Team, Client and facilitate handover activities.

Key responsibilities include:

Lead by example and coach good HSE and safe working practices.
Develop Commissioning strategy and execution plans.
Develop Commissioning and input to the integrated schedule – in line with project timeline and milestones.
Develop Commissioning and Start-up procedures.
Coordinate between the Engineering, construction, and Operation teams to ensure that all systems are installed, tested, verifying readiness for RFSU claims.
Manage completion Systemization and implementation to ensure works can progress methodically and efficiently.
Manage resources to ensure preparation and review of commissioning procedures, completions system and RLMs.
Ensure test records of all commissioning activities, including test results, reports, and any issues encountered are accurate and compiled in line with completions strategies.
Ensure all commissioning dossiers and documentation is completed, updated, and ready for review and handover.
Manage Commissioning vendor requirements/
Develop Work Execution Flow Scheme (WEFS).
Develop readiness and ORA documentation, PSSR, PSUA, SOF to support RFSU Certification claims.
Develop Commissioning Consumables list and commissioning spares list.
Develop and implement Project to Asset Transfer Plan (P2A) plan comprising of physical assets with system turnover team and the Information Management Documents
Drive the Flawless Project Delivery (FPD) with a focused ownership on the FPD deliverables specific for the CSU areas
Manage and support interface with the Asset’s Operations & Maintenance during start up and handover.

Experience required:

Minimum 20+ years of experience required
Minimum 14-15+ Years of experience in Oil & gas industry
10 years in Oil and  Gas Operations or Project Engineering positions, with experience in Commissioning & Start-up
Should have been a Manager for minimum 5+ years

Education:

Bachelor honours degree in a relevant engineering discipline from a recognised institution.

Preferred:

Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline.

Interested and suitable candidates please apply for the role. Suitable candidates will be contacted directly.
