These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design and engineering capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets."

Roles and Responsibilities:

The Planning Engineer will report to the Project Control Manager. 

Specific responsibilities include:

Developing and maintaining Project Execution Schedules including Level 1/2/3 schedules using tools like Primavera P6. Ensure alignment on project assumptions with cost engineering, cost estimation, risk management and project management.
Implement Schedule requirements of Company into the planning and cascade these to the contractors accordingly.
Coordinate with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to gather inputs for the master schedule.
Monitor progress and update schedules regularly to reflect actual performance.
Identifying trends or potential slippages and report on these to the Project Engineers or the Project Services Lead.
Producing regular reports on progress against schedule. Reporting schedule performance index (SPI)
Deliver and maintain consistent and realistic plans and control structures for the project. Understand the list of plans required to execute the assigned project sub-elements and their interface to other sub-elements. Develop the activities, durations as per productivity norms, logic, resources and progress for the assigned project sub-elements, leading to the creation of the baseline schedule and its subsequent maintenance.
Develop, implement and comply with the planning and progress monitoring procedures.
Conduct the schedule monthly progress update, forecast, critical path and trend analyses for assigned elements, including any impact from interface areas. Implement and maintain the status reports. Provide regular and comprehensive schedule status reports to project engineers.
Liaise with and challenge Project Engineering personnel to ensure proper understanding of the key schedule sensitivities and drivers.
Develop contract key dates, milestones and Project Hub plan dates that align with the overall project schedule.
Participate in evaluating bid schedules and reviewing and assessing contractor plans to support contract award recommendations.
Develop contract sections for planning and progress monitoring and reporting. Review, verify, assess contractors reported progress and ensure that this is reflected in the project schedule.
Contribute to the translation of the project’s risk profile into the probabilistic risk model and understand the output, including the key risk drivers for the possible range of schedule completion dates. Track the criticality of the main paths to completion and float consumption.
Provide input data for and participate in benchmarking activities.
Contribute to close-out data to enable knowledge retention (lessons learned, project data compilation) at completion of work

Bachelor’s Degree in an engineering discipline

Minimum 8 years experience in Oil and Gas Industry in Planning Engineer roles.
Minimum 5 years experience in Oil and Gas related project delivery related projects
Ability to work and manage in a multi-cultural environment with good understanding of cost estimation parameters to be considered in Middle East.
Skill to actively engage with different project disciplines
Ability to work and manage in a multi-cultural environment

Minimum Academic Requirements
Minimum 4 years Bachelor’s Engineering degree in Corrosion Science, Chemical, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline.
At least 15 years of experience in Cathodic Protection System in the Oil & Gas Industry.
10 years should have been spent in a senior engineering capacity as Technical Authority for Project Works related to Cathodic Protection System for Well Casing, Pipelines, Plant Piping Storage Tanks, Process Vessel and Concrete reinforced Structures.
AMPP NACE Level III Certification or an equivalent professional credential.
Fully conversant with AMPP & ISO Standards for Cathodic Protection System
About the Job

The selected candidate will closely work and liaise with the Project Team, and Integrity Project team taking responsibility for all technical aspects related to the Cathodic Protection (CP) System during the Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) execution phase. The role includes reviewing, supervision, testing, and approval of all elements of the CP System adhering to Project Specification and meeting applicable industry standards such as AMPP, ISO, and DNV. This encompasses the CP system design, installation activities, material datasheets, remote monitoring and control system commissioning, and handover procedures and activities. The selected candidate shall be required to work in both office and site-based execution of CP systems at all critical junctures during the Project in closed coordination and alignment with the COMPANY Integrity Project team – CP Specialist, Integrity Specialist.

Key Accountabilities
Ensure that CP systems are properly designed, installed, tested and commissioned in line with project requirements and integrity standards. 
Work closely with COMPANY Project Execution Team, and Contractor/ CP Subcontractor to align CP activities with overall project schedule and milestones. 
Interface with Integrity Project – CP Specialist to ensure CP design supports long-term asset integrity and corrosion control strategies as per approved code of practices and guidelines. 
Collaborate with Interface Management Team to resolve conflicts between CP systems and other disciplines (electrical, civil, mechanical) 
Review and approve all project deliverables submitted by the CP vendor, including design documents, material datasheets, Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), construction documentation, testing protocols, commissioning procedures, and startup operating guidelines.
Participating in the Pre-Design Site surveys jointly with EPC/ CP Contractor to align the Site Installation Schemes.
Represent the Company to ensure that all requirements are met according to the approved Inspection and Test Plan (ITP), including witnessing Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) for critical CP equipment.
Provide technical solutions for design changes, site issues, or unexpected corrosion challenges.
Review and approve Software and hardware application for Remote Monitoring & Control System for integrated CP System.
Review and validate Contractor Request for Inspection (RFI), IFC drawing and CONTRACTOR’s QA/QC documentation and test reports.
Provide technical solutions and responses to site-based technical queries and authorize necessary design deviations from project specifications due to site challenges or construction constraints in alignment with Integrity Project team.
Ensure all CP activities comply with COMPANY standards and regulatory requirements.
Prepare progress reports, technical evaluations, and recommendations for management
Supervise site work during crucial phases of CP system installation activities.
Maintain a full-time supervisory presence onsite during pre-commissioning testing, commissioning, and handover processes.
Review and Approve CP System commissioning, and Start Up reports
Ensure proper handover with as-built documentation and O&M manuals.

Belong, Connect, Grow, with KBR! 

Program Summary

KBR Government Solutions pioneers comprehensive professional and technical services, enhancing operational preparedness and fostering innovation across diverse domains. Our dedicated team propels global productivity, efficiency, and intrigue, offering an unparalleled opportunity to drive transformative change within the realm of DoD Fuel Management Systems. Join us on this journey toward greater impact and endless possibilities.

Job Summary

Are you passionate about delivering exceptional work with unwavering integrity? Step into the role of AFHE Maintenance Technician and become an indispensable part of our team.In this pivotal position, you will be at the forefront of maintaining, modifying, and installing Automated Fueling System Equipment (AFHE) across various sites and projects worldwide. Your dedication will directly contribute to the seamless operations crucial for Global Readiness & Sustainment of the United States Military.

We're not just meeting standards; we're exceeding them. As an AFHE Maintenance Technician, you'll join forces with like-minded professionals dedicated to excellence. Your meticulous attention to detail, coupled with your commitment to exceeding expectations, will drive our success forward.

Roles and Responsibilities 

Efficient Time and Resource Management: Strategically direct and manage the allocation of time and provided resources to meet demanding schedules, ensuring adherence to both KBR and stakeholder standards for quality and value.
Documentation Management: Diligently maintain and track maintenance documents and deliverables, ensuring timely submission to management for review and approval.
Customer Site Coordination: Organize, schedule, and execute high-quality work at customer sites, maintaining a standard of excellence in service delivery.
Stakeholder Engagement: Foster and sustain positive relationships with stakeholders, effectively engaging and collaborating with site personnel to achieve project objectives.
Install Industrial Control Systems: PLC panels (Programmable Logic Controllers), VFDs (Variable Frequency Drives), Control wiring (24VDC, 120VAC, analog, digital signals & modems, sensors, limit switches, encoders, HMI screens (Human-Machine Interfaces)
Troubleshoot Automation Equipment: PLC logic issues, faulty relays, sensors, or I/O modules, motor control problems, network or communication faults (Ethernet/IP, Modbus, Profinet).
Program or Modify Control Systems: Create or edit PLC ladder logic, function block, structured text, configure VFD parameters, update HMI graphics and process controls.
Additional Responsibilities: Undertake any other duties as assigned, demonstrating flexibility and adaptability in supporting organizational needs.
Must be able to lift ±40 lbs
Must be able to climb stairs to access heights of 20’ or greater
Must be able to perform physical duties such as kneeling, bending, and working in varied conditions to complete installations effectively.
Travel: This position has a 20% travel requirement.

Basic Qualifications 

Must be a US Citizen.
Must be able to pass a NACLC security background check.
Strong electrical knowledge (often more advanced than standard electricians)
Proficiency in troubleshooting  3 phase and single phase AC circuits, low voltage DC control circuits and various communication protocols including Modbus RTU and TCP/IP.
Ability to troubleshoot and maintain industrial network infrastructure including Ethernet and fiber optic networks
Experience with PLC programming (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Mitsubishi, Omron).
Ability to read, interpret, and verify control schematics, wiring diagrams, design drawings, P&IDs, ladder logic
Proficient with the use of hand tools and diagnostic equipment i.e. multimeters, process calibrators, and instrumentation calibration (pressure, flow, temp, level).
Strong understanding of analog and digital technology.
Understanding of NEC code and NFPA 70e & mechanical aptitudes (pneumatics, hydraulics)
Computer and Microsoft Windows proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

Preference for current possession of a government CAC.
Active or previous security clearance preferred.
Experience with Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems is a plus

In this pivotal role, you’ll provide expert guidance across projects and tenders, ensuring scope readiness and seamless collaboration between engineering, project operations, and offshore teams. Support the Equipment Assurance team by answering or clarifying operational queries related to pre-commissioning and Remote Intervention subjects.

 

Subject matter expert:

Regular audit from Company within ROV team (IMCA) to validate Subsea7 within all company.
Contribute with operational lessons learnt and share these with

The Principal Engineer will act as the Product Organisation’s representative for the Brazil region and will serve as the primary point of contact for all ICM product related activities, with particular focus on Mechanically Lined Pipe products.

Key responsibilities include providing technical and commercial product support for early engagement activities and project strategies, building and maintaining relationships with internal stakeholders, clients and suppliers, ensuring accurate technical communication, supporting product strategy definition, identifying and eliminating product cost of loss, providing support to Supply Chain Management, leading product development programmes and participating in Communities of Experts. Lead Product Development Programmes: Ensure new products are developed, and introduced to the market, in line with Company processes and product strategy.  In addition, lead product portfolio expansion projects such as new material selection and qualification.

title: Trainee Engineer - Rigid Pipelines
description:
About us

Leader mondial dans la réalisation de projets et services offshore pour le secteur de l’énergie, Subsea7 rend la transition énergétique en mer possible en participant au développement des énergies à faible émission en carbone, des énergies renouvelables et des énergies émergentes.

 

Nous créons de la valeur durable en fournissant les solutions de transition énergétique offshore dont le monde a besoin, pour aujourd'hui et pour demain.

 

Répartis sur les cinq continents, Subsea7 offre à ses 15 000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs des opportunités de carrière passionnantes qui leur permettent d’exprimer pleinement leurs talents et de participer à une aventure humaine hors du commun.

What will you be doing?

Vous serez intégré(e) à l'équipe Rigid Pipelines au sein du département Design & Analyses Engineering de Subsea7 GPC (Global Projects Centre). Ce département est responsable de l'ingénierie des pipelines sous-marins et des systèmes de raccordement pour les projets de construction offshore.

Dans les systèmes de pipelines sous-marins, et plus particulièrement au niveau de l'extrémité du pipeline (PLET), il est essentiel d'évaluer la distance entre la bride d'ancrage et le fond marin, surtout lorsque le PLET est situé à une profondeur importante. Cette analyse permet de s'assurer que la conduite n'est pas soumise à des contraintes excessives.

 

Pour garantir une conception sûre en termes de résistance et de fatigue, une enveloppe admissible est définie. Cette enveloppe délimite les angles et les élévations acceptables pour la bride d'ancrage, assurant ainsi que les charges et les dommages dus à la fatigue restent dans les limites admissibles.

Chaque point de cette enveloppe correspond à une analyse par éléments finis (EF) où l'intégrité du pipeline ou les dommages dus à la fatigue atteignent le seuil admissible.

Actuellement, ce processus est manuel et repose sur une méthode empirique pour identifier les limites critiques. Le modèle EF utilisé partage les mêmes hypothèses et données d'entrée que le modèle global utilisé pour l'analyse de la rugosité de fond.

 

Ce stage vise à étudier comment simplifier le modèle EF actuel sans compromettre sa précision ainsi qu’à automatiser la génération de l'enveloppe admissible, éliminant ainsi les itérations manuelles et améliorant l'efficacité de la conception.

 

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

 

Examiner et analyser le modèle EF actuel utilisé pour la génération de l'enveloppe.
Identifier les possibilités de simplification du modèle tout en conservant des résultats fiables.
Concevoir et mettre en œuvre un processus automatisé pour générer l'enveloppe admissible.
Développer des scripts ou des outils pour exécuter des simulations et compiler les résultats de manière autonome.
Valider l'approche automatisée en la comparant aux méthodes manuelles existantes.
Documenter la méthodologie et formuler des recommandations pour son intégration dans les flux de travail d'ingénierie.
What experience would we like you to have?
Étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs ou en master spécialisé en génie mécanique, génie offshore ou modélisation numérique
Maîtrise de l'analyse par éléments finis (par exemple, Abaqus, Ansys ou équivalent)
Compétences en programmation (Python, MATLAB ou équivalent) pour l'automatisation et le traitement des données
Intérêt pour les systèmes offshore, l'analyse de la fatigue et l'intégrité structurale
Esprit analytique, autonomie et proactivité dans la résolution de problèmes
Anglais courant obligatoire (langue de travail de l'équipe)

 

Location

Le stage est basé à Bois-Colombes (92).

 

Duration

6 mois

Subsea7 est fier d'être un employeur qui respecte l'égalité des chances et qui recrute tous les talents sans distinction de race, de genre, de religion, d’origine, d’orientation sexuelle, de handicap ou d’âge.

title: Materials and Corrosion Lead Engineer
description:
What will you be doing?

 

The Global Projects Centre (GPC) is Subsea 7's centre of excellence for the execution of its largest projects worldwide.
Subsea7 is hiring a Materials and Corrosion Lead Engineer  within the Materials, Welding and Coatings department where you will be responsible for providing support to projects and other departments for all questions pertaining to metallic materials (carbon steel, stainless steels, nickel base alloys) and corrosion (materials selection, CO2 corrosion, H2S corrosion, SCC).

This role provides exciting opportunities to be involved throughout all stages of projects with activities related to Flexibles, Rigid Flowlines, PIP, Subsea structures, Offshore/Onshore Fabrication and Installation.

 

Key Responsibilities:
•    Produce the material specifications for pipes, forgings, and bends.
•    Review and clarify offers received from pipes, bends, and forgings suppliers.
•    Responsible of the materials selection according to the corrosive environment and the project constraints.
•    Perform CO2 corrosion calculation.
•    Participate to meeting with Clients, Vendors and Suppliers, and interface with Client representatives as required for resolving any technical issues.
•    Support quality and SCM departments for supplier’s qualification.
•    Participate to the R & D activities on materials and corrosion.
•    Ensures effective communication is maintained with clients and other departments.

What experience would we like you to have?

 

Qualifications:

 

•    10 + years’ Experience in Oil and Gas.
•    Bachelor’s degree in Materials science or other degree in Engineering with focus on materials and corrosion.

 

Skills:


•    Good understanding of metallurgical and mechanical properties of metallic materials.
•    Experienced in providing materials support to procurement of line pipe, induction bends, forgings, and in the review of subcontractor procedures and documentation.
•    Experienced in oil and gas corrosion mechanisms (CO2 corrosion, H2S corrosion)
•    Experienced in corrosion calculation, Material Selection, Compatibility & Feasibility Design Report.
•    Have good level of familiarity of recognized industry codes and standards relevant to materials and welding discipline. (API 5L, DNV OS-F101, NORSOK, ASTM, NACE).
•    Basic/good understanding of welding processes, welding qualifications, NDT procedures (UT, MPI, DPI, RT) used during welding of components and fabrication of subsea structures.
•    Communicates effectively and articulately at all levels, internally and externally.
•    Demonstrates positive attitude and flexibility in work approach.
•    Risk focused and demonstrates good analytical skills when making decisions.
•    Commitment to self-improvement, education and development.
•    Demonstrate ability to manage interfaces with multi projects and functions in a multicultural environment.

They will be in charge to support and coordinate the electrical and instrumentation hook-up activities, onshore and offshore as well as oversee managing vendors and subcontractors and maintain good relationship with the client.

title: Principal Analysis Engineer (Pipeline Installation)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Principal Analysis Engineer (Pipeline Installation) to join our Pipeline Group (PG) team at our Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia office on a full-time, permanent basis.

 

The analysis engineering team within Pipeline Group are responsible for delivering fit for purpose rigid pipeline installation analysis to projects and/or tenders, with specific focus on safe and cost effective installation operations.

 

Our engineers are recognised for their expertise and at principal level management skills.  They can oversee a team of installation analysis project engineers, dealing with rigid pipeline installation analysis in project, FEED or tender.   They are responsible to the Analysis Team Lead for the efficient day-to-day management of the installation analysis team and provide regular operational reports on general project engineering activities, technical subject matters and resource management.

 

What will you be doing?

 

Perform in autonomy installation analysis of rigid pipeline in S-lay, J-lay and/or Reel-lay and be accountable for you, and in some cases depending on level a teams, scope of work.
Mentor and support junior engineers on their scopes of work
Responsible for ensuring that standard of engineering services provided complies with relevant company engineering standards with a clear focus on commerciality of engineering solutions.
Ensure installation analysis solution is fit for purpose while meeting client specifications.
Provide engineering support during operations with occasional periods offshore or on yard.
Promote safety culture and initiatives to the installation engineering team throughout the onshore and offshore delivery phases.
Participate actively to the Pipeline Group department know-how consolidation
Propose innovative solutions allowing cost & risks reduction.
What would we like you to have?

Please note, if you don’t tick all the boxes below but feel you have some of the relevant skills and experience, we’re looking for, please do consider applying. We would encourage you to apply with a CV that highlights your transferable skills and experience.

 

Degree qualified in a relevant engineering or similar subject
Demonstrable relevant experience (preferably in the Oil & Gas market but other relevant experience will be considered).
Proficient with Orcaflex and familiarity with systems such as Python, VBA and Abaqus
Good communication skills with ability to speak with all levels within the business.  Comfortable working individually and as part of a team.
Excellent report writing skills with the ability to self-check and produce accurate work, as well as the ability prioritise and organise work accordingly to meet deadlines set by management.
This role may involve short spells of overseas travel so candidates may need to show a willingness and flexibility to meet these requirements.

title: Material Planner II 1
description:
Job Purpose

In line with TechnipFMC Global Planning Processes and Policies, as well as local Planning Procedures, provide Material Planning analysis and support to the Manufacturing Organization.

The Planner will support the Manufacturing Organization, monitoring and expediting Material Demand, influencing Material Supply Strategy, performing Material Planning and offering Material Analysis, Interpretation & Intervention in support of Master Production Schedule commitments.

Job Description

MAIN ACCOUNTABILITIES:

•    Create and review any new material master extension or any material master change in the S4 HANA system for externally procured or subcontracted materials within their responsibility.
•    Validate use of project vs common stock following financial standards and procurement strategy.
•    Work in commodity planning in conjunction with procurement and engineering to define strategy per commodity. Act on standardization, stocking and order quantity initiatives with the goal to ensure material is available on time to site needs, managing inventory levels and seeking optimum costs and lead times.
•    Work in conjunction with sourcing and procurement teams to define the planning strategy for all materials under their responsibility. Interact with buyers to mitigate any possible deviations to the plan. 
•    Plan externally Procured material by Developing, executing, and Analyzing MRP and initiate actions to drive actions and manage exceptions.
•    Release purchase requisitions to buyers, when required, so they can execute procurement of the material.
•    Provide progress reports for materials being externally procured, keeping Master Schedulers, Project Delivery Planners and Production Planners informed about any risks associated to the plan.
•    Implementation and execution of Consumption Based Planning.
•    Ensure proper management of inventory levels, based on the planned activity levels, and mix of products and maximize inventory turns by reducing excess, optimizing strategic stock and planning for the right time.
•    Capable of processing Engineering Changes (ECN’s), from all plants, in Supporting Plant while checking that all information is accurate and complete to ensure all plant data accurately reflects S4 HANA/TCE data.
•    Maintain the accuracy of plant material masters and bills of materials for materials under their responsibility in line with changes issued by engineering by issuing requested changes to all relevant departments and checking all demand is correct once changes are carried out.
•    Provide support, guidance and training to colleagues and other functions related to material management processes.
•    Minimize logistic cost by developing a distribution plan to support all sites with demand for the referred material.
•    Control material allocation, when restriction in supply chain, and escalate when a conflict exists.
•    Participate in KPIs, Obeya routines, and reporting cycles.
•    Contribute to cross-functional process improvement initiatives to enhance execution efficiency.
•    Strengthen the global Planning community: build competencies, share best practices, foster collaboration, participate on Networks and promote knowledge exchange across teams driving the organization to an SSI environment.
•    Identify and/or contribute to global planning improvement initiatives aligned with the TechnipFMC strategy, with a focus on Lean methodology.
•    Promote the effective and diverse use of systems to simplify execution and increase operational visibility.

You are meant for this job if:

Qualifications (professional, technical, academic)
•    Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, Planning, Supply Chain.

Experience/Skills/Knowledge
•    Minimum of 3 to 6 years of relative planning experience
•    A working knowledge of Manufacturing
•    Appreciation and understanding of the Engineering Execution Process (EEP)
•    Practical understanding of Engineering BOM’s and documents
•    Demonstrated ability to analyze trends or deviations from standards and recommend creative and unique cross functional solutions
•    Demonstrates an understanding of the communication process and ensures effectiveness (written, verbal and listening) across functional boundaries.
•    Prepares and delivers somewhat simple proposals and reports to planning audience.
•    Ability to work under pressure in a matrixed environment. 
•    Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
•    Open to give and receive constructive feedback. 
•    Good workload management and organization skills. 
•    Confident in hosting meetings and presentation skills. 

Technical/General Competencies
•    Proficient in SAP S4 Hana
•    Microsoft Excel (Advanced user)
•    Data analysis
•    Developing and using KPIs

Additional Skills

Nice to have: 
•    Subsea Construction planning
•    Good knowledge and experience of Operations/Manufacturing activities
•    Good knowledge and experience of Energy industry
•    Good knowledge and experience of Planning
•    Advanced S4 Hana Planning systems & transactions skills preferred
•    Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project
•    Desired APICS CPIM Certification
•    Desired PMP Certification
•    Experience of Subsea industry preferred.
•    Experience and / or Certifications in Lean Six Sigma preferred
•    Technical background a plus.
•    Utilizes systemic thinking to solve cross functional system level problems utilizing preventative measures.

Skills
Data Analysis
Planning

title: Lead Engineer I - Surface
description:
Job Purpose

This is an individual contributor position in Surface Technologies, Hyderabad.

The role is responsible for executing activities assigned by the manager and execute it with the assigned team.

Will work on assigned teams based on experience and business need: Project Engineering for Surface Americas or Surface international, Product Development and qualification testing, Product standardization.

Job Description

Leads project engineering, new product/technology development, product improvement and product standardization, and product qualification projects depending upon business need.

Serves as a technical point of contact for assigned project or product scope and serve as a focal point for all communications related to scope.

Assess project needs and balance them with the product line standardization strategies to reduce project execution risk.

Develops product design, geometry standards documentation and product qualification requirements.

Responsible for quality and on-time-delivery of assigned project.

Creates, reviews part reports, drawings, engineering specifications and standards per customer requirements and industry standards.

Supports and manage project schedule and deliverables.

Provides Management with technical assistance and work progress updates as requested.

Mentors and provides technical guidance to Product Engineers and Designers/Drafters. Works collaboratively to accomplish project tasks. Provides independent review and approval of work packages.

Provides vendors technical assistance and builds strong working relationships.

Works to the requirements of industry code related to Surface wellhead systems, TechnipFMC standards and client specifications.

Adheres to all relevant work instructions and design guidelines, clearly demonstrates creativity and innovation in finding solutions and alternatives.

Develops unique solutions for complex technical problems that may include the design of new products/systems or the development of solutions having few or no precedents.

You are meant for this job if:

Degreed Mechanical Engineer with at least 8-years of Engineering experience in the Surface wellhead systems, reduced to 6-years for Masters/PhD candidates.

Demonstrated experience in supporting engineering for surface projects constrained by safety, quality, delivery, and cost requirements.

Experience in reviewing & approving engineering designs, documents, layouts, calculations, and interpreting FEA/ structural analysis results.

Strong knowledge of engineering discipline and physical modeling techniques (solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, heat transfer) is required. Experience conducting design analysis - hoop stress, flexibility, buckling, burst, fatigue, etc.

Work experience must include experience with API 6A, NACE MR 0175. Good to have knowledge for ASME, API 6FA, API 5CT, ASME 31.3 as it relates to surface equipment design and manufacturing.

Exposure to various manufacturing processes - forging, hot and cold extrusion, cladding, HIP, induction bending etc.

Exposure to welding codes and practices - ASME IX and API 1104.

Exposure to NDE codes and practices - UT, PAUT, PT, RT, MPI per ASME V

Identify and implement opportunities for waste reduction, process optimization, and standard work as part of Lean initiatives.
Participate in SSI activities, including hazard identification, risk mitigation, and safety audits.

Document all activities, observations, and results in lab notebooks or digital systems.
Follow safety protocols and handle chemicals and equipment responsibly.

High school diploma or technical certification; associate degree in materials science, chemistry, or related field preferred.
2+ years of experience in elastomer mixing and/or molding, preferably in a lab or R&D environment.
Familiarity with rubber compounding, curing systems, and molding techniques.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

The Project Document Controller play a vital role in ensuring the success of the project by ensuring that all project documentation is accurate, complete, and up to date.  By effectively managing and controlling project documentation.   The role supports the quality engineers, and autonomously performs quality related tasks within the scope of the accountabilities.   The role ensures that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. Manage and control all project documentation throughout the project lifecycle. title: Principal Engineer - MV/HV Cable Design
description:
Introduction

The post holder will play a key role in TechnipFMC renewables product development directly for the Dynamic Inter Array Cable System (DIAC) for Floating Offshore Wind and it is  expected they will work closely with New Energies.


This role is placed in a dedicated Research & Development team with a strong technical focus - the development and maintenance of MV/HV submarine cable products and power cable elements in hybrid power umbilical products. 


In general, the Research & Development function at TechnipFMC is responsible for the development of Umbilical and Power Cable products and their components providing focused niche technical guidance in Polymers, Metallurgy, Electrical Engineering, Cable/Umbilical Handling and Product Analysis; we contribute to the direction, co-ordination and implementation of the development of TechnipFMC products.

 

The role can be based in Newcastle, Aberdeen or Dunfermline.

Job Purpose

 

We are seeking a Principal Engineer - MV/HV Cable Design to join our R&D team.

Acting as a technical authority and responsible for leading the design, development and maintenance of both MV/HV submarine cable products for offshore wind and power cable elements within hybrid power umbilical system, in-line with TechnipFMC's New Product Development and Product Life Maintenance procedures. Responsible for the technical deliverables for R&D projects and providing technical support and guidance across the R&D function and to other teams, where appropriate. Responsible for setting and maintaining design rules, technical standards and associated documentation requirements. Ultimately strengthening the company’s position in the marketplace, reduce costs, improving quality and increasing its product and capabilities portfolio.

Job Description

•    At technical authority level, to provide technical leadership within the R&D team regarding MV/HV submarine cables. This may include but is not limited to;
                      ▪ Leading, managing, delivering and documenting specific R&D projects.
                      ▪ The development and maintenance of cable design rules.
                      ▪ Setting standards for technical reports and documentation.
                      ▪ Conducting appropriate cable design calculations studies.
                      ▪ Liaising with internal & external clients and suppliers (as appropriate).
•    To provide technical support and guidance the wider R&D team and others (as appropriate) throughout the life cycle of the product, including but not limited to;
                      ▪ Technical risk identification and client specification reviews
                      ▪ Non-conformances / Design rule and project concessions
                      ▪ Complex client technical queries and their solutions
•    Responsible for supporting, and where appropriate leading, the development and integration of new technologies, templates, calculations and tools to improve efficiency and quality. 
•    On job training and mentorship of engineers at all levels. 
•    Where appropriate and as directed, take actions to comply with the group/team expectations to meet their objectives. 

You are meant for this job if:

Essential
•    Degree or equivalent in an Engineering discipline – preferably Electrical or Mechanical Engineering; a Physics degree may also be suitable. Chartered Engineer Status or demonstrable ability to apply within a reasonable time frame.
•    Extensive relevant experience of high voltage submarine cables in the offshore wind and/or oil & gas sectors, encompassing detailed cable system design, research & development and cable manufacturing processes. 
•    Strong relevant knowledge of submarine cable constructions, designs, ratings, limits, manufacturing, installation and operation; proficient with tools, methods and industry best practice regarding design and manufacture; familiarity with client documentation requirements and processes.
•    Significant knowledge of relevant industry standards relating to submarine cable design, qualification, testing and the wider offshore wind/subsea industry; experience of interpretation and application of appropriate IEC standards and CIGRE recommendations.
•    Demonstrable experience of problem solving and working in high pace environments. 
•    Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
•    Proficient in Microsoft office tool such as word, excel and PowerPoint
Desirable
•    A higher degree: MEng or higher in relevant subject.
•    Publishing technical papers and or participation in industry forums and events such as CIGRE working groups or conferences.
•    Experience delivering against challenging schedules in a project management environment; proficient in client interaction and acting as a technical authority.
•    Knowledge of HV submarine cable testing (including factory, laboratory, type, R&D, offshore aspects) and offshore installation practices.
•    Experience with engineering tools such as MathCAD or equivalent and or cable specific design and rating tools such as CYMCAP.
•    Familiarity or experience in Finite Element Analysis tools such as COMSOL is not required but beneficial.
•    Experience implementing R&D processes and practices with a drive for improvement.

What we offer
My Annual Leave - 25 days + 8 fixed public holidays.
My Wealth and Protection – Critical Illness Cover, Income Protection, Life Assurance, Will Writing, Workplace Isa, Group Personal Pension Plan - employer contributions up to 10%.
My Health and Wellbeing - Private Medical Insurance, Employee Assistance Programme, Dental Insurance, Health Assessments & Personal Accident Insurance.

title: Electro-Thermal Analysis Specialist - MV/HV Cables
description:
Introduction

The post holder will play a key role in TechnipFMC renewables product development directly for the Dynamic Inter Array Cable System (DIAC) for Floating Offshore Wind and it is  expected they will work closely with New Energies.


This role is placed in a dedicated Research & Development team with a strong technical focus - the development and maintenance of MV/HV submarine cable products and power cable elements in hybrid power umbilical products. 


In general, the Research & Development function at TechnipFMC is responsible for the development of Umbilical and Power Cable products and their components providing focused niche technical guidance in Polymers, Metallurgy, Electrical Engineering, Cable/Umbilical Handling and Product Analysis; we contribute to the direction, co-ordination and implementation of the development of TechnipFMC products.

 

The role can be based in Newcastle, Aberdeen or Dunfermline.

Job Purpose

We are seeking a Electro-Thermal Analysis Specialist - MV/HV Cables to join our R&D team.

An expert in electro-thermal analysis and responsible for developing, maintaining and verifying electro-thermal calculation strategies, methodologies and tools along with their associated documentation for TechnipFMC MV/HV submarine cable products for offshore wind and power cable elements in hybrid power umbilical systems. Responsible for conducting electrical, thermal, and coupled electro-thermal studies and related R&D projects to support business objectives, providing technical support and guidance across the R&D function and to other teams, where appropriate. Working closely with other members of the R&D team to strengthen the company’s position in the marketplace, reduce costs, improving quality and increase its product and capabilities portfolio.

•    At expert level providing technical leadership and services regarding electro-thermal analysis for the MV/HV cable product groups. This may include but is not limited to;

                      ▪ The development and maintenance of cable rating strategies and methods.

title: Senior Engineer - Surface
description:
Job Purpose

The Senior Product Improvement Engineer is responsible for execution of product design improvement activities arising from feedback on field performance, ease of manufacturing, assembly & testing and ease of installation & retrieval of the product. Improvement Engineer participates in RCA investigations and initiates the necessary corrective & prevention actions. Improvement Engineer assists the Improvement Lead in the implementation of new processes, tools, improvement activities like information flow, risk management, value stream mapping, LPPD behaviors and thinking.

Job Description

• Executes engineering projects & tasks that have complex problem-solving situations. Applies problem-solving frameworks, techniques and tools, and when to drive and influence investigations.

• Supports product improvement and product standardization and product qualification projects depending upon the assigned group.

• Using LPPD and transformational thinking, defines a simplified future state Operating System for Engineering Management and optimum operating processes and tools for engineering staff (GD3, Readiness Levels etc.)

• Uses analytical and risk evaluation tools to expose root causes and defines countermeasures.

• Operates with a continuous improvement mindset, remains isolated from firefighting.

• Responsible for listening to learn, consults experts where appropriate.

• Challenges the norm, rejects the status quo, while educating and inspiring the team to support continuous improvement.

Additional Description

• Serves as a technical point of contact for assigned work package scope and may serve as a focal point for all communications related to scope.

• Develops product design, geometry standards documentation and product qualification requirements.

• Creates, reviews/approves part reports, drawings, engineering specifications and standards.

• Defines product quality, material, welding, and NDE requirements.

• Supports and manage project schedule and deliverables.

• Provides Management with technical assistance and work progress updates as requested.

• Mentors and provides technical guidance to Junior Engineers and Designers/Drafters. Works collaboratively to accomplish project tasks. Provides independent review and approval of work packages.

• Provides vendors technical assistance and builds strong working relationships.

• Works to the requirements of industry code related to surface production systems, TechnipFMC standards and client specifications.

• Adheres to all relevant work instructions and design guidelines, clearly demonstrates creativity and innovation in finding solutions and alternatives.

• Develops unique solutions for complex technical problems that may include the design of new products/systems or the development of solutions having few or no precedents.

• This is an individual contributor position. The role is responsible for executing activities assigned by the manager and execute it with the assigned team.

You are meant for this job if:

• Degreed Mechanical Engineer with at least 6-years of Product Design Engineering experience preferably in upstream Oil & Gas industry, reduced to 4-years for Masters/PhD candidates.

• Demonstrated experience in supporting engineering for Oil & Gas projects constrained by safety, quality, delivery, and cost requirements.

• Product engineering experience in design of Surface Oil & Gas products like Wellheads, Christmas Trees (XT) Gate Valves, Actuators, Chokes, Ball Valves etc. will be added benefit.

• Alternate industry background that are relevant for this position: Heavy Engineering, Power Plant Engineering, Boilers & Pressure Vessels, Large Bore Valve Engineering etc.

• Experience in reviewing & approving engineering designs, documents, layouts, calculations and interpreting FEA/ structural analysis results.

• Good knowledge of engineering discipline and physical modeling techniques (solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, heat transfer) is required. Experience conducting design analysis - hoop stress, flexibility, buckling, burst, fatigue, etc.

• Work experience must include experience with various ASME, API and NACE Codes and Standards as it relates to surface equipment design and manufacturing.

• Exposure to various manufacturing processes - forging, hot and cold extrusion, cladding, HIP, induction bending etc.

• Exposure to welding codes and practices - ASME IX and API 1104.

• Exposure to NDE codes and practices - UT, PAUT, PT, RT, MPI per ASME V.

Project Execution
Problem-solving Tools and Continuous Improvement Techniques
Design Review Process - SSE Eng.

title: Service Project Manager
description:
Job Purpose

Join us as a Service Project Manager at our Altens site in Aberdeen, where you’ll play a central role in driving high‑quality service delivery across our well-established energy operations. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys leading teams, building strong customer relationships, and taking full ownership of project success from start to finish.

In this role, you will lead a dedicated service project team—including FST Supervisors, Technicians assigned to your projects, and key support functions—to ensure seamless execution and delivery. You’ll be the primary point of contact for customers across all service and aftermarket activities, representing the company with professionalism and commercial awareness.

As a Service Project Manager, you’ll oversee the commercial, operational, logistical, risk, financial, and scheduling aspects of each project, working with a clear goal: delivering safe, efficient, and successful outcomes for your customers. It’s a dynamic position where no two days are the same, and your leadership will directly influence customer satisfaction and overall project performance.

Job Description

General Responsibilities

Responsible for ensuring that all assigned work tasks are performed in accordance with TechnipFMC policies and HSEQ requirements.
Report project performance to Service Management monthly and inform them in the event that business critical decisions must be made.
The contractual point of contact to the customer responsible for all Service and Aftermarket activities.
Shall fulfil the role of project leader, managing a dedicated service project team daily.
Lead by example, actively promote, and contribute to a positive working environment with your colleagues within your service project team and towards your colleagues within other departments.
Responsible for managing the commercial terms (contract), schedule (forecast and FST planning), offshore operations, onshore storage, risk, financial performance and all project deliverables.
Responsible for cost control within projects and maintaining a forecast for project revenue which must be updated monthly.
Responsible for ensuring risk management is implemented with the project, record, monitor and manage all risks via TechnipFMC Risk Management tool.
Responsible for ensuring all project meetings are scheduled and executed as required. For example: project kick-off meetings, pre-job meetings, section close out meetings, risk management meetings etc.
Responsible for inventory control offshore, including stock count and/or inventory checks.
Responsible for active contribution towards the Service and Aftermarket department objectives.
Actively promote and work in accordance with TechnipFMC’s core values.
Long Description

Main Tasks

Achieve a full and detailed understanding of your assigned customer contract.
Attend internal and external customer meetings on location, prepare and give presentations regarding project performance as required.
Ensure a project kick-off meeting is conducted with all service project team and supporting functions for every project to review scope of work, set clear expectations, and project milestones.
Ensure all team members fully understand their role and responsibility within the service project team.
Provide guidance, direction and support to your service project team daily as required both onshore and offshore
Provide a long term (12 month) FST forecast demand to the FST department and update monthly.
Ensure that all operational documents and templates utilised for execution of project objectives are in accordance with the BPMS or revision controlled LWI’s
Ensure weekly service project meetings are scheduled to review checklists for upcoming operations.
Coordinate all EFNCR’s, SN’s and QN’s related to your project as required.
Ensure that pre-job meetings with FST Supervisors are conducted and documented ahead of starting a new project and during every crew change.
Ensure that all spare parts and consumables used offshore are recorded and billed accordingly.
Create PR’s required for service project execution in line with DoA.
Ensure that section close out meetings are conducted and documented after every section.
Notify hardware PM regarding installed equipment for invoicing purposes after each section close out meeting were applicable.
Monitoring financial performance monthly: revenue vs. budget, cost of sales and GM: together with finance.
Responsible for on time invoicing for all project deliverables.
Provide customer reports, maintain and monitor customer KPI in line with contractual obligations.
Identify and seek opportunities to generate additional services.
Providing variation orders and/or quotation to customer for additional services as required.
Provide key input to help develop and continuously improve local department processes and procedures in line with GBPMS.
You are meant for this job if:

Qualifications/Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent technical background (relevant experience may substitute).
Project Management experience.
Oil & gas experience in a relevant role (e.g., Service Technician, Field Engineer, Wellhead/XT Engineer, System Engineer, Project Engineer) working with surface equipment
Solid understanding of surface wellhead equipment, tooling, and accessories.
Knowledge of industry standards (API, ISO, NORSOK).
Experience with SAP.
Understanding of refurbishment and recertification processes (QCPs, ITPs).
Familiarity with lean tools (preferably 5S).
Strong risk management awareness.
Financial and commercial understanding.
Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio)

 

Interpersonal Skills

Strong written and verbal English communication.
Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and meeting‑leadership skills.
Proactive mindset; able to give/receive constructive feedback.
Comfortable working within diverse cultural environments.
Customer‑focused with the ability to handle dissatisfaction pragmatically.
Strong team player with the ability to prioritise workload and work under pressure.

 

Technical & Problem Solving Skills

Structured, logical, and pragmatic approach to planning and issue resolution.
Flexible and adaptable in changing environments.
Capable of developing and improving processes, policies, and procedures.
Strong analytical skills and ability to apply problem‑solving techniques effectively.

Assist in updating/improving MPM service related technical procedures, tools and techniques.

Update and maintain internal tracking and recording systems.
Adherence to industry standards.
Actively ensures that the personal health & safety of self and co-workers are preserved at all times.
You are meant for this job if:
Degreed Petroleum or Chemical Engineer with at least 3-years of Engineering experience in the Oil & Gas Industry or job experience equivalent.
Extensive knowledge of hydrocarbon chemistry, fluid dynamics, fluid modelling, PVT and fluid behavior. Advanced user of PVT modelling software (Multiflash, PVTSim, etc.).
Experience with operation of multiphase metering, PVT sampling / modelling, production analysis and operation an advantage.

Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to effectively transfer subject matter expertise. Good communication skills in Spanish and Portuguese languages an advantage.
Excellent organization and customer service skills.

Ability to travel on short notice; some international travel may be required.
Demonstrated proficiency to work in cross-functional, multi-cultural teams.
Pro-active, initiative driven approach and willingness to contribute with new ideas.
Accuracy, dependability, ability to manage schedule and prioritize work for self and others in team, a self-motivated self-starter.

Spends 50-70% time in an office environment and 30-50% in shop or field environment supporting onshore/offshore activities.  May be exposed to possible hazards including working with high-pressure equipment, high noise, inclement weather, chemicals, pressure testing, heavy lift operations and shop/field traffic.  Some travel (international and domestic) as necessary visiting TechnipFMC regional offices, plants and makes visits to existing and potential customer’s facilities and field installations as required.

Job Purpose

The Global Rotational Graduate program blends formal training with hands-on experience, real design work, and professional development. I Kristiansunds avdelingen vår gjennomfører vi service og vedlikehold på Subsea utstyr til offshore installasjoner for nord områdene. I velutstyrte og moderne verkstedbygg jobber dyktige teknikere og ingeniører sammen for å levere det beste til kundene våre hver dag. title: Engineer II - Flexibles & Umbilicals
Material Planner III
description:
Job Purpose

In line with the Global Planning Processes and Policies, as well as local Planning Procedures, provide Material Planning analysis and support to the Manufacturing (REMS) Organization.

The Planner will support the REMS Organization, monitoring and expediting Material Demand, influencing Material Supply Strategy, performing Material Planning and offering Material Analysis, Interpretation & Intervention in support of Master Production Schedule(s) commitments.

The planner will provide advice and guidance to other functions related to Material Management.

The Planner is responsible and/or accountable for:

·    Engineering Change Management
·    Manage Master data in S4 HANA
·    Execute MRP manually or via S4 HANA in order to identify demand, inventory and supply needed
·    Material Planning
·    Consumption Based Planning
·    Support Product Standardization /Utilization
·    Plan externally procured materials
·    Manage Exceptions / Deviations to the plan for externally procured materials
·    Manage Inventory Levels
·    Maximize inventory turns
·    Minimize logistic costs by developing a distribution logic
·    Control material allocation and escalate when a conflict exists.

The Planner will have a good understanding of the activities and equipment associated with Materials under their sphere of influence.

Job Description

•    Create and review any new material master extension or any material master change in the S4 HANA system for externally procured or subcontracted materials within their responsibility.

•    Validate use of project vs common stock following financial standards and procurement strategy

•    Work in commodity planning in conjunction with procurement and engineering to define strategy per commodity. Act on standardization, stocking and order quantity initiatives with the goal to ensure material is available on time to site needs, managing inventory levels and seeking optimum costs and lead times.

•    Work in conjunction with sourcing and procurement teams to define the planning strategy for all materials under their responsibility. Interact with buyers to mitigate any possible deviations to the plan 

•    Plan externally Procured material by Developing, executing, and Analyzing MRP and initiate actions to drive actions and manage exceptions

•    Release purchase requisitions to buyers, when required, so they can execute procurement of the material.

•    Provide progress reports for materials being externally procured, keeping Master Schedulers, Project Delivery Planners and Production Planners informed about any risks associated to the plan

•    Implementation and execution of Consumption Based Planning.

•    Ensure proper management of inventory levels, based on the planned activity levels, and mix of product and maximize inventory turns by reducing excess, optimizing strategic stock and planning for the right time

•    Capable of processing Engineering Changes (ECN’s), from all plants, in Supporting Plant while checking that all information is accurate and complete to ensure all plant data accurately reflects S4 HANA/TCE data.
•    Maintain the accuracy of plant material masters and bills of materials for materials under their responsibility in line with changes issued by engineering by issuing requested changes to all relevant departments and checking all demand is correct once changes are carried out.
•    Provide support, guidance and training to colleagues and other functions related to material management processes
•    Minimize logistic cost by developing a distribution plan to support all sites with demand for the referred material.
•    Control material allocation, when restriction in supply chain, and escalate when a conflict exists.

You are meant for this job if:

Qualifications:

•    Minimum Degree Level preferred in Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, Planning, Supply Chain.
•    Minimum of 6 to 9 years of relative planning experience
•    Understanding of Lean manufacturing and processes
•    Appreciation and understanding of the and the Engineering Execution Process (EEP)
•    Practical understanding of Engineering BOM’s

Technical
•    Proficient in S4 Hana
•    Microsoft Excel (Advanced user)
•    Data analysis
•    Developing and using KPIs

 Nice to have:

•    Planning qualification and/or experience
•    Subsea Construction Planning
•    Good knowledge and experience of Operations/Manufacturing activities
•    Good knowledge and experience of Energy industry
•    Good knowledge and experience of Planning
•    Advanced S4 HANA Planning systems & transactions skills preferred
•    Desired APICS CPIM Certification
•    Experience of Subsea industry preferred.
•    Experience and / or Certifications in Lean Six Sigma preferred
•    Technical background a plus.
•    Utilizes systemic thinking to solve cross functional system level problems utilizing preventative measures.

Skills
Planning

title: Workshop Technician
description:
Job Purpose

We are looking for a Workshop Technician to join our team located in Veenoord / Nieuw-Amsterdam (The Netherlands).  This role of a Workshop Technician executes inspection, repair and/or maintenance activities for TechnipFMC and/or customer equipment in the workshop in line with Quality strategy, TechnipFMC Policies, Quality management system processes/procedures, customers/ legal/applicable industry standards requirements. In this position you report to the workshop manager who is the main vocal point for the workshop internally and externally.

 

We zoeken een Workshop Technician om ons team in Veenoord / Nieuw-Amsterdam (Nederland) te versterken. De rol van een Workshop Technician omvat het uitvoeren van inspectie-, reparatie- en/of onderhoudsactiviteiten voor TechnipFMC en/of klantapparatuur in de werkplaats in lijn met de kwaliteitsstrategie, TechnipFMC-beleid, processen/procedures van het kwaliteitsmanagementsysteem, vereisten van klanten en wettige toepasbare industriestandaarden. In deze functie rapporteer je aan de werkplaatsmanager, die het belangrijkste aanspreekpunt is voor de werkplaats intern en extern.

Job Description
Assembles and tests assemblies according to specifications. Masters basic skills and some advanced skills in procedures, techniques, tools, materials and/or equipment in the area of expertise
Completes required test documentation including test reports, failed test reports and NCRs
Cleans components after assembly according to FMCTI specifications and verbal/written instructions
Uses material handling equipment to move parts, components and sub-assemblies from one work or storage area to another as required
Collects and inputs information in specific systems for cost tracking purposes
Performs all duties in a safe manner and keeps all employees aware of dangers in work area
Assists more experienced Assembly Technicians as assigned
Disassembling and cleaning of equipment and tools
Perform inspections of equipment and tools
Create inspection reports
Assembling of equipment and tools
Pressure testing of equipment and tools
Execute refurbishment and maintenance to equipment and tools
Execute the logistic movements dedicated to preparation, execution and finishing your work orders
Practices good housekeeping in assigned area and properly disposes of waste according to health, safety, and environmental policies
Promptly reports any operational problems or Quality / Safety issues with machinery, tools, or equipment to the Workshop Manager (and record in local Start card system).

 

Functieomschrijving

Monteert en test assemblages volgens specificaties. Beheerst basisvaardigheden en enkele gevorderde vaardigheden in procedures, technieken, gereedschappen, materialen en/of apparatuur in het expertisegebied.
Voltooit vereiste testdocumentatie, inclusief testrapporten en NCR's.
Reinigt componenten na montage volgens FMCTI specificaties en mondelinge/schriftelijke instructies.
Gebruikt kraan of heftruck om onderdelen, componenten en subassemblages van het ene werk- of opslaggebied naar het andere te verplaatsen.
Verzamelt en voert informatie in specifieke systemen in voor kostenregistratiedoeleinden.
Voert alle taken op een veilige manier uit en houdt alle werknemers op de hoogte van gevaren op de werkplek.
Demonteert en reinigt apparatuur en gereedschappen.
Voert inspecties van apparatuur en gereedschappen uit.
Maakt inspectierapporten.
Assembleert apparatuur.
Voert (hoge) druktesten uit op apparatuur.
Voert revisie- en onderhoudswerkzaamheden uit aan apparatuur.
Voert logistieke bewegingen uit die zijn toegewezen aan de voorbereiding, uitvoering en afronding van je werkorders.
Bewaakt orde en netheid in het toegewezen gebied en verwijdert afval op een correcte manier volgens het gezondheids-, veiligheids- en milieubeleid.
Meldt onmiddellijk operationele problemen of kwaliteits-/veiligheidsproblemen met machines, gereedschap of apparatuur aan de werkplaatsmanager (en registreert deze in het lokale Startkaart-systeem).
 
You are meant for this job if:
(V)MBO/TL Technik or similar
Experience, preferably in Energy industry
Adequate language skills in Dutch and English (both verbal and writing)
Experience working in a workshop or technical environment
Experience to work with hand tools, power tools etc.
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)
Ability to demonstrate flexibility and adapt to a constantly changing environment

 

Je bent geknipt voor deze baan als je

(V)MBO/TL Techniek of vergelijkbaar hebt.
Ervaring hebt, bij voorkeur in de energie-industrie.
Voldoende taalvaardigheden hebt in het Nederlands en Engels (zowel mondeling als schriftelijk).
Ervaring hebt met werken in een werkplaats of technische omgeving.
Ervaring hebt met handgereedschap, elektrisch gereedschap, etc.
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) kunt gebruiken.
Flexibiliteit kunt tonen en kunt aanpassen aan een voortdurend veranderende omgeving.
Uitstekende communicatie- en interpersoonlijke vaardigheden.
Moet een teamspeler zijn, maar in staat zijn om zelfstandig te werken aan meer gevarieerde en complexe taken met beperkte supervisie om succesvol aan de verwachtingen te voldoen.
In staat zijn om onder druk te werken.
Groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en de overtuiging dat veiligheid voorop staat.
In staat zijn om activiteiten te prioriteren in overleg met de werkplaatsmanager.
In staat zijn om constructieve feedback en coaching te geven en te ontvangen en hier gepast op te reageren.
Gedrag vertonen dat consistent is met de Gedragscode van TechnipFMC, de visie en kernwaarden.
 
Interpersonal Skills
Excellent communication & interpersonal skills ·
Must be a team player, however be able to work independently on more varied and complex tasks with limited supervision to successfully meet the expectations
Ability to be able to work under pressure
Great sense of responsibility and belief that safety comes first
Ability to prioritize activities in consultation with workshop manager
Ability to give and receive constructive feedback and coaching and respond appropriately
Demonstrate behavior that is consistent with TechnipFMC’s Code of business Conduct, vision and core values
Wat wij bieden

Wij bieden je een carrière in een ambitieuze, internationale, sociaal en financieel solide organisatie. We zullen investeren in coaching, mentoring en ondersteunen bij je professionele ontwikkeling.

Expertise in digital electronic design including high speed, serial communication interfaces (CAN, RSXXX, I2C, SPI, USB), control, processor, network interface design on SoC platforms.

Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, network analyzers, communication analyzers, signal generators, and simulators.

Experience in embedded hardware design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to embedded controller design in control system applications.

title: Head of Power Cable Technologies
description:
Job Purpose

At TechnipFMC, we’re pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in Floating Offshore Wind — and we’re looking for a visionary engineer to help lead the charge. As a key member of our dedicated R&D team, you’ll play a central role in developing cutting‑edge Medium and High Voltage subsea power cable systems for our Dynamic Inter Array Cable System (DIAC). Working closely with our New Energies business segment, you’ll drive innovation from concept to qualification, helping us deliver world‑leading integrated solutions that will define the future of offshore wind.

 

This position is open to candidates based in a range of locations, and we welcome applications from talented engineers regardless of where they are currently located. For those interested in the role whom are not based at our Newcastle hub, occasional travel may be required to collaborate with the local team, support testing activities, and contribute to key project milestones.

 

If you’re passionate about engineering excellence, excited by complex technical challenges, and driven to make a real impact in the renewable energy transition, this is your opportunity to step into a pivotal role at the forefront of industry change.

Job Description

As a High-Medium Voltage Subsea Power Cable Chief Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in the development, qualification, and integration of our subsea dynamic power cable products for success of integrated Water Column EPCI offering for Floating Offshore Wind.

 

Core Responsibilities:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and optimize high and medium voltage power cables.
Provide technical governance of the supply chain for power core components.
Apply your knowledge of cable manufacturing processes to ensure quality and efficiency.
Specifying HV/MV testing to validate cable performance.
Analyse long-term performance and failure modes of HV/MV cables.
Ensure compliance and have participation with relevant standards (e.g., IEC, CIGRE).
Foster a network of experts in this field across clients, suppliers, academia, and industry recognised organisations
Developing a clear overview of the operational requirements for the developing floating offshore wind market through engagement with clients and other experts
You are meant for this job if:

Essential:

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering.
Extensive relevant experience in subsea power cable engineering in the offshore wind and/or oil & gas sectors.
Proficiency in power core supply chain management, cable manufacturing, and HV/MV testing.

 

Desirable (beneficial but not mandatory):

Experience in mechanical testing and performance assessment of power cables.
Proficiency in electro-magnetic analysis for cable systems.

title: Scheduler
description:
Job Purpose

The main function for the REMS Senior Planner is to setup, analyze and report on APAC-scope Tender & Execution Primavera schedules. To this end, the Senior Planner is required to coordinate with different product functions (Engineering, Procurement & Delivery Teams) to ensure quality and timely planning deliverables. This position is also responsible for designing, optimizing and maintaining systems and processes to improve overall planning. As a senior, it is expected that the planner can leverage on experience & communicate well to provide guidance, supervision, and feedback to other planners, as well as stakeholders.

Job Description

Key responsibilities:

Setup & Analyze Tender Primavera Schedules for APAC deliverables.
Setup, Analyze and Report on Execution Project Schedules for APAC deliverables.
Coordinate schedule creation & integration of various regional schedules for APAC awarded projects.
Work closely with PMMs / Delivery Managers to ensure on-time delivery of their products and making each project/delivery successful.
Seek any opportunity to simplify, optimize and maintain Scheduling systems & processes.
Provide guidance, supervision and feedback to other planners and stakeholders.

Duties and Responsibilities

Strategy

Produce, Develop and Refine Planning Reports to engage and assist local Delivery Teams in strategic analysis and decisions. 
Contribute to, Implement and adhere to any policies or procedures defined and released by Global Scheduling Governance Team.

Execution

Work with various stakeholders (Engineering, Procurement, Delivery Teams, Project Teams, Tendering) to setup and prepare REMS Quotation & Backlog Execution Primavera Schedules in a good and timely manner. 
Maintain good collaboration with Subsea Projects Team to improve information flow and cohesiveness.

Building Capabilities

Develop, Implement, Troubleshoot & Optimize workflow, processes & procedures revolving around planning tools to improve data quality and efficiency.
Educate, Guide, Supervise and Grow other planners, as well as stakeholders.

Safety

Responsible for system-related housekeeping and enhancement/upgrade testing for planning tools.
You are meant for this job if:

Minimum 4-5 years of work experience in Project Scheduling and/or Project Management with a BS or BA preferably in Information Technology or Process Engineering.
Expertise in Project Scheduling & Resource Analysis using Primavera
Able to demonstrate knowledge of Project Management & Control, including Critical Path Analysis.
Strong interpersonal, communication, co-ordination, meeting facilitation and presentation skills required.
Must demonstrate leadership capabilities and conflict resolution skills in resolving issues.
Computer Systems experience includes strong PC skills, preferably with Excel and/or other reporting tools.
Will be an advantage -Experience in SAP Material Resource Planning (MRP) Module and/or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems
Familiar with Subsea Equipment and possesses Oilfield equipment manufacturing knowledge including machining, welding, assembly and MRB processes.

Desired Qualifications:
Experience in Oil & Gas / Manufacturing Industry is preferred.

title: Strategic Planner - VSO
description:

To ensure the effective planning and scheduling of VSO assets in support of TechnipFMC’s projects. The Strategic Planner - VSO is responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date asset schedules, supporting tender activities, and aligning operational and project timelines to optimize asset utilization and project execution.

•    Create, maintain, and simulate planning scenarios across all phases of work, including Long-Term Planning (S&OP, Budget, Master Scheduling), Tendering, and Execution.

title: HSE Intern
description:
The HSE intern provides immediate support to the HSE function, and all levels of employees on a variety of Health, Safety and Environmental aspects.
The candidate will report to the Trinidad HSE Lead, and be assigned to the SLB La Romaine location however, will be required to report to all TT locations as requested during his/her tenure.
Become familiar with SLB HSE culture and SLB health, safety and environmental system
Provide direct support to the HSE function in execution of HSE duties
Conduct site walkarounds, with ability to observe operations and site conditions with a keen eye on HSE aspects.
Provide health, safety and environmental observations, recommendations and ideas for improvement
Participate in HSE Audits, Inspections, Meetings conducted at all TT locations, when required
Support with Administrative tasks including but not limited to; record keeping and management of both Hardcopy files and Softcopy HSE records, use of the company Quest Internal document Management System and GTC HSE Sharepoint, Viva Engage, etc.
Liaise with other business lines, functions and third parties on HSE matters with the guidance of SLB HSE personnel
Communicate effectively among others both verbally and written.
Review and respond to HSE emails & Actions with sound HSE advice and professionalism
Assist with the preparation of HSE Meeting slides, Training Room, and Communications for Meetings and/or Training
Liaise with Buyers/ Suppliers, and follow up on placed orders for Goods/Services related to the HSE/FM  function
Assisting in the developing, review and verifying validity of Risk Assessments in Quest
Comply with all Company Policies and Procedures in the execution of duties
Assist with ad hoc requests and projects as required.
The Employee may be assigned other duties, in addition to, or in lieu of those described above, according to the needs of the location or Company.
Candidate must possess an undergraduate degree from an accredited university
Possess either OSHA General Industry Training/ NEBOSH or equivalent HSE training to be considered for the role
Previous HSE experience working in an HSE role is preferred, but not required
Must be experienced and efficient with use of Computers and the Internet and be proficient in the use of Microsoft Office Applications: Excel, Powerpoint, Word, Outlook.
Have the ability to be flexible, prioritize, and manage multiple activities in a fast-paced, changing environment
Must show initiative and work as a team player, and be willing to learn and grow in an HSE career
Must be an experienced and safe driver, and possess a valid driver’s license and vehicle, to drive oneself to/from locations as job requires.

title: Maintenance Associate
description:
The Maintenance Associate is responsible to perform maintenance activities per the Maintenance Program and ensure on-time delivery of equipment in accordance with operational demand. The Maintenance Associate supports initiatives to improve the maintenance-related Cost of Service Delivery (CoSD), Maintenance Efficiency, People Productivity, and Asset Availability within the Center of Reliability and Efficiency (CRE) or Maintenance Base (MB), or Maintenance Center.

Comply with SLB's and respective division TLM standards.
Maintain and build competency in compliance with the TLM Competency Management System.
Participate in and support continuous improvement (CI) initiatives.
Craft Certification or related experience in mechanical, technical or similar field
Strong mechanical aptitude
Basic computer skills with knowledge of Microsoft Office
Must be able to work in a team environment
Must be able to perform the essential functions in a fast-paced and high-stress environment

description:
