title: Sales Engineer
description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a results-driven Sales Representative or manager to join our team, based Indonesia, focusing on the sales of valves in Indonesia. The ideal candidate will leverage their technical background and industry experience to develop customer relationships, identify sales opportunities, formulate regional sales strategies, conduct contract T&C negotiation directly with EPC or end-users and achieve sales targets within the oil & gas upstream, midstream and downstream such as petrochemical, and chemical sectors in Indonesia market.
Key Responsibilities
Regional Sales Leadership
: Take full responsibility for the sales of new valve products in Indonesia region, including market development, customer management, and target achievement.
Customer Relationship Management
: Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with new and existing customers in the target industries across Indonesia.
Sales Opportunity Development
: Proactively identify, pursue, and secure new sales opportunities through market research, cold calling, and networking within the region.
Sales Strategy & Market Forecasting
: Formulate and implement regional sales strategies aligned with company objectives; conduct regular market demand forecasting to support inventory planning and business decision-making.
Sales Pipeline Management
: Maintain C4C for accounts, including customer profiling, organizational chart, visit reports, and customer drivers. Prepare comprehensive sales data and materials and actively participate in internal sales pipeline review meetings (in-person or virtual) to report progress, address challenges, and align on next steps action.
Technical Consultation & Quotation
: Conduct product presentations and technical consultations to customers; prepare and submit accurate sales quotations, coordinate between plant, engineering team and customers for technical clarification.
Cross-functional Collaboration
: Collaborate closely with internal teams (tendering, engineering legal, finance and service etc.) to ensure customer satisfaction and resolve regional issues promptly.
Market Intelligence
: Keep abreast of Indonesia regional market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to provide valuable feedback to the sales management team.
Contract Negotiation
: negotiate contract T&C directly with customers including EPC or end-users and ensure smooth order processing and contract execution.
Target Achievement
: Achieve and exceed assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for Indonesia region.
Job Requirements
Education:
Bachelor’s degree or above in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or related disciplines preferred).
Experience:
A minimum of 5 years’ Sales and Commercial experience (sales, tendering, sales support etc.) in Indonesia oil and gas or related industry.
Knowledge:
Having knowledge of valve products preferred
Skills:
•
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills in English (verbal and written)
•   Strong capabilities in sales strategy formulation and market forecasting.
•   Proficiency in preparing sales materials and reporting in sales pipeline review meetings.
•   Strong self-motivation, results-oriented mindset, and ability to work independently.
•   Basic technical understanding of industrial valve products.
•   Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Others:
•  Legal right to work in Indonesia
•  Willingness to travel frequently

title: RP TLM Maintenance Manager

The TLM Maintenance Manager is responsible to ensure on-time equipment delivery per operational demands. They improve maintenance-related NPTr, boost asset efficiency, increase asset usage and reduce COSD for the MB.

Develop and build competency of MB employees and track their progress.
Position is for a mid-career (10+ of Experience)

title: Early Careers-Geoscience&Petrotechnical
description:
IMPORTANT NOTE
Thank you for your interest in joining our team!
This is a general job requisition, allowing you to submit your CV for future opportunities. Please note that this requisition is not tied to any active or specific job openings at this time.
We're always looking for exceptional talent in Europe. We invite you to check out our current job openings on our website:

Even if we don't currently have a position that matches your profile, we may consider your application for future opportunities that could be a perfect fit.
Job Title
On our Geoscience and Petrotechnical teams, proven expertise and intelligent tech meet, powering our legacy and future of subsurface solutions. Whether in the field or our learning centers, your unique skills and understanding of hydrocarbons will help solve the toughest challenges for clients every day. And with a start at SLB, you’ll be set up for a bright future making a real impact across our business and industry.
As a
Geologist
, you will combine your understanding of earth sciences with a comprehensive knowledge of the latest logging technologies to determine reservoir architecture and hydrocarbon potential. You will become adept at multiple software systems and work closely with customers to find innovative ways to solve some of their most complex challenges.
As one of our
Geophysicists
, you will apply your knowledge and expertise of the earth’s properties to enhance interpretations of geological data and greater define how we understand the subsurface. We acquire huge amounts of often previously unseen seismic and geophysical data around the world and you will help transform it into the knowledge that powers better decision-making and more effective, more efficient services. You will be involved in the acquisition, processing and interpretation of that data and we offer a range of career opportunities to develop your skills and get exposure across the data lifecycle.
As a
Petrophysicist
, you will combine logging data from multiple downhole sensors with sample data to determine hydrocarbon production capacity, lithology and fluid saturation of the reservoir to ultimately help us optimize its production. You will incorporate data from multiple wells and additional sensors to consider acoustics, spectroscopy and magnetic resonance to enhance overall accuracy or build a clearer picture of the reservoir by understanding its permeability and mechanical properties.
As a
Reservoir Engineer
, you will use data and our leading software products and solutions to create reservoir models that help clients make decisions that deliver safer, optimized, long-term production for each reservoir by simulating fluid flow phase behavior and reservoir physical properties.
As a
Production Optimization Engineer
, you will deliver performance improvements to our clients’ assets worldwide though virtual representations of our downhole products which incorporate calculations, finite element analysis (FEA), computation fluid dynamics (CFD), costing and parametric modeling into one cohesive system.
Requirements
Meet
minimum degree requirements
Technically curious and determined to improve approaches and methods of discovery
Ambitious and looking to take on responsibility
Able to effectively contribute to a team
Good written and verbal communication
Focused on quality

Job Title
Wellsite Engineer Trainee – Recent Graduates
Location
Work Place – SLB Bases and Client Wellsites across the wider Europe
About Us
We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. At SLB we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. We are facing the world’s greatest balancing act- how to simultaneously reduce emissions and meet the world’s growing energy demands. Our collective future depends on decarbonizing the fossil fuel industry, while innovating a new energy landscape. It’s what drives us. Ensuring progress for people and the planet, on the journey to net zero and beyond.
More than 98,000 employees over 120 countries already started their SLB journeys. Start yours now!
If you would like to know more, please visit our website at https://www.slb.com/
Job Description
As a Wellsite Engineer, you’ll be involved in every part of our business. From helping acquire essential data to planning long-term well development, you’ll organize, run, and report operations in the field environment and assist specialists and other Engineers with key decisions. Your training will be hands-on as you learn about the energy industry and become an expert in the various tools and services in your business line. You’ll be asked to learn a lot quickly, and you’ll be given responsibility and support to make your impact and start becoming a leader in our business.
Responsibilities
Perform operations, operate equipment, and be accountable for team wellsite performance, by the end of your training.
Manage field operations, including engineering design, maintenance, job planning, and operational reporting.
Learn the well construction process and understand the role of different service companies.
Support engineers and specialists on-site and help with essential duties, such as risk analysis.
Effectively manage a crew and/or processes.
Help prepare wellsite reports and post-job debriefings.
Actively contribute to continuous improvement culture—across the business.
Qualifications
BSc or MEng: Petroleum, Energy, Industrial, Manufacturing, Mechanical,
Electrical, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering (other closely related degrees considered).
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Quick learner able to use logic to solve problems.
Be personally committed to continuous improvement.
Evidence of leadership and teamwork skills.
The desire to work in at a wellsite environment and in a fast-paced, dynamic business on high-value, technically complex products/projects.
The right to work in the Romania.
Preferred Skills
Strong interpersonal skills to communicate clearly and confidently.
Be able to choose and initiate action.
Be passionate about learning and research.
Be eager to deliver results and meet demands.
Remain positive during pressures, setbacks, and fast-paced environments.
If this role is of interest to you and you are eager to learn more then we strongly encourage you to apply. We can then discuss how you will help shape and grow SLB moving forward.
Why, as a graduate, should you join us
Dynamic work environments
The strength of our culture means you’ll work in a fast-paced, supportive work environment. We offer hybrid working with a combination of on-site & home working days to achieve the right work-life balance and allotted time for participating in volunteering and sustainability efforts.
Developing future leaders
Become part of a community where your potential to lead is nurtured from the start. Joining us opens doors to leadership opportunities within our organization and across the broader industry, as evidenced by over 90% of our executive team who began their careers with us.
Borderless careers
Our career-building approach means you’ll have dedicated systems and an open, honest dialogue with managers and HR, helping you develop your career with potential opportunities across regions, functions and businesses.
Women in STEM
Diversity is a key part of our success, and we have focused on gender balance for nearly 25 years. We are dedicated to nurturing and developing female talent both locally and globally. To support this goal, SLB has several initiatives, including mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company-wide webinars, all aimed at helping women succeed.
Industry-Leading Equipment
Engage with cutting-edge technology positioned at the forefront of the industry, contributing to pioneering advancements.
Benefits
Competitive salary.

description:
As a
Web UI/UX Designer
at SLB, you will play a crucial role in enhancing the user experience across our digital platforms. title: Research Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Research Engineer to join our world-class team at Schlumberger Doll Research (SDR) in Cambridge, Massachusetts, where breakthrough science meets real-world impact. In this role, you will help shape the future of energy by inventing and advancing next generation process systems that enable cleaner, more efficient, and more sustainable energy solutions.
At SDR, research doesn’t stop at theory—you will work at the intersection of fundamental science, hands-on experimentation, and scalable industrial deployment, tackling some of the most pressing challenges of the global energy transition. Your work will directly contribute to reducing carbon intensity, improving energy efficiency, and enabling new clean energy and decarbonization technologies across SLB’s portfolio.
This position is ideal for an engineer driven by curiosity and purpose—someone excited to design and run cutting-edge laboratory and pilot scale experiments, transform insights into deployable technologies, and see their ideas make a measurable impact on the path to a lower carbon, more sustainable energy system.
Key responsibilities:
· Design and execute laboratory-scale and pilot-scale experiments to develop new or improved processes.
· Build experimental setups, define test protocols, and analyze experimental data.
· Translate experimental results into scalable process designs and performance predictions.
· Develop and validate process simulation models using tools such as Aspen Plus, HYSYS, gPROMS, or equivalent.
· Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams spanning R&D, engineering, manufacturing, and commercialization.
· Document results through technical reports, presentations, and intellectual property disclosures.
Qualifications
Required skills/experience: Master degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, or related fields with relevant courses.
· Experience in hands-on research or technology development within oil & gas, chemical, food, or related process industries
· Ability to connect experimental observations with first-principles engineering models.
· Working knowledge of process simulation and modeling tools · Programming skills related to data processing and analysis , such as Python, Matlab, R, or equivalent
Preferred skills/experience:
· Demonstrable experience in unit operations (separations, reactors, heat & mass transfer) that delivered step-change improvements in energy efficiency, footprint, and cost across laboratory, pilot, and early scale-up stages · Programming skills related to instrumentation, data collection and analysis, such as LabView, Python, or equivalent

Our career-building approach means you’ll have dedicated systems and an open, honest dialogue with managers and HR, helping you develop your career with potential opportunities across regions, functions and businesses.

Diversity is a key part of our success, and we have focused on gender balance for nearly 25 years. We are dedicated to nurturing and developing female talent both locally and globally. To support this goal, SLB has several initiatives, including mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company-wide webinars, all aimed at helping women succeed.

title: Geólogo de Desarrollo
description:
Descripción:
El Geólogo de Desarrollo participa activamente en el proceso de pozos nuevos y trabajos de reacondicionamiento incluidos en el Plan de Trabajo Anual (PTA) del desarrollo del campo, como así también en todos los estudios de Geociencias involucrados en el plan del desarrollo del campo (FDP). Su papel principal es participar en todas las actividades para lograr un proceso de propuesta y construcción de pozos adecuado, así como obtener las aprobaciones a nivel interno y externo, de HQ APS, Petroecuador y entidades gubernamentales.
Trabaja en diferentes campos de la geología con conocimientos de geofísica, geomecánica, petrofísica e ingeniería de reservorios. El Geólogo de Desarrollo combina el conocimiento de datos de pozos con la comprensión de la geología del petróleo y gas para determinar la arquitectura y propiedades del reservorio (volúmenes de hidrocarburo en sitio, distribución de facies) a través del análisis e integración de información de diversas fuentes.
Roles y Responsabilidades:
Elaborar la prognosis de perforación (lista de chequeo) basado en el PTA acordado internamente por el equipo de Explotación.
Coordinar reuniones y material soporte para obtener aprobaciones de prognosis de pozos nuevos ante el grupo de Gerencia Técnica (TAT) de HQ.
Coordinar reuniones con el grupo técnico de Petroecuador para lograr la aprobación de la propuesta de los pozos nuevos, así como de las entidades gubernamentales.
Monitorear las operaciones de perforación.
Elaborar mapas y correlaciones estructurales y estratigráficas para el soporte de las propuestas de reacondicionamiento de pozos, mediante la conceptualización e interpretación de estructuras, sedimentología
Integrar diferentes datos/información de subsuelo y producción para el mejor entendimiento y caracterización del subsuelo.
Capacidad de evaluación estratigráfica y estructural avanzada, a partir de, pero no limitado a: registros eléctricos básicos y especiales, sísmica e inversión sísmica, modelos estáticos, núcleos y ripios de perforación, para soportar la ubicación óptima de pozos y la identificación de oportunidades para el futuro desarrollo del campo, integrado con comportamiento de producción.
Proponer estrategias de desarrollo y derisqueo para áreas del campo que lo necesiten, con el fin de asegurar resultados de producción de pozos nuevos y WO.
Contribuir activamente en la construcción y actualización del Plan de Desarrollo del Campo (FDP), con conocimiento en reservas y volúmenes recuperables.
Proponer y coordinar campañas de adquisición de datos con su respectiva justificación.
Realizar las funciones de geólogo de pozo cuando la operación lo requiera.
Cualificación Mínima & Experiencia:
Geólogo / Ingeniero Geólogo, preferiblemente con conocimientos sólidos de geología de operaciones.
Experiencia de entre 5 a 10 años como Geólogo de desarrollo de campos y en proyectos de producción y perforación de pozos dentro de compañías de la industria Oil & Gas.
Experticia en manejo del software PETREL.
Inglés Intermedio - Avanzado
Posición para la ciudad de Quito.

title: Logistics Specialist
description:
The Logistics Specialist is responsible to manage and coordinate the domestic or international movement of assets, products, and materials upon the request of the Business Line.  They optimize equipment utilization, select the most cost-effective routings and MoTs and plan / book these shipments with approved carriers and 3PLs, comply with the selection of preferred contracted carriers or internal fleet, and secure delivery as per the established service level.
Be the BL's logistics focal point for their logistics movements.
Validate transport requests and required delivery dates for a defined geographic region or lane(s) to achieve on-time delivery.
Prepare equipment load plans per planning standard operating procedures to maximize rental and call-out equipment utilization.
Leverage  planning and use rate checker tools to achieve competitive costs by applying preferred contracted rates.
Plan effective shipment/truck routings, leverage consolidation/cargo optimization, and maximize backload opportunities to drive down costs where possible.
Monitor shipment execution, track shipment movements and manage deviations with our logistics suppliers while keep internal stakeholders updated.
Manage weekly fixed schedules and regional milk runs.
Issue work orders before each move with associated cost approvals.
Identify logistics network improvement projects or opportunities.
Ensure full compliance of transports with the international transport regulations.
Monitor cargo moves status and performances and investigates deviations.
Implement proactive and corrective measures combined with appropriate communication when early warning signs of deviation are detected.
Assess carrier performance with respect to on-time delivery and on-time pickup.
Manage international or domestic logistics movements ensuring compliance with Schlumberger policies and processes as well as local regulations including but not limited to finance, personnel, LTC guidelines and QHSE.
Ensure proper storage of electronic documents in the system.
Act as the interface with the Import/Export Teams and assure smooth communication flow between parties.
Participate in the performance analysis meeting.
Monitor and capture logistics milestone data in the business system.
Report any deviation in QUEST and follow up on action plan to ensure continuous improvement on service quality.
Obtain the necessary freight cost approval from the Business line representatives and shortlist offers from Freight Forwarders in the bidding system.
Logistics Specialist can report into a Logistics Manager or Logistics Supervisor at GeoUnit or SCC (LCT or DSC) based on the specific location of the role.

title: Coordenador de Serviços de Cimentação
description:
O Coordenador de Engajamento do Cliente de Cimentação é responsável por atuar como ponto de contato do cliente para as operações da Linha de Produtos, fornecendo níveis superiores de suporte durante todo o processo de prestação de serviços, impulsionando a receita do contrato, a lucratividade e a gestão de recebíveis. Desenvolve e entrega projetos técnicos otimizados para a área de responsabilidade. O Coordenador de Engajamento do Cliente estabelece e mantém um relacionamento profissional com o cliente e maximiza o conhecimento sobre ele para agregar valor ao contrato tanto para a SLB quanto para o cliente. Ele garante que os serviços prestados ao cliente estejam em conformidade com os acordos contratuais e atendam aos objetivos e métricas de desempenho do cliente. Essa pessoa impulsiona a adoção de soluções tecnológicas eficazes para as necessidades e desafios do cliente. O Coordenador de Engajamento do Cliente coordena os canais de comunicação e as atividades entre o cliente e a equipe de prestação de serviços e é responsável pelo COSD (ou seja, consumo de recursos).
Responsabilidades
Desenvolver projetos técnicos de tarefas conforme necessário para a Linha de Produtos.
Apoiar o Gerente de PSD na fase de execução com alterações de projeto, conforme necessário, devido a mudanças nas dimensões da tarefa, disponibilidade de recursos, incidentes de qualidade de serviço, etc.
Auxiliar na resposta a incidentes, recuperação e investigação de incidentes.
Analisar a execução da tarefa em comparação com o projeto e registrar formalmente melhorias de projeto e oportunidades de otimização (lições aprendidas e melhores práticas).
Registrar/atualizar a atividade do cliente para visibilidade da entrega de serviços nos sistemas de negócios.
Registrar e comunicar internamente informações relevantes sobre o cliente.
Registrar e confirmar os requisitos específicos da tarefa.
Como membro da Equipe de Contas, identificar e capturar leads de vendas, tanto da Linha de Produtos quanto de outras linhas de produtos, fora dos termos do contrato existente, e contribuir para o Plano de Contas.
Compilar e revisar estimativas de custos para consolidação com a proposta técnica.
Avaliar os riscos da tarefa durante a análise dos requisitos do cliente.
Participar de sessões de briefing e debriefing com a equipe de PSD, conforme necessário, para garantir que os objetivos do cliente sejam claramente compreendidos.
Comunicar recomendações e ações ao cliente para mitigar eventos não planejados.
Garantir que as entregas da tarefa sejam precisas e realizadas dentro do prazo. Facilitar as revisões de eventos de qualidade de serviço (SQ) com os clientes, conforme necessário.
Coordenar e conduzir reuniões regulares de qualidade de serviço com o cliente.
Avaliar o feedback do cliente por meio de relatórios de satisfação e avaliações de desempenho.
Revisar a qualidade e a integridade dos chamados de campo.
Identificar e resolver proativamente disputas de faturas relacionadas a problemas de entrega de produtos e serviços.
Requisitos Mínimos
Formação superior em Engenharia ou áreas afins
CREA ativo
Experiência comprovada em projetos de cimentação: elaboração, projeto e execução de projetos, avaliação e coordenação de serviços de instalação e manutenção de equipamentos, além de gestão logística de recursos.
Conhecimentos em software: SAP, Pacote Office (desejável)
Inglês avançado

description:

Location:
Libya

Full-time
Job Summary
We are seeking a
Senior Production Engineer (Mid-Career)
to support the Product and Service Delivery (PSD) team in delivering safe, efficient, and reliable products and services to our customers in Libya. The role focuses on developing and delivering optimized technical job designs, providing real-time operational support, managing risk, and driving continuous improvement initiatives across Product Lines. The Senior Production Engineer is also responsible for cost optimization through COSD (Cost of Service Delivery) and applying lessons learned to improve future job designs.

Develop and deliver optimized technical job designs for assigned Product Lines
Ensure safe, efficient, and reliable service delivery in support of PSD operations
Identify and implement innovative and cost-effective techniques to improve performance
Explore opportunities for value-added products and services

Communicate the value of technologies and technical interpretations to customers and internal stakeholders
Collaborate with subject matter experts to optimize technical designs and mitigate operational risks
Support OU PSD and/or PSD Managers during the execution phase, adapting designs to changes in job parameters, resource availability, or service quality incidents

Senior technical role with direct impact on production performance and service quality
Exposure to complex and challenging operations in Libya
Opportunities for professional growth and technical leadership development
Safety-focused, collaborative, and performance-driven work environment

Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline

Strong knowledge of technical job design, risk management, and operational execution
Proven ability to support field operations and real-time decision-making
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, field-oriented environment in Libya

Engage with cutting-edge technology positioned at the forefront of the industry, contributing to pioneering advancements.

title: CPL Field Engineer
description:
Job Title
Wellsite Engineer Trainee - Energy Technology (Graduate Role)
Location
Ploiesti, Romania.
Work Place – SLB Base and Client Wellsites across the wider Europe
About Us
We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. At SLB we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. We are facing the world’s greatest balancing act- how to simultaneously reduce emissions and meet the world’s growing energy demands. Our collective future depends on decarbonizing the fossil fuel industry, while innovating a new energy landscape. It’s what drives us. More than 98,000 employees over 120 countries already started their SLB journeys. Start yours now!

As a Wellsite Engineer, you’ll be involved in every part of our business. From helping acquire essential data to planning long-term well development, you’ll organize, run, and report operations in the field environment and assist specialists and other Engineers with key decisions. Your training will be hands-on as you learn about the energy industry and become an expert in the various tools and services in your business line. You’ll be asked to learn a lot quickly, and you’ll be given responsibility and support to make your impact and start becoming a leader in our business.

Manage field operations, including engineering design, maintenance, job planning, and operational reporting.
Learn the well construction process and understand the role of different service companies.
Support engineers and specialists on-site and help with essential duties, such as risk analysis.
Effectively manage a crew and/or processes.
Help prepare wellsite reports and post-job debriefings.
Actively contribute to continuous improvement culture—across the business.

The desire to work in at a wellsite environment and in a fast-paced, dynamic business on high-value, technically complex products/projects.
The right to work in the Romania.

Strong interpersonal skills to communicate clearly and confidently.
Be able to choose and initiate action.
Be passionate about learning and research.
Be eager to deliver results and meet demands.
Remain positive during pressures, setbacks, and fast-paced environments.
If this role is of interest to you and you are eager to learn more then we strongly encourage you to apply. We can then discuss how you will help shape and grow SLB moving forward.

Dynamic work environments

Developing future leaders
Become part of a community where your potential to lead is nurtured from the start. Joining us opens doors to leadership opportunities within our organization and across the broader industry, as evidenced by over 90% of our executive team who began their careers with us.
Borderless careers
Our career-building approach means you’ll have dedicated systems and an open, honest dialogue with managers and HR, helping you develop your career with potential opportunities across regions, functions and businesses.

To support this goal, SLB has several initiatives, including mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company-wide webinars, all aimed at helping women succeed.
Industry-Leading Equipment
Engage with cutting-edge technology positioned at the forefront of the industry, contributing to pioneering advancements.
Benefits
Competitive salary.

We provide well-being programs such as Employee Mental health support and health and wellness coaching.

title: Fluids Plant Operator
description:
The MI Fluids Plant Operator is responsible for delivering safe, efficient, and reliable product and service delivery (PSD) to customers.  The MI Fluids Plant Operator identifies opportunities to improve service delivery, implements standard work (SW), and manages risk during service delivery.  This person manages bulk plant facilities to facilitate delivery of prepared products and bulk materials to wellsites, maintaining excellent quality control (QC) in accordance with company policies and procedures.  The MI Fluids Plant Operator assists in training other Operators and trainees.  This person ensures compliance with governmental regulations and industry standards, and reduces environmental impacts through observing Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies.
Ensure job deliverables are accurate and delivered on time.
Blend and mix bulk products for delivery to the wellsite, on time, according to the job program design.
Check and/or calculate quantities of material blends required prior to loading.
Follow Product Line (PL) quality assurance procedures to ensure proper loading.
Coordinate movement of bulk products to and from locations with the PSD and Logistics Team.
Assist in conducting monthly inventory and daily paperwork completion for goods received and shipped.
Label and store additives in a safe manner and ensure the disposal of empty drums and pails.
Maintain bulk plant equipment by performing a daily check while ensuring the bulk plant is kept clean.
Participate in job risk analysis and continuous improvement programs.
Wear PPE and observe HSE policies.
O&G Preferred
Must have authorization to work in the US

title: Reservoir Engineer
description:
Job Title:
Reservoir Engineer
About Us:
We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.​
Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all.​
Our inclusive culture is the key to our success. We collaborate with our internal community of colleagues, alumni, and our valued external partners to support each other and achieve our goals. We aim to raise the bar high. Global in outlook, local in practice – and with a united, shared passion for discovering solutions, we hire talented, driven people and support them to succeed, personally and professionally.
More than 98,000 employees over 120 countries already started their SLB journeys. Start yours now!
If you would like to know more, please visit our website at
https://www.slb.com/
Job Summary:
The
Reservoir Engineer (RE)
based in Brisbane, responsible for driving the success of our customers’ unconventional gas assets across Queensland (Surat and Bowen Basins). You will serve as the bridge between SLB’s advanced simulation technologies (
Petrel, ECLIPSE, INTERSECT
) and the operational needs of major CSG producers. By providing expert technical support, field development planning, and high-level training, you ensure the safe, efficient, and commercially superior delivery of products and services while maintaining SLB’s market leadership in the Queensland energy sector.
Tasks and Responsibilities:
Technical Advisory:
Provide specialized support for CSG subsurface teams, utilizing
ECLIPSE
and
INTERSECT
to model complex coal reservoirs.
Field Development Planning (FDP):
Lead and assist in the design of development strategies for unconventional assets, focusing on well spacing, completion optimization, and production optimization.
Training & Enablement:
Deliver technical SLB software training sessions for clients to increase product adoption and technical proficiency.
Competitive Strategy:
Partner with Technical Sales and Service Delivery to identify competitive threats and demonstrate the superior value of SLB’s simulation and characterization workflows.
Continuous Improvement:
Identify opportunities to apply new, cost-effective techniques in CSG production and formally communicate findings with AbTC.
Operational Support:
Assist in real-time incident response and provide technical validation for tenders to ensure commercial and technical viability.
Industry Presence:
Maintain high visibility within the Brisbane energy community through
SPE (Society of Petroleum Engineers)
, contributing to technical publications, and engaging with Queensland-based research organizations and universities.
Technical Requirements & Expertise:
The ideal candidate must demonstrate a deep understanding of the unique physics governing Coal Seam Gas reservoirs:
CSG Simulation & Modeling:
Expert-level proficiency in
Petrel
,
ECLIPSE
, and
INTERSECT
, specifically for dual-porosity/dual-permeability modeling.
Production Forecasting:
Advanced skills in both analytical (Type Curves, DCA) and numerical simulation methods for unconventional gas.
CSG Physics:
Sorption Dynamics:
Langmuir Isotherm and time-dependent desorption processes.
Geomechanics:
Deep understanding of
stress-dependent permeability
and its impact on production life cycles.
Well Modeling:
Expertise in modeling CSG wellbore hydraulics.
Minimum Qualifications:
Full Australian working rights.
Bachelors or Masters of Engineering.

title: RTOC Analyst
description:
Position: Real Time Drilling Ops Centre Analyst (RTDOC Analyst)
Job Summary:
As an RTDOC Analyst, should demonstrate adaptability and proficiency in handling various real-time visualization and monitoring platforms. The core responsibilities include actively overseeing ongoing drilling operations, leveraging real-time data to identify and address any operational anomalies promptly. This not only helps in maintaining the safety and efficiency of the drilling process but also minimizes potential risks and downtime.
Effective monitoring involves continuous analysis of key performance indicators, timely escalation of detected issues, and clear communication with relevant stakeholders to implement corrective actions and you will provide technical expertise and support to deliver exceptional services for data capture, management, and reporting throughout the entire lifecycle for wellsite drilling & workover operations. You will receive training that expands your technical knowledge and hands-on skillset.
Job Location:
Duliajan, Assam, INDIA
Mumbai, Maharashtra, INDIA
Dehradun, Uttarakhand, INDIA
Reporting to Project Manager or Team Lead
Key Responsibilities:
Perform daily reporting of wellsite operations and be accountable for overall performance of timely data capture and reporting including configuration, loading, QC, monitoring and troubleshooting of operational activity for the asset / location
Ensure seamless data is captured with reporting applications including monitoring of mandatory reports, data sources, report formats including units, identifiers, meanings, normal value ranges to identify and fix data issues proactively.
Learn the reporting application, system installation and configuration, troubleshooting process and keep track of issues and resolution
Understand the role of different stakeholders and coordinate project data collection across service companies, client organization, real time data providers
Provide support to the on-site team, collaborate with the project team, client organization and remote operations support to ensure smooth and reliable function of application software and systems, including system upgrades, troubleshooting and maintenance activities
Monitor service quality, understand and utilize the Incident Escalation Procedures and pre-emptively inform supervisors when potential issues arise
Understand and Implement the Data Confidentiality Standards and IT Security Policies across all activities related to data capture, storage, transfer and archival
Maintain HSE Scorecards and actively contribute to HSE Safety Programs
Behaviour:
Learn quickly and adapt to new problems and situations.
Pursues everything with energy, drive, and a need to finish. Use logic to solve problems with effective solutions.
Is personally committed to continuous improvement.
Listens and can communicate effectively with managers, peers and clients both written and verbally.
Experience & Exposures:
Qualification –
Diploma/ Graduation in engineering or equivalent/ Higher. He should
be able to communicate in English / Hindi.
Relevant Experience –
Minimum 3 years’ experience in upstream Drilling operation and
minimum 1 year experience in providing real time data services for Drilling domain in
upstream oil and gas sectors.
Environment –
On land rotational

English / Hindi.

title: Well Superintendent
description:
Superintendent – Well
Location:
Tripoli, Libya
Job Summary:
The Superintendent is responsible for overseeing the execution of well programs, including drilling, completion, and workover operations, ensuring that all activities are conducted safely, efficiently, and cost-effectively. Acting as the primary point of contact for Wellsite Supervisors, the Superintendent coordinates communications between the wellsite, Product Lines (PLs), and third-party contractors to optimize resources and operational performance.
Key Responsibilities:
Operational Leadership:
Manage day-to-day well program execution and monitor operational progress against planned objectives.
Participate in pre-job planning/kickoff meetings with PLs, contractors, and customers to ensure shared understanding of program objectives.
Review operational issues, support incident response and recovery, and implement program changes as needed.
Attend the rig site for critical wellsite activities and consolidate lessons learned for future campaigns.
Health, Safety, and Quality:
Drive continuous improvement of HSE processes, identifying and implementing corrective action plans.
Conduct regular QHSE and rig audits alongside the QHSE Coordinator.
Demonstrate leadership in QHSE practices and ensure compliance with Schlumberger policies, Integrated PL standards, and standing orders.
Validate project deliverables and ensure quality process improvement for final acceptance.
Resource Management & Planning:
Forecast medium- and long-term resource requirements to meet operational program needs.
Coordinate operational activities of PLs and third parties to ensure efficiency and service quality.
Manage operational budgets and ensure cost control relative to the project budget.
Support the selection and evaluation of service companies, suppliers, and equipment.
Team Development:
Provide proper training, mentoring, and development for Wellsite Supervisors and personnel under direct supervision.
Foster knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team.
Qualifications & Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum Engineering (or a related engineering discipline such as Mechanical or Chemical Engineering) is required.
Proven experience in well program execution (drilling, completion, and workover).
Strong leadership and communication skills, with experience managing teams and third-party contractors.
Demonstrated commitment to HSE and quality standards.
Strong analytical, planning, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work in challenging environments, including rig sites.

title: Geologist
description:
The Geologist is responsible for assisting in delivery of safe, efficient, and reliable products and services to our customers. The job consults with operations groups as needed to support the area of expertise and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement of product and service delivery and formally communicates findings. The Geologist actively participates in promoting new technology and services offerings and supports the PL in risk management and applying lessons learned to improve job design and execution as related to the area of expertise. They provide real-time support to operations as required.
Provide technical support in the area of expertise throughout the Sales and Product and Service Delivery process.
Assist as required with the development of technical job designs for PLs.
Assist with identifying areas where new and cost effective techniques can be applied.
Explore opportunities for value-added products and services.
Consult with Design/Technical Engineer role as required to optimize the technical design.
Assist in real-time incident response, recovery, and investigation as related to the area of expertise.
Assist in evaluating technical viability and overall appraisal of tenders as related to the area of expertise.
Remain current on new technologies.
Maintain customer visibility through active participation in professional society activities and calls for papers.
Understand the competition’s technical offering.
Participate in external technical societies and communities.
Contribute, write and review technical publications.
Engage with local universities, Customer institutes and research organizations.
Carbonate facies and diagenesis integration: Build high‑resolution stratigraphic frameworks and facies models for platform, ramp, reef, and basin carbonates; integrate core, thin sections, image logs, and seismic attributes to capture diagenetic overprint (dolomitization, cementation, dissolution) on porosity and permeability.
Fracture & vug characterization: Interpret FMI/FMS image logs to identify fractures, vugs, and depositional features, LWD azimuthal resistivity, borehole televiewer, and outcrop analogs to describe fracture intensity, orientation, and connectivity, and vuggy/karst porosity; translate into DFN/dual‑porosity models and flow units.
Dual‑porosity/dual‑permeability modeling: Construct and history‑match carbonate reservoir models (matrix + fracture/vug systems) at pattern and field scale; assess fracture–matrix interaction and scale‑dependent sweep efficiency for FDP scenarios.
Rock typing & flow‑unit mapping: Develop carbonate rock types (e.g., Lucia/Rosetta schemes), link SCAL/Cap‑P/Rel‑P/NMR to electrofacies; propagate flow units through the static model to improve well placement and wellbore architecture.
Seismic for carbonates: Use spectral decomposition, inversion (AI/impedance), and geomorphology attributes to delineate reef build‑ups, shoals, karst surfaces, unconformities; integrate VSP/checkshots for reliable carbonate velocity models and depth conversion.
Well placement & drilling in carbonates: Optimize horizontals and multilateral wells to target connected vugs/fractures while minimizing lost circulation/karst hazards; design geosteering markers tied to facies and image logs; collaborate on drilling fluids and LCM strategies.
Uncertainty & decision support: Quantify heterogeneity/diagenesis uncertainty; produce scenario‑based reserves and FDP sensitivities focused on connectivity and sweep risk in fractured/vuggy systems.
Deep carbonate expertise
: 10–15+ years working on
platform/reef/ramp carbonates
in development settings, including mature field optimization and FDP execution.
Carbonate sedimentology & diagenesis
: Proven core description and petrography (thin section, SEM, cathodoluminescence) to classify
porosity types
(intergranular, intercrystalline, moldic, vuggy) and their diagenetic controls; ability to tie rock fabrics to petrophysical behavior.
Fracture systems
: Demonstrated experience building
DFN models
and implementing
dual‑porosity/dual‑permeability
simulations; integration of image logs and outcrop analogs into static and dynamic models.
Rock typing & SCAL
: Hands‑on
SCAL program design and interpretation
in carbonates (wettability, MICP, capillary pressure, relative permeability, carbonate‑specific brine/rock interactions), and construction of robust
rock‑typing frameworks
for modeling.
Drilling & completion in carbonates
: Track record mitigating
lost circulation/karst
, designing
acid stimulation
(matrix/frac), and tailoring completions for fracture‑dominated flow; familiarity with
geomechanics
in weak/heterogeneous carbonate rocks.

Carbonate-specific log interpretation: Advanced interpretation of logs in heterogeneous carbonate systems, including vuggy porosity, moldic porosity, and fracture identification using image logs (FMI/FMS), NMR, and dielectric measurements.
Rock typing for carbonates: Develop robust carbonate rock typing schemes (e.g., Lucia classification) integrating porosity types, pore throat size, and diagenetic features; propagate rock types across multiwell datasets using machine learning.
Dual-porosity modeling: Incorporate fracture and vug systems into petrophysical models; support dual-porosity/dual-permeability simulation inputs for reservoir engineers.
Diagenesis and wettability analysis: Evaluate diagenetic overprints (dolomitization, cementation) and their impact on wettability and saturation height functions; design SCAL programs for carbonate-specific wettability and capillary pressure.
Integration with seismic and geology: Collaborate on carbonate facies modeling and seismic attribute analysis to link petrophysical properties with depositional and diagenetic trends.
Carbonate-specific saturation modeling: Apply advanced saturation-height modeling using MICP and integrate with NMR-derived pore size distribution for mixed-wet carbonate systems.
Lost circulation and karst risk assessment: Provide petrophysical input for drilling hazard identification in karstified intervals and fractured zones.
Integration with geology and reservoir engineering: Experience in supporting and updating static and dynamic reservoir modelling for carbonate reservoirs.
Extensive carbonate experience
: 10–15+ years in carbonate reservoirs (platform, reef, ramp), including mature field optimization and FDP execution.
Carbonate petrophysics expertise
: Proven ability to interpret logs in complex carbonate systems (image logs, NMR, dielectric, spectroscopy) and reconcile log-core discrepancies.
Diagenesis and pore system knowledge
: Strong understanding of carbonate diagenesis and its impact on porosity/permeability; ability to integrate petrography (thin section, SEM) with petrophysical models.
Rock typing & SCAL
: Hands‑on SCAL program design and interpretation in carbonates (wettability, MICP, capillary pressure, relative permeability, carbonate‑specific brine/rock interactions), and construction of robust rock‑typing frameworks for modeling.
SCAL and wettability in carbonates:
Hands-on experience designing and interpreting SCAL programs for carbonate reservoirs, including capillary pressure and relative permeability.
Fracture characterization
: Skilled in fracture detection and quantification from logs and core; experience building DFN models for integration into reservoir simulation.
Advanced software proficiency
: IP, Techlog for carbonate-specific workflows; Petrel for integration with geological models; OFM for production data analysis.
Familiarity with carbonate analogues:
Good knowledge of local and regional depositional models (Middle East).

title: GSS Mud Logging Analyst
description:
The GSS Mud Logging Analyst located in Louisiana is responsible for delivering safe, efficient, and reliable Product Service Delivery to customers. The GSS Mud Logging Analyst identifies opportunities to improve service delivery, implements standard work, and manages risk during service delivery. This person monitors the well to provide timely and information to our customers; maintain sensors, equipment, and data acquisition equipment; and delivers high quality data to the customer at the wellsite.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Ensures the integrity of the samples collected; analyzes, interprets and reports in the End of Well Report and enters within the formation evaluation log all information relating to the cutting samples, and informs the Client representatives.
Is responsible for communicating to the Client representatives any information regarding primary well control and well integrity during well site operations as deducted from the data.
Primary responsible for maintaining and analyzing the volume balance sheet during well site operations.
Exercises their discretion and independent judgment to alert the Data Analyst of any discrepancies in the formation evaluation or gases analysis observed.
Is a key person involved in the detection and monitoring of potential well control situations
Ensures the design of an accurate and comprehensive formation evaluation log according to the Client's format.
Is aware of, and respects all safety regulations and procedures, as specified by the Client, Drilling Operator, Geoservices or relevant safety authorities.
Uses their experience and judgment to improve the service quality delivery and communicates to the Data Analyst all improvement opportunities.
Interacts with other service companies’ personnel and Client representatives at the well site, ensuring the prevention of events that may give rise to the wellbore insecurity.
Provides technical advice and assistance in core recovery and core description.
Shares with other well site personnel the responsibility for rigging up and rigging down the mud logging equipment.
Keeps the confidentiality of the Client’s well data.
Manages and provides support, coaching and guidance to Sample Catchers.
Performs other duties as assigned by direct supervisor.
Qualifications and Experience:
University Degree in Geology, Geological Applied Sciences, Earth Sciences or Applied Sciences required.
Previous experience as a Mud Logger / Mud Logging Analyst is preferred however not essential if candidate is degree qualified in relevant discipline.
Previous experience in field-work is a plus.
Knowledge of Drilling Equipment and Techniques.
Excellent Computer Skills.
Candidates must be able to legally work and reside in the US, without sponsorship.

title: Forklift Mechanic
description:
Position Summary
The Industrial Maintenance Technician located in Ville Platte, La is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic systems across the facility. This role supports safe and reliable operations by performing preventive maintenance, addressing equipment issues in a timely manner, and ensuring all facility rolling stock — including forklifts and aerial lifts — remains in optimal working condition. The ideal candidate is detail‑oriented, safety‑focused, and skilled in both mechanical and electrical diagnostics.
Key Responsibilities
Equipment Operation & Maintenance
Operate overhead cranes and other lifting equipment safely and efficiently.
Diagnose, repair, and perform preventive maintenance on
forklifts, aerial lifts (scissor lifts, boom lifts), golf carts, tuggers, and other rolling stock
within the facility.
Maintain and repair industrial machinery including motors, gearboxes, conveyors, pumps, and other mechanical systems.
Perform troubleshooting on electrical and mechanical problems, distinguishing between the two and making accurate repair recommendations.
Technical Competencies
Read, interpret, and apply mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, and blueprints used within the maintenance department.
Utilize maintenance documentation systems, CMMS software, and databases to record work, track parts, and update equipment status.
Understand and follow the facility’s machine monitoring program, including vibration analysis, lubrication schedules, and equipment performance tracking.
Be proficient with hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic equipment common to the industrial mechanic trade.
Continuous Improvement & Preventive Maintenance
Identify opportunities for preventive maintenance and propose improvements to reduce downtime and extend equipment life.
Use the guiding principles and tools of the
Manufacturing System
(Lean, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, etc.) to drive continuous improvement and enhance equipment reliability.
Support root‑cause analysis and corrective action implementation for recurring equipment issues.
Safety & Compliance
Follow all facility safety procedures, lock‑out/tag‑out protocols, and equipment-specific safety requirements.
Maintain a clean, organized, and hazard-free work area.
Ensure repairs and modifications meet regulatory and facility standards.
Qualifications
Experience in industrial maintenance or mechanical repair (facility-specific experience preferred).
Ability to safely operate cranes, forklifts, aerial lifts, and other industrial equipment.
Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently or within a team environment.
Basic computer proficiency for documentation and CMMS use.
Must have the legal right to work in the United States without visa sponsorship.
Ability to lift, climb, kneel, and work in a manufacturing/facility environment.

title: Wellsite Engineer Trainee
description:
Job Title
Wellsite Engineer Trainee - Energy Technology (Graduate Role)
Location
Ploiesti, Romania.
Work Place – SLB Base and Client Wellsites across the wider Europe
About Us
We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. At SLB we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. We are facing the world’s greatest balancing act- how to simultaneously reduce emissions and meet the world’s growing energy demands. Our collective future depends on decarbonizing the fossil fuel industry, while innovating a new energy landscape. It’s what drives us. Ensuring progress for people and the planet, on the journey to net zero and beyond.
More than 98,000 employees over 120 countries already started their SLB journeys. Start yours now!
If you would like to know more, please visit our website at https://www.slb.com/
Job Description
As a Wellsite Engineer, you’ll be involved in every part of our business. From helping acquire essential data to planning long-term well development, you’ll organize, run, and report operations in the field environment and assist specialists and other Engineers with key decisions. Your training will be hands-on as you learn about the energy industry and become an expert in the various tools and services in your business line. You’ll be asked to learn a lot quickly, and you’ll be given responsibility and support to make your impact and start becoming a leader in our business.
Responsibilities
Perform operations, operate equipment, and be accountable for team wellsite performance, by the end of your training.
Manage field operations, including engineering design, maintenance, job planning, and operational reporting.
Learn the well construction process and understand the role of different service companies.
Support engineers and specialists on-site and help with essential duties, such as risk analysis.
Effectively manage a crew and/or processes.
Help prepare wellsite reports and post-job debriefings.
Actively contribute to continuous improvement culture—across the business.
Qualifications
BSc or MEng: Petroleum, Energy, Industrial, Manufacturing, Mechanical,
Electrical, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering (other closely related degrees considered).
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Quick learner able to use logic to solve problems.
Be personally committed to continuous improvement.
Evidence of leadership and teamwork skills.
The desire to work in at a wellsite environment and in a fast-paced, dynamic business on high-value, technically complex products/projects.
The right to work in the Romania.
Preferred Skills
Strong interpersonal skills to communicate clearly and confidently.
Be able to choose and initiate action.
Be passionate about learning and research.
Be eager to deliver results and meet demands.
Remain positive during pressures, setbacks, and fast-paced environments.
If this role is of interest to you and you are eager to learn more then we strongly encourage you to apply. We can then discuss how you will help shape and grow SLB moving forward.
Why, as a graduate, should you join us
Dynamic work environments
The strength of our culture means you’ll work in a fast-paced, supportive work environment. We offer hybrid working with a combination of on-site & home working days to achieve the right work-life balance and allotted time for participating in volunteering and sustainability efforts.
Developing future leaders
Become part of a community where your potential to lead is nurtured from the start. Joining us opens doors to leadership opportunities within our organization and across the broader industry, as evidenced by over 90% of our executive team who began their careers with us.
Borderless careers
Our career-building approach means you’ll have dedicated systems and an open, honest dialogue with managers and HR, helping you develop your career with potential opportunities across regions, functions and businesses.
Women in STEM
Diversity is a key part of our success, and we have focused on gender balance for nearly 25 years. We are dedicated to nurturing and developing female talent both locally and globally. To support this goal, SLB has several initiatives, including mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company-wide webinars, all aimed at helping women succeed.
Industry-Leading Equipment
Engage with cutting-edge technology positioned at the forefront of the industry, contributing to pioneering advancements.
Benefits
Competitive salary.
We offer private healthcare for employees and their families.
We provide well-being programs such as Employee Mental health support and health and wellness coaching.
Life insurance.
We have multiple internal employee resources groups, female mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company-wide webinars, amongst other opportunities.
Other benefits are also available through the SLB flexible benefits program.

description:
We are SLB

who, representing more than 160 nationalities, provide leading digital solutions and deploy ground-breaking technologies to enable performance and sustainability that are crucial for the global energy industry.
With expertise in more than 120 countries, we partner with customers in close collaboration to create industry-changing technologies that unlock cleaner, and safer access to energy for every community—including those we live and work in.
We are SLB, and we are leading the energy industry forward—together.
SLB
people
We are industry leaders because of our exceptional and talented people. They are the core that drives our purpose and integrity, which fuels our belief that everyone should have the opportunity to reach their greatest potential. Ever evolving and constantly innovating, we transcend every cultural and technological boundary set before us. Indeed, it is our diversity that makes us stronger. Together, we achieve more.
Job Summary:
The successful candidate will join the Bucharest Legal Services Center (LSC) where, under the supervision of a
Team Manager
and the
LSC Manager, will be responsible to provide legal assistance and advice in support of operations in SLB Europe & Africa markets. The Customer Contracts Attorney is responsible for facilitating successful business relationships with our customers. This role focuses on protecting the company’s interests while enabling business growth by ensuring that all customer agreements for products and/or services are clearly defined, compliant, and commercially sound.
Location:
This role is based in Bucharest, Romania. The employee will be hired in Romania with compensation and benefits competitive within the Romanian legal market.
Key Responsibilities:
Review, draft, and negotiate a wide variety of commercial contracts with customers for the provision of products and/or services, ensuring alignment with SLB policies and risk thresholds.
Analyse and respond to exceptions in tender documents, bid packages, and requests for quotations, identifying areas of legal or commercial concern and proposing practical solutions that align with SLB's objectives.
Collaborate with SLB's commercial, sales, procurement, and operational teams to align contract terms with both business objectives and operational capabilities.
Advise on contractual rights and obligations and provide legal guidance across the contract lifecycle, from initial proposal through negotiation, execution, and renewal, ensuring SLB's interests are protected.
Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations, including export/import controls, data privacy, anti-bribery, and anti-corruption requirements, in line with SLB's commitment to integrity and ethical practices.
Maintain awareness of changes in relevant legal landscapes and proactively update SLB's contract templates and processes to address evolving risks.
Contribute to the development and delivery of training to SLB's commercial teams on contract best practices, negotiation strategies, and key legal risk areas.
Qualifications & Skills:
At least 5 years of experience negotiating and drafting commercial contracts, preferably in a corporate or in-house environment dealing with complex customer agreements in the technology, energy, or industrial sectors.
Strong knowledge of contract law, commercial law, and relevant regulatory frameworks, with the ability to apply this expertise to SLB's operations.
Excellent command of English (written and spoken); proficiency in French is a plus.
Cultural sensitivity, ability to compromise, and ability to work within a team that reflects SLB's diverse and inclusive culture.
Exceptional negotiation, drafting, and communication skills, with a keen attention to detail and a solutions-oriented mindset that aligns with SLB's innovative approach.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and manage a diverse workload with competing priorities, reflecting SLB's dynamic and global operations.
Strong business acumen and the ability to translate legal risk into practical recommendations for SLB's non-legal stakeholders.
Other positive traits include a desire for an internationally mobile career, willingness to live overseas for extended periods, and the ability to learn fast and work efficiently. A law degree with eligibility to practice law in applicable jurisdiction(s) is required.

title: Completion Field Specialist
description:
Completion Field Specialist is responsible for designing, preparing, and installing well completions equipments (such as: safety valve, production packer, permanent downhole monitoring gauge, sand screen) tailored to diverse wells conditions across Indonesia. You will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient completion installation. The position reports to the Product and Service Delivery Manager (PSD Manager).
Successful Position holders are excellent communicators, enjoy solving problems, and work well in teams.
Roles and Responsibilities:
Well Completions design such as create completion schematic, perform tubing stress analysis, torque and drag analysis.
Provide on-site support during completion equipment preparation, installation and operation.
Serve as technical and operational focal point for Completions related inquiries and proposals.
Prepare and present technical documentation, performance reports, and recommendations to clients.
Ensure all Completions operations comply with SLB’s HSE standards and client-specific safety protocols.
Qualifications and Experience:
Diploma degree in Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
Minimum 3 years of experience in design, installation, and troubleshooting of completions technology.
Knowledge on Tubing Design and Stress Analysis software, Well Completions Design Software, Torque and Drag analysis software, Safety Valve and Production Packer Operation.
Desirable experience/skills/languages.

title: IT  Application Support Engineer
description:
Application Support Engineer  to be based in Villahermosa, Tabasco
As an Application Support Engineer, you will be responsible in providing L2 application & workflow support to users (internal & external). You will also be a proxy in communication with Engineering team to the services the DDH provided.
Responsibilities include (not limited to):
Service Operations Execution - executing data loading procedures, executing computation of Rig states / Drill states and drilling KPI, checking results of the computations and configuring computation parameters, configuring new drilling KPI on demand.
Infrastructure Management - servers, virtual machines, Oracle database, backup / recovery solution, administration of Performance Insights.
Customer & workflow support - making sure that system is available to users, consulting on user workflow, KPI presentation, collecting user requirements and communicating with engineering team.  Manage support requests/tickets over Enterprise Service Management (ESM) according to the actual Service Level Agreement.
Good knowledge of D&I Digital technologies eg: Performance Insights, DrillOps, DrillPlan and other 3rd party application such as Oracle, PoweBI, PowerApps, with excellent customer communication skills are key success factors in this position.Being familiar with drilling domain would be a definite plus.
The candidate must be self-starter, understand responsibility & accountability on each job taken and able to work with autonomy in a remote collaboration environment.
MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Maintain Infrastructure – making sure that all servers and VM are running, monitoring backups, making sure that the application is accessible by the users. The VMs are on AZURE
Administer Performance Insights system – this includes creating new projects on demand, configure pre-default templates, managing users access to the projects
Maintain data flow - configure automated data loading and QC procedures  for drilling sensors data and daily drilling reports, monitor data loading process, reporting QC issues to users
Maintain computation of  drilling KPI -  configure RigState and DrillState computations, configure KPI computations, monitor computations, check quality of the computations versus daily drilling data
Provide help and consultation to users how to access and use RigHour system, explanation of KPIs meaning and values.
Collect user requirements
Configuring new drilling KPIs
Communicate issue and user requirements with Performance Insights engineering team
Notify customers with New Releases and Technical Alerts
Skills Needed:
Note: It is not necessary to be an expert in every single one of the technical technologies listed below, but the candidate must have had some experience or exposure in as many as possible.
Oracle database – knowledge of SQL required and 3rd party tools such as Oracle PL/SQL Developer
Preferable – good understanding & knowledge of Microsoft PowerApps suite
Preferable – good understanding & knowledge of Data Analytics methodology
Preferable – good understanding & knowledge of Cloud Platforms (eg: AZURE, AWS, GCP)
Basic knowledge of Schlumberger Techlog, Techlog Drilling Intepretation
Basic knowledge of E&P
Basic knowledge of Schlumberger InterACT, WITSML, Data Aggregator, Bluebox, Edge Devices
Good Knowledge of drilling domain, specifically understanding of well construction phases – i.e. drilling, casing, tripping etc.
Basic knowledge of operating systems – Linux, Windows Server
Basic knowledge of IIS Web server and Active Directory/LDAP
Basic knowledge of Network architecture and other infrastructure components
Soft Skills:
Fluent in English – verbal & written.
Effective Communication & Presentation skills
Self driven and ability to manage his/her own work with utmost responsibility & accountability
Able to adapt & comfortable working in a global, international, and multicultural environment with daily remote collaboration
Experience/knowledge of  dealing with customers and software engineering teams
Education:
Minimum: BS degree level in IT, Engineering or in Oil & Gas discipline with IT experience
3 years experience in the advertised Skillsets
SLB does not require a fee for applying to the recruitment process
Applicants must be 18 years or older to apply.
.

title: Field Service Technician
description:
The Rig Technician is responsible for rotating among rig positions leading to a specialization in maintenance (mechanic or electrician) or rig operations, as part of the fixed-step development program.
Independently performs commissioning, repairs and maintenance on electrical controls, SCRs, drives and other equipment for oil and gas drilling industry.
Participate in pre-tour and toolbox meetings with the maintenance crew.
Complete formal training on health, safety, environment and technical subjects as described by the fixed-step program.
Obtain certifications and competencies as required for duties assigned.
Maintain equipment in safe working order and report deviations.
Complete work assignments in all rig departments, attaining working knowledge of all rig operations.
Write analytical reports.
Keep record of progress and make monthly reports to the Rig Manager.
Uses technical manuals, prints and specifications to get information to diagnose, order parts and repair equipment
Uses computer, meters, scopes, and other instruments to test, calibrate and program equipment
Troubleshoots & repairs: 1/4HP-2000HP VFD’s, AC-PWM Inverters, DC-SCR Drives, General industrial electronics, Power generation controls, Rig automation controls
Completes service reports and other documentation as required by the Company
Performs all necessary safety checks on equipment prior to commencing work, complies with safety procedures and wears required personal protective equipment (PPE).
Associates Degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering or Technology or equivalent military training or Approved apprenticeship training or OJT.
Minimum of five years of experience in the start-up and repair of AC and DC drives and drives systems.
Oilfield electrical experience required
Should be comfortable reading wiring diagrams, electrical schematics and have a good understanding of ladder logic.
Experience in programming PLC’s and HMI’s desired.
Excellent reasoning and problem solving skills to apply knowledge, understand written information and verbal instructions in repairing/servicing unusual and/or unknown technical equipment operational problems
Can work independently with minimal supervision
Ability to communicate with customers promoting good customer service
Ability to mentor levels one and two technicians.
Ability to supervise a small team of technicians and prepare progress reports on each team member.
Report to management any issues pertaining to the resolution of operational problems
Ability to train rig personnel on Omron Drilling Controls
Travel Requirements:
RPC provides field service 24 hours a day and seven days a week.
60% + domestic & foreign travel required

title: Field Sales Representative
description:

This job is responsible for growing market share and revenue with assigned accounts.

Act as customer interface with operations.
Capture customer Business Line and all local and international competitor activity in GAC.

Provide basic product/service recommendations and presents to the client.
Assist in troubleshooting product/service performance in the field and resolving complaints.
Ensure that customer problems arising from sales are responded to and appropriately managed.
Understand sales programs, new product introduction, etc., within assigned sales territory.
Attend training courses to maintain knowledge of key technologies as well as competitor practices.
Maintain awareness of market and competitive intelligence and communicate to management.
Identify and communicate potential multi-BL and multi-Division opportunities.
Four or more years of relevant experience,
Background in Completions or Sales in Frac Plugs or Setting Tools
Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office suite.
Able to pick up on technical processes quickly.
This will be an Office Based Role and driving to visit client’s offices

Location

About the company
We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet. At SLB we create
amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. We are facing the world’s greatest balancing act- how to simultaneously reduce emissions and meet the world’s growing energy demands. Our collective future depends on decarbonizing the fossil fuel industry, while innovating a new energy landscape. It’s what drives us. Ensuring progress for people and the planet, on the journey to net zero and beyond.
More than 98,000 employees over 120 countries already started their SLB journeys. Start yours now!
If you would like to know more, please visit our website at
https://www.slb.com/
Job Description
The Maintenance Engineer Trainee is responsible for improving efficiency and increasing asset utilization within the business unit or location. This role focuses on enhancing the reliability of the Product Line’s equipment assets and reducing the cost of service delivery (CoSD). The Maintenance Engineer Trainee will contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, equipment failure investigations, and technical audits while working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Responsibilities
Develop a continuous improvement culture, initiatives and improvement plans in the assigned location or business unit to improve asset utilization, reliability and CoSD.
Drive continuous improvement efforts to improve asset turnaround time through reduction of assets waiting for maintenance, down for parts or repair authorization number, down for failure and work-in-process.
Identify new opportunities and develop business cases for projects pertaining to rework and reuse of parts, service level kits and equipment design improvements.
Monitor the quality and completeness of data capture by the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to drive CoSD and reliability analysis.
Monitor adherence of projects to improve quality, reliability and CoSD.
Participate in failure Investigations as assigned by the Reliability and CoSD or Maintenance Manager.
Participate in periodic technical audits and CAT compliance assessments. Follow up on maintenance-related remedial action plan closures.
Qualifications
BSc or MEng: Industrial, Manufacturing, Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering (other closely related degrees considered).
The desire to work in a fast-paced, dynamic business on high-value, technically complex products/projects.
Right to work in the Romania.
Preferred Skills
Strong interpersonal skills to communicate clearly and confidently.
Be able to choose and initiate action.
Be passionate about learning and research.
Be eager to deliver results and meet demands.
Remain positive during pressures, setbacks, and fast-paced environments.
Why, as a graduate, should you join us
Dynamic work environments
The strength of our culture means you’ll work in a fast-paced, supportive work environment. We offer hybrid working with a combination of on-site & home working days to achieve the right work-life balance and allotted time for participating in volunteering and sustainability efforts.
Developing future leaders
Become part of a community where your potential to lead is nurtured from the start. Joining us opens doors to leadership opportunities within our organization and across the broader industry, as evidenced by over 90% of our executive team who began their careers with us.
Borderless careers
Our career-building approach means you’ll have dedicated systems and an open, honest dialogue with managers and HR, helping you develop your career with potential opportunities across regions, functions and businesses.
Women in STEM
Diversity is a key part of our success, and we have focused on gender balance for nearly 25 years. We are dedicated to nurturing and developing female talent both locally and globally. To support this goal, SLB has several initiatives, including mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company-wide webinars, all aimed at helping women succeed.
Industry-Leading Equipment
Engage with cutting-edge technology positioned at the forefront of the industry, contributing to pioneering advancements.
Benefits
Competitive salary.
We offer private healthcare for employees and their families.
We provide well-being programs such as Employee Mental health support and health and wellness coaching.
Life insurance.
We have multiple internal employee resources groups, female mentorship programs, volunteering opportunities, and company-wide webinars, amongst other opportunities.
Other benefits are also available through the SLB flexible benefits program.
Flexible working
We are open to flexible, hybrid working with a combination of on-site & home working days.
