title: MACHINIST
description:
At SLB, we recognize that our innovation, creativity, and success stem from our differences. We actively recruit people with a diverse range of backgrounds and cultivate a culture of inclusion that unlocks the benefits of our diversity. We want to ensure that everyone feels a sense of belonging here and we encourage, enable, and empower our people to foster inclusivity, build trust, and demonstrate respect for across the organization.
Global in outlook, local in practice – and with a united, shared passion for discovering solutions, we hire talented, driven people and support them to succeed, personally and professionally.
The second shift Machinist located in Ville Platte, La must be capable of operating one type of machine to perform highly routine/repetitive work with minimal supervision. Detailed instruction and guidance are provided as needed. Continues growth in knowledge and skills and acquiring work experience. Typically requires 2-5 years’ experience. Come join one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive groups of industry experts. Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all.
Job Description
Demonstrates a proven working knowledge of various technical /machining principles. Tasks assigned require a basic knowledge of concepts and procedures.
Demonstrates the ability to solve basic problems with assistance. Recognizes problems in machining process and reports to appropriate supervisor and/or lead person in a timely manner.
Proficiently uses all required calibrated measuring instruments.
Reviews and comprehends blueprints, drawings, specifications or sample parts to determine dimensions and tolerances of part/product, sequence of operations and/or set up requirements.
Uses computer systems to retrieve relevant work documents such as engineering drawings, routings, and other documents as they relate to machining of valves or related products. Confers with programmer to suggest programming changes to improve manufacturing process.
Performs internal stenciling and or marking for required traceability purposes. Verifies correct material and heat number against internal traceability system prior to machining process.
Performs machine setups by selecting, aligning, and securing holding fixtures, cutting tools, attachments, accessories, on machines to include mills and/or lathes. With guidance, calculates and sets controls to regulate machining factors such as speed, feed, coolant, flow, and depth and angle of cut, or enters commands to retrieve, input or computerized machine control media.
Demonstrates a clear understanding of safety policies and procedures (Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Quest, etc.). Operates overhead crane and other capacity lifting equipment (forklift) safely (training provided).
Participates/contributes in continuous improvement initiatives and programs.
Provides informal guidance and support to new team members.
Embodies core values of responsibility, integrity, innovation, collaboration, and excellence.
Exhibits SLB behaviors of Commitment, Integrity, Teamwork, and Drive. The behaviors are expected of every SLB team member including attitude, words, and actions, as we interact with each other and with our external stakeholders.
Regular, punctual attendance is an essential job function.
Continually produces quality products with minimal defect rate by detecting own defects for ongoing corrective action.
Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write and/or complete routine reports.
Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
Qualifications and Experience
High school diploma or GED required.
Requires 2+ years’ experience in a related field or in a role that involves the use of hand and/or machine tools.
Candidates must be able to legally work and reside in the US, without sponsorship.

title: Supplier Contracts Attorney
description:
About Us
We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.
Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all.
Our inclusive culture is the key to our success. We collaborate with our internal community of colleagues, alumni, and our valued external partners to support each other and achieve our goals. We aim to raise the bar high. We look for people who are committed to innovation and success and act with integrity to become and be a part of one of the most diverse group of experts in our industry, anywhere around the globe.
Global in outlook, local in practice – and with a united, shared passion for discovering solutions, we hire talented, driven people and support them to succeed, personally and professionally.
Job Summary
The Attorney handles routine general legal tasks under the supervision of the Legal Team Lead, the Legal Counsel or other senior lawyer(s) in the assigned Legal Support Center (LSC), GeoUnit, Division, Technology Center, Corporate Legal or Ethics & Compliance groups at headquarters (HQ).   Depending on the assignment:
LSC/ GeoUnit/ Division:
Handles day-to-day legal matters in the assigned business unit.
Drafts, reviews and negotiates confidentiality, consulting, development agreements, and handles day-t-day contracts disputes for the assigned Technology Center.
Provides legal advice and support to Supply Chain and Contracts teams in drafting and negotiating all types of contracts to meet business and legal needs, including complex contracts in the assigned Technology Center (data privacy, research and development, IOT services, other digital products, licensing and certification).
Corporate Legal HQ:
Drafts, reviews and negotiates legal and commercial documents including letters of intent, supplier/procurement agreements, leases and licenses.
Maintains structures allocated to him/her, ensures the integrity of the Schlumberger corporate structure, and under supervision manages transactions related to such structures. Assists with reporting, filing and other issues regarding the exchanges on which Schlumberger securities are traded.
Assists the Legal Counsel in the assigned business unit(s) with: Conducting regular legal risk assessment, coordinating and documenting input from the business and other functions stakeholders, maintaining the risk database, taking responsibility for the implementation of the assigned risk mitigation actions; Managing litigations; Managing and supervising outside counsel; Handling internal investigations and compliance reviews; implementing procedures, practices, guidelines, templates and related training.
Interacts with support functions and departments in the assigned business unit(s), ensuring involvement of Legal in all matters that may have a legal impact on Schlumberger.
Provides legal support to ensure compliance with local regulations and Schlumberger Code of Ethics, including assisting in performing operations assurance reviews when requested.
Identifies and proposes improvements to existing legal procedures.
Documents lessons learned for sharing within the organization.
Minimum qualification & experience:
Professional degree in Law
Advanced Portuguese level
Advanced English level
1 or 2 years of experience
Location
The role is based in Bogota/Cota, Colombia.
SLB is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.

title: MIG Welder
description:

Clamp, hold, tack-weld, heat-bend, and grind component parts.
Detect faulty operation of equipment and materials.
Examine work for defects and ensure quality standards are met.
Operate hand and power tools common to the welding trade.
Use the guiding principles and tools of the Manufacturing System to drive continuous improvement, wherever applicable.

High school diploma or GED required.
Preference for one-year certificate from technical school or college.
Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a related field.
Demonstrated proficiency in GMAW (MIG) and FCAW (flux core) welding techniques.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work and reside in the United States without sponsorship.

About Us
We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.
At SLB, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. That is our purpose. As innovators, that’s been our mission for 100 years. Job Summary
As a Reservoir Engineer Trainee, you will support the delivery of reservoir engineering solutions and contribute to the development of innovative workflows and technologies. This entry-level opportunity combines engineering fundamentals with exposure to advanced reservoir engineering practices in one of the industry’s most dynamic environments.
During your first months, you will:
Contribute to ongoing reservoir engineering projects and customer engagements.
Learn to manage data preparation, reservoir simulation, and reporting within digital workflows.
Participate in structured training on SLB’s reservoir engineering software while receiving one-on-one guidance from experienced engineers.
Gain hands-on exposure through active project delivery, customer interactions, and collaboration with multi-disciplinary teams.
You will gradually develop expertise in reservoir simulation, engineering analysis, and solution delivery frameworks, building a foundation to become an independent technical contributor supporting our European operations.

Support the delivery and adoption of reservoir engineering projects, including simulation setup, data validation, and risk assessment, ensuring quality and timely execution.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to align engineering objectives, optimize workflows, and identify opportunities for software or process improvements.
Engage with customers through review meetings, progress reporting, and solution delivery, while promoting the adoption of reservoir engineering tools and workflows.
Ensure compliance with company policies, including quality, safety, and environmental standards, while participating in training and continuous improvement initiatives.

title: Senior Well Engineer
description:
The Senior Well Engineer is responsible for well engineering on a project and requires both detailed and broad well engineering and operations knowledge including the ability to design wells for a wide range of well types and different rig operations. title: Drilling Superintendent
description:
The Drilling Superintendent is responsible for providing operation and management support to the Country/Operations Manager and to the Rig Superintendent.  The Drilling Superintendent manages the company interests in the field in respect to the customers, the well program and all personnel onboard the rig.  This person coaches the Rig Manager in managing the rig as a safe, efficient and profitable independent unit while delivering value drilling services to customers.
Responsible for ensuring that policies, standards and procedures are implemented and understood for the operations under his care.
Promotes and coaches the practical implementation of QHSE MS system for the operations under care.
Ensure the rig has established and functioning system of assessments (CAT's) inspections and drills, with proper follow-up using QUEST.
Participate in HSE CMS, HiPo Light and Near Accident event investigations and follow-up.
Coaches the Rig Manager into establishing an efficient business unit.
Advises the Rig Manager on the rig during critical operations.
Ensure that equipment management and the Preventive Management Systems (PMS) programs are efficiently and effectively carried out.
Ensures that technical studies initiated by the Engineering Departments are followed up and developed.
Ensures that the Operations make efficient use of Technical Support Resources.
Supports the creation and organization of rig specific Technical and Operational Procedures, and Standard Work Instructions and get them implemented.
Maintains relationship with the customer's representative on the rig in coordination with the Rig Superintendent and/or the Country/Operation Manager.
* Ensures that the rigs under his care operate in accordance to contractual obligations and relevant legal and regulatory requirements.
Support implementation of new technologies and processes in rig operations.
Support the preparation of the Operations budget and utilization forecast and recommend when Operating costs can be streamlined.
Coaches the Rig Manager in the proper planning of the coming operations and ensuring that all materials and equipment are ready and compliant for key operations.
Ensures that minimum operational practices and standards are understood and followed.
Supports and advises Rig Manager and Rig superintendent in planning maintenance jobs to be carried out.
Monitors rigs and equipment inspection schedule as per Standards and Procedures.
Acts as front line training coach for the rig personnel.
Ensures that the Field Engineer Trainee program (FET program) and Field Technician Trainee program (FTT program) modular and certification programs are implemented.
Appraises the training needs of the field personnel and make recommendations to the Training department to allow the necessary training to be provided and improved.
Supports and implements the Competency System for senior positions and identifies areas of strength and development.
Provides continuous training development and coaching to Drillers, Supervisors and Rig Manager through competency assessments in line with the Competency System.
-15 years Minimum Experiance

title: HSE Specialist
description:
The HSE Specialist is responsible for supporting local management in establishing and continuously improving Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) culture within the worksite.
Develop managers' awareness and ensure HSE policies and standards are an integral part of line management responsibilities and objectives.
Assist line management with: Understanding and Implementing the HSE Management System; monitoring HSE objectives; liaising with local contractors and agencies regarding HSE; assessing local risks; generating local HSE procedures, work instructions and checklists; preparing and monitoring HSE plans that define how the HSE Management System is implemented at the location level; monitoring compliance to policies, standards and procedures; compliance audits and self-audits.
Advise management on corrective actions required.
Coordinate and participate in screening and HSE training of personnel, including contractors.
Keep abreast of new documentation and training material related to HSE and inform management accordingly.
Ensure that HSE documentation is updated and available onsite.
Advise management on the level local HSE compliance with Schlumberger, local and host country regulations.
Monitor and follow up on HSE reports and facilitate LPT meetings and HSE audits.
Support line management in investigations of failures and accidents.
Maintain a high level of HSE awareness among personnel through communication, training and promoting involvement in HSE programs.
Recommend improvements to the HSE program.
Review QUEST to ensure that logged data is correct and up to date.
Analyze HSE trends for the location.
-10 years Minimum Experiance

title: Completion & Well Intervention Engineer
description:
The Completion & Well Intervention Engineer is responsible for well engineering and operations support for one or more completion/workover rigs/rigless completion operation including preparing Completion and Workover Programs and procedures; and AFE's.  The Completion & Well Intervention Engineer supervises and mentors FET's and junior engineers.  This person attends critical operations at the wellsite as necessary in a technical advisory capacity.
Work with Subsurface and Production to ensure completion and workover plans meet requirements and objectives. * Reviews Completion Basis of Design and performs detailed design checks.
Review all completion hardware components for compatibility with clearances, setting pressure/turns/weight, and couplings.
Review regulatory requirements to determine downhole and surface safety equipment requirements and confirm compliance of final equipment configuration.
Review current well status and well integrity.
Prepare final well status post completion / workover.
Prepare completion / workover operations flowchart and contingencies.
Confirm final hardware design and compatibility (stimulation, treating, production) with TDAS.
Write program for making up sub-assemblies, drifting, gauging and pressure testing prior to them being RIH.
Determine required fluid density and composition for formation compatibility to minimize formation damage and manage fluid losses.
Review and determine compatibility of all slickline and wireline operations required.
Review fishing tool requirements and alternatives (workover).
Write program for setting cement plugs e.g. squeezing perforations, and any remedial cementing (workover).
Review and insure compliance with high pressure treating standards.
Ensure compliance with IPM Standards for Simultaneous Activities.
Ensure IPM Barrier Standards is complied with when removing the BOP and installing the Christmas Tree.
Prepares Completion / Workover Programs and follows the execution of programs technically.
Prepares Completion / Workover procedures.
Prepares Completion / Workover time estimates and AFE's.
Review the program with all parties involved (drilling contractor, completion, wellhead, slickline, etc.).
Participates in selection and evaluation of service companies, suppliers and equipment.
Ensures proper communication with relevant parties (client, Product Lines, third parties, etc.).
Participates in cost control of programs vs AFE by analyzing solutions."
Reviews new technology for possible application to project.
Uses InTouch for best practices, lessons learned and technical alerts.
Participates in HARC's.
Prepares requests for exemptions to IPM Standards in QUEST.
Enters SQ RIR's resulting from Completion / Workover operations in QUEST.
Prepares Management of Change to Completion / Workover programs.
Forecasts and plans medium and long term needs to meet program requirements.
Anticipates operational changes and needs and revises plan accordingly.
Participates in Daily Operations Meetings.
QA/QC of data in Daily Report.
Monitors daily progress against plan.
Monitors actual costs Vs AFE.
Record and monitor operational NPT trends.
Evaluates results Vs goals and performance of service companies.
Initiates engineering corrective action to ensure a process of continuous improvement.
Performs engineering studies to solve recurring problems (completion hardware problems, etc.).
-12 years Minimum Experiance

title: Well Engineer
description:
The Well Engineer is responsible for ensuring well engineering and operations support for one or more rigs or well sites. They are tasked with developing and delivering optimized technical well designs for areas of responsibility, including preparation of Well Proposals, Basis of Designs, Well Programs(i.e., Drilling, Completion, Workover), project budgets, and End of Well Reports. They perform Assistant Well Site Leader duties according to the Well Engineer Training Program development requirements. They also provide risk management project support and apply lessons learned to improve the well program and provide real-time support to the project operations as required. The position is expected to identify opportunities for continuous improvement of service delivery, well program, well operations, and formally communicate findings.
Provide technical and operational support throughout the project execution process.
Prepare well schedule, budget estimates, and project well control briefing.
Support multiple PL operations in a collaborative optimized program design.
Assist in incident response, recovery, and incident investigation.
Understand, communicate, and implement new technologies for the project.
Analyze job execution versus design and formally capture design improvements and optimization opportunities.
Participate in selection and evaluation of service companies, suppliers, and equipment.
Ensure proper communication with relevant parties (i.e., Customer, PLs, third-parties, etc.)
Participate in HARCs and other risk assessment methodology.
Forecast and plan medium- and long-term needs to meet program requirements
Anticipate operational changes and needs and revise the plan accordingly.
Manage and monitor daily operational progress (i.e., scope, time, cost and quality) versus plan and provide recommendations for improvements utilizing new technology options where appropriate.
Evaluate results versus objectives, focusing on service companies and key contractors performance.
Perform engineering studies to solve recurring well problems and initiate engineering corrective actions for continuous improvement.
Attend critical operations at the wellsite as necessary.
-12 years Minimum Experiance

title: Superintendent CWI
description:
The Superintendent CWI is responsible for the execution of well programs (drilling, completion, workover) to ensure that operations are performed in a safe, efficient and cost-effective manner. The Superintendent CWI is the focal point for the Wellsite Supervisor for reviewing daily operations and program changes. They act as focal point of communications between rig or well-site, Product Lines, and Third Parties and ensure resources are deployed efficiently.
Drive improvement of HSE processes through identifying and implementing action plans, which includes monitoring and recording project execution results, and recommending performance changes to improve project delivery, and auditing is performed regularly to ensure there is a continuous feedback loop.
Manage operations and ensure deliverables requirements are recorded to meet the planned project operations work.
Ensure quality process continuous improvement while validating project deliverables meet requirements for final acceptance.
Participate in pre-job planning/kickoff meetings while incorporating PLs, relevant contractors, and customer to ensure a common understanding.
Ensure compliance with Schlumberger policies and Integrated PL standards, including Integrated PL standing orders.
Demonstrate QHSE leadership in the project, including regular visits to the wellsite, and conduct QHSE/rig audits with the QHSE Coordinator.
Review operational problems and support job incidents, changes, incident response and recovery, including coordination with the individual PLs and key contractors.
Forecast and plan medium- and long-term to anticipate resources to meet operational program(s) requirements.
Manage and monitor operations, as well as assess and report operational progress.
Participate in the selection and evaluation of service companies, suppliers, and equipment.
Ensure cost control of the program versus project budget.
Coordinate operational activities of Schlumberger PLs and third-parties to ensure compliance with work program, optimum efficiency, and service quality.
Attend the rig site as needed for critical wellsite activities and consolidate lessons learned during the campaign.
Assure proper training and development of Well Site Supervisors and other personnel under their direct supervisions.
-13 years Minimum Experiance

title: Logistics Lead
description:
The Logistics Lead is responsible for executing and managing logistics operations for a country or basin, by finding a cost-efficient solution and ensuring maximum service level quality to field operations. The Logistics lead manages a team of logistics specialists, Import export specialists and logistics billing specialists.
Provides on-time logistics at a competitive cost to Operations.
Manages logistics specialists, Import export specialists and logistics billing specialists, ensuring the proper training path is accomplished, assess their competencies and identifies learning opportunities.
Ensures appropriate levels of support is given to internal/ external customers and works with the Logistics Manager to fill gaps.
Serves as the first point of contact for the logistics operational issues.
Implements and/ or supports logistics cost-saving initiatives.
Ensures compliance of all services and transactions to all applicable SLB and regulatory guidelines (including but not limited to, land transport guidelines, HSE policies, local and international regulations and dangerous goods requirements).
Ensure all Service Quality incidents are reported on time in QUEST and investigated when necessary.
Ensure timely escalation of potential service quality failures to line management.
Active involvement in reviewing and assessing the performance of logistics service providers through proactive engagement with Logistics Category/ Supplier Manager.
Proactive engagement with internal customers via regular business/ service quality reviews.
Ensure compliance of the team with internal procedures and management of deviations through proper change management protocol.
Stays current with all safety training requirements.
Is accountable for minimizing rental fleet idle time and optimizing truck capacity utilization.
Works closely with Operations to develop Mobilization/Demobilization (Mob/Demob) Forecast.
Works closely with Logistics specialist assigned to receive and execute the Mob/Demob plan.
The Logistics Lead would normally have logistics specialists and / or Import export specialists and/or logistics billing specialists reporting into him/her. In case the Logistics Lead is based in the LCT he/she may also have Intercompany Process Coordinators reporting into him/her. The supervisor's reporting line is into GU Logistics manager or into the SSC organization where applicable / based on location of the role.
The Logistics Supervisor would normally have logistics specialists and/or billing specialist reporting into him/her. In case the Logistics Supervisor is based in the LCT he/she may also have Intercompany Process Coordinators reporting into him/her. The supervisor's reporting line is into GU Logistcs manager or into the SSC organization where applicable / based on location of the role.
-12 years Minimum Experiance

title: Internet of Things (IoT) / Edge Engineer
description:
We are looking for an Instrumentation an d Control Engineer with knowledge and experience in IoT engineer ing to support the design, implementation, commissioning, and optimization of instrumentation, control, and industrial IoT solutions. This role bridges traditional I&C engineering with digital and IoT - based data acquisition and monitoring, supporting both project execution and operational
improvements.
Mandatory Job Description (Must Have):
Design, specify, and review instrumentation and control systems for energy and industrial facilities.
Prepare and review:
Instrument datasheets and specifications
P&IDs, loop diagrams, hook - up drawing
Control philosophies and cause & effect diagrams
Instrument index, I/O lists, and cable schedules
Select and size field instruments (pressure, temperature, flow, level, analyzers).
Support engineering and configuration of PLC, DCS, and SCADA systems.
Support FAT, SAT, commissioning, and start - up activities.
Coordinate with process, electrical, mechanical, and civil engineering teams.
Ensure compliance with industry standards (IEC, ISA, API, ISO).
Interface with clients, vendors, and system integrators.
Prepare technical documentation and engineering reports.
Additional Job Description (Nice to Have):
Support the implementation of industrial IoT (IIoT) solutions for data acquisition, monitoring, and diagnostics.
Assist in connecting field devices, sensors, or PLCs to IoT gateways or edge devices.
Understand and work with common IoT communication protocols (e.g., MQTT, OPC UA,Modbus TCP).
Support integration of plant data to cloud or on - premise platforms for visualization and analytics.
Participate in basic dashboarding, data trending, or condition monitoring use cases.
Collaborate with IT, OT, and digital teams on secure data connectivity and system integration.
Support troubleshooting of IoT - enabled monitoring systems during operation.
Technical Skill Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation, Control, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or Automation Engineering.
Typically 3 – 5 years of experience in instrumentation, control, or industrial automation.
Solid understanding of instrumentation and control engineering fundamentals , experience with PLC, DCS, and/or SCADA systems (any major vendor) , and have the competency to read and develop P&IDs and I&C engineering documentation.
Had exposure to IoT, digitalization, or smart monitoring projects in industrial or energy environments , familiar with IoT communication protocol (e.g. MQTT, OPC UA) . Had experience with Edge devices or industrial gateways , and Cloud or on - premise monitoring platforms (e.g.,Azure IoT, AWS IoT, or similar) .
Programming and Software : Proficiency in programming languages, such as Python, C/C++, and knowledge of IIoT platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS, Google Cloud).
Data Analytics : Skills in data analysis, machine learning, and statistical modeling to extract meaningful insights from sensor data, including creating the use cases simulator.
Personal Traits Qualifications:
Strong engineering mindset with curiosity for digital technologies.
Willingness to learn and adapt to IoT and digital transformation initiatives.
Structured problem - solving and attention to detail.
Good communication skills with both technical and non - technical stakeholders.
Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams (I&C, IT, OT, digital).
Self - motivated, reliable, and quality - focused.

title: Maintenance Associate

title: Oilfield PDC Drill Bit Repair Technician
description:
We are currently seeking a dedicated, detail‑oriented, and motivated individual to join our Nisku, AB team as a Oilfield PDC Drill Bit Repair Technician. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliable and timely delivery of drilling tools by performing high‑quality inspections, repairs, and maintenance of PDC (polycrystalline diamond compact) drill bits in accordance with customer and industry standards.
This is an excellent opportunity to join a high‑performing team that values safety, quality, and innovation. We offer access to world‑class training, skill development, and a comprehensive benefits program. Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all. For more information about SLB please visit
slb.com
.
Job Responsibilities
Inspecting and repairing PDC (polycrystalline diamond compact) drill bits.  Duties include detailed visual and dimensional inspections, brazing, blade, pocket and body repair, hard-facing, grinding, and final finishing to meet customer and industry specifications.
The technician documents repair processes, maintains quality control standards, and follows all safety and operational procedures while working with specialized tools and equipment.
Participate in continuous improvement efforts to improve asset turnaround time, which includes reducing downtime due to maintenance, parts, failures and work-in process.
Participate in failure investigations as assigned.
Minimum Job Qualifications
Completed High School Diploma.
Strong mechanical skills and attention to detail.
Experience in drill bit repair is required, and brazing experience is a definite asset.
Candidates should be able to read technical drawings, use precision measuring instruments, and work effectively in a shop environment.
The position may involve standing for long periods, working extended hours, and is essential to delivering reliable, high-quality drilling tools to oilfield customers.
Candidates must be able to legally work and reside in Canada, without sponsorship.
SLB Canada is committed to workplace diversity and employment equity and supports initiatives to enhance employment opportunities for local workforces and Indigenous Persons.
.

title: Real Time Support Analyst
description:
Position:
Position: Real Time Field Support Engineer
Job Summary:
As an Real Time Field Support engineer, you
continuously monitor the performance and health of hardware and software systems.
Perform regular system maintenance, upgrades, patching, and troubleshooting to prevent downtime and ensure optimal operation.
Implement and enforce IT security protocols, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, anti-virus solutions, and access controls.
Conduct vulnerability assessments and resolve security incidents.
Configure, monitor, and maintain enterprise network infrastructures including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and internet connectivity.
Optimize network performance and manage network hardware such as routers, switches, and load balancers.
Establish processes for secure data storage, backup, and recovery.
Ensure data integrity and availability in case of incidents such as hardware failures or cyberattacks.
Provide Tier 2/3 escalated support to users and applications teams, resolving infrastructure-related issues quickly.
Collaborate with helpdesk and support teams for incident and problem management.
Prepare and maintain accurate documentation for systems configuration, changes, incidents, and procedures.
Ensure compliance with industry standards, policies, and relevant regulations.
Develop, test, and maintain disaster recovery plans to assure business continuity in case of major infrastructure failures.
Monitor resource usage and forecast future requirements to ensure infrastructure meets business demands.
Evaluate and implement new technologies that can enhance performance or reduce costs.
Job Location:
Mumbai/ Delhi, India.
Reporting to Project Manager or Team Lead
Key Responsibilities:
Oversee system performance, address hardware and software issues, and ensure IT systems are consistently available and reliable.
Administer network security, manage firewalls, VPNs, backup solutions, disaster recovery strategies, and oversee access controls.
Maintain thorough documentation of infrastructure setups and processes, ensuring adherence to industry best practices and compliance requirements.
Assist in the deployment and maintenance of virtualization technologies, cloud infrastructures, and enterprise management tools, including platforms for monitoring, patching, and automation.
Work closely with IT teams to facilitate seamless application rollouts, updates, and continuous optimization of infrastructure for increased scalability and enhanced performance.
Continuously assess infrastructure for potential vulnerabilities or capacity issues and implement proactive measures to mitigate risks.
Comprehend the responsibilities of various stakeholders and coordinate the collection of project data among service providers, client organizations, and real-time data sources.
Deliver support to on-site personnel, partner with project teams, client organizations, and remote operation units to ensure the efficient operation of applications and systems, including troubleshooting, maintenance, and system upgrades.
Track service quality, apply Incident Escalation Procedures effectively, and alert supervision ahead of potential concerns.
Apply Data Confidentiality Standards and IT Security Policies diligently for all processes related to data acquisition, storage, transfer, and archiving.
Keep Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Scorecards updated and play an active role in HSE safety initiatives.
Behaviour:
Learn quickly and adapt to new problems and situations.
Pursues everything with energy, drive, and a need to finish. Use logic to solve problems with effective solutions.
Is personally committed to continuous improvement.
Listens and can communicate effectively with managers, peers and clients both written and verbally.
Experience & Exposures:
Qualification –
B.tech /BCA /BSC IT.
Relevant Experience –
Minimum 5 years’ experience in IT Domain to manage and monitor IT Infrastructure (Server, Storage, Switches).
Environment –
On land
Language -
English / Hindi.
Experience & Exposures:
Qualification –
B.tech /BCA /BSC IT.
Relevant Experience –
Minimum 5 years’ experience in IT Domain to manage and monitor IT Infrastructure (Server, Storage, Switches).

title: Drilling Data Analyst
description:
Position:
Drilling Data Analyst
Job Summary:
As a Drilling Data Analyst, you will provide technical expertise and support to deliver exceptional services for data capture, management, and reporting throughout the entire lifecycle for wellsite drilling & workover operations. Using data reporting tools and techniques, you will apply your knowledge and understanding to ensure daily reporting of well-site activity (dysfunctional symptoms, executing KPI-based analytics, and conducting NPT/ILT time analysis.). This includes data capture from various service providers, client organization, real-time data sources and other data formats to ensure streamlined data capture via reporting tools. You will also monitor the reporting for mandatory parameters and maintain records to monitor daily reporting quality. You will receive training that expands your technical knowledge and hands-on skillset.
Job Location:
Duliajan, Navi Mumbai and Dehradun, India.
Reporting to Project Manager or Team Lead
Key Responsibilities:
Perform daily reporting of wellsite operations and be accountable for overall performance of timely data capture and reporting including configuration, loading, QC, monitoring and troubleshooting of operational activity for the asset / location
Ensure seamless data is captured with reporting applications including monitoring of mandatory reports, data sources, report formats including units, identifiers, meanings, normal value ranges to identify and fix data issues proactively.
Learn the reporting application, system installation and configuration, troubleshooting process and keep track of issues and resolution
Understand the role of different stakeholders and coordinate project data collection across service companies, client organization, real time data providers
Provide support to the on-site team, collaborate with the project team, client organization and remote operations support to ensure smooth and reliable function of application software and systems, including system upgrades, troubleshooting and maintenance activities
Monitor service quality, understand and utilize the Incident Escalation Procedures and pre-emptively inform supervisors when potential issues arise
Understand and Implement the Data Confidentiality Standards and IT Security Policies across all activities related to data capture, storage, transfer and archival
Maintain HSE Scorecards and actively contribute to HSE Safety Programs
Behaviour:
Learn quickly and adapt to new problems and situations.
Pursues everything with energy, drive, and a need to finish. Use logic to solve problems with effective solutions.
Is personally committed to continuous improvement.
Listens and can communicate effectively with managers, peers and clients both written and verbally.
Experience & Exposures:
Qualification –
Graduation Degree in Mechanical/Information Technology/ Computer
Science/ or equivalent/ Higher degree.
Relevant Experience –
Minimum 3 years’ experience in data analytics and minimum 1 year
experience in data analytics in in upstream drilling operation.

On land rotational

title: Data Scientist
description:
Job Description
Build, train, and deploy large-scale, self-supervised "foundation" models that learn rich representations of time series, sequential sensor data in addition to textual and vision data, to be fine-tuned for tasks such as anomaly/event detection, predictive maintenance, forecasting, classification, or multi-modal sensor fusion for industrial and scientific applications.
Data/Signal Processing
• Time Series & Sequential Data: processing, augmentation, feature engineering for financial, industrial, IoT, medical, or other sensor streams (univariate/multivariate time series).
• Sensor Data Analysis: expertise with diverse sensor modalities (e.g., accelerometers, temperature, vibration, audio, images), sampling rates, synchronization, and real-world noise/artifact handling.
• Multi-Modality Learning: integrating heterogeneous data types (time series, images, text, audio, structured) into robust deep learning architectures; cross-modal representation learning.
Machine Learning & Foundation Model Expertise
• Self-supervised and Semi-supervised Learning: time series foundation models, masked modeling, contrastive methods, temporal predictive coding, multimodal alignment and fusion.
• Model Architectures: sequence models (RNNs, GRU/LSTM, TCN), 1D/2D/3D CNNs, Transformers (BERT, ViT, TimeSFormer), graph neural networks, diffusion/generative models, multi-modal/fusion encoders.
• Transfer Learning & Fine-Tuning at Scale: prompt/adapter-based strategies, temporal domain adaptation, few-shot learning for specialized tasks.
• Evaluation Metrics: regression/classification (MSE, F1, AUC), time series similarity (DTW, correlation), event detection/segmentation (IoU, accuracy), business/end-user KPIs.
Software & Infrastructure
• Programming: expert Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas), C++/CUDA for custom kernels and high-performance preprocessing.
• Deep Learning Frameworks: PyTorch (Lightning, Distributed), TensorFlow/Keras, JAX/Flax.
• Large-scale Training: multi-GPU, multi-node clusters, mixed-precision, ZeRO optimization, scalable data loaders for long sequences.
• Data Engineering: robust pipelines for ingesting, cleaning, segmenting, and aligning large-scale, time-synchronized multi-sensor datasets.
Mathematical & Algorithmic Foundations
• Linear Algebra, Probability & Statistics, Optimization (stochastic, convex/non-convex, Bayesian).
• Signal Processing: Fourier/wavelet analysis, filters (Kalman, Savitzky–Golay), resampling, noise modeling.
• Numerical Methods: ODE/PDE solvers, inverse problems, regularization, time-frequency methods for complex systems.
Collaboration & Communication
• Cross-disciplinary teamwork with domain experts, engineers, product owners, and end-users from industrial, scientific, or medical backgrounds.
• Clear presentation of complex model behaviors (interpretability, attention analysis), uncertainty quantification, and value impact.
MS / Ph.D. in computer science, data science and AI or related fields.
3+ years of relevant experience in data science and AI or related fields.

Somos una empresa tecnológica que abre el acceso a la energía en beneficio de todos. Como innovadores, esa ha sido nuestra misión durante casi un siglo. title: Digital & Directional Drilling Engineer
description:
The Digital Drilling Engineer (DDE) for Directional Drilling is responsible for the implementation, office adoption and customer support of DrillPlan, DrillOps and Drilling Data projects. The DDE provides digital drilling product support to end users to achieve the defined deliverables and performance as per the scope of work of each specific project. The DDE will provide technical and drilling expertise on how to maximize value of the digital tools to the customer. In addition, DDE will capture software enhancements ideas and communicate to the digital organization. DDE will be first point of contact for customers who will guide them through Digital Drilling change management process. This position establishes trusted advisor relationship with customer and understands their technical challenges. DDE with in-depth knowledge ensure the quality of service delivery on assigned projects.
Responsibilities
Advise Sales & Commercial on technical requirements and bid clarifications responses.
Perform the project technical analysis and potential value of Digital solutions based on past wells analysis and project scope of work.
Participates in technical discussions for customer workflow optimization and requirements.
Participate in Market Segmentation exercise, perform technology gap analysis and help build the GeoUnit strategy.
Capture leads and opportunities for application of differentiated technology packages.
Initiates engineering corrective action to ensure a process of continuous improvement.
Promote cross-Domain / cross-BL solutions.
Report on competition technology application in the GeoUnit.
Leads DrillPlan and DrillOps deployment in GU, Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely delivery for digital drilling projects.
Hold performance reviews with customers.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering
Professional License CREA active
Previous experience in offshore Directional Drilling operations
Advanced English, Portuguese Fluent
Valid documentation to live and work in Brazil

description:

O Especialista em HSE será responsável por apoiar a gestão local no estabelecimento e na melhoria contínua da cultura de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) dentro do local de trabalho.
Será responsável por realizar visitas em campos de operações.

Desenvolver a conscientização dos gestores e garantir que as políticas e padrões de HSE sejam parte integrante das responsabilidades e objetivos da linha de gestão.
Auxiliar a gestão na: compreensão e implementação do Sistema de Gestão de HSE; monitoramento de objetivos de HSE; interação com contratados locais e órgãos reguladores sobre HSE; avaliação de riscos locais; elaboração de procedimentos, instruções de trabalho e checklists de HSE locais; preparação e acompanhamento de planos de HSE que definam como o Sistema de Gestão de HSE é implementado no nível da unidade; monitoramento da conformidade com políticas, padrões e procedimentos; realização de auditorias de conformidade e autoavaliações.

Coordenar e participar da triagem e dos treinamentos de HSE do pessoal, incluindo contratados.

Monitorar e acompanhar relatórios de HSE e facilitar reuniões e auditorias de HSE.
Apoiar a gestão nas investigações de falhas e acidentes.
Manter um alto nível de conscientização em HSE entre os colaboradores por meio de comunicação, treinamentos e incentivo à participação em programas de HSE.
Recomendar melhorias no programa de HSE.
Revisar o QUEST para assegurar que os dados registrados estejam corretos e atualizados.
Analisar as tendências de HSE da unidade/local.

Formação Técnica em Segurança do Trabalho
Experiência como técnico de segurança, preferencialmente em operações na indústria de
O&G
.

title: Engenheiro (a) de Qualidade
description:
Resumo da vaga
Atuar como ponto focal de interface com Supply Management e funções de QA/QC, garantindo inspeções integradas, melhoria do desempenho de fornecedores e gestão de TPI’s indicados pelo cliente.
Os principais projetos relacionados a esta posição são a fabricação de skids de processo, módulos offshore e vasos de pressão, incluindo o fornecimento de instrumentos, válvulas e materiais de E&I por fornecedores.
Principais Responsabilidades
Executar relatórios periódicos para extração de solicitações de trabalho SAP.
Revisar especificações, códigos e normas aplicáveis da indústria (NR, ASME, AWS, ISO, API, entre outras) em relação aos requisitos do projeto.
Liderar melhorias de processos, incluindo investigação de causa raiz e implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
Desenvolver, implementar e manter especificações do cliente e requisitos regulatórios brasileiros, bem como a documentação da qualidade.
Desenvolver, revisar e aprovar documentos de fornecedores, como ITPs, procedimentos de fabricação e END, relatórios de END, etc.
Coordenar com fornecedores as inspeções e a compilação de documentos (MDB).
Criar, classificar, atribuir, acompanhar e encerrar Relatórios de Incidentes de Qualidade.
Liderar e coordenar investigações de Qualidade junto à equipe de investigação para evitar recorrências.
Gerenciar o processo de NCR (Relatório de Não Conformidade) de fornecedores.
Comunicar ativamente problemas e gargalos ao time de Gerencia de projetos e Supply Chain.
Executar tarefas e projetos especiais conforme designado pelo PSL e pelo RQM.
Capturar lições aprendidas durante a execução das atividades e recomendar treinamentos necessários ou fornecer feedback ao projeto e aos fornecedores para implementação.
Garantir que todas as mudanças de escopo sejam devidamente gerenciadas, implementadas e reportadas.
Engajar fornecedores em processos de melhoria contínua, incluindo avaliação de novos fornecedores e auditorias periódicas em fornecedores existentes (planejamento, preparação, execução, reporte de resultados e acompanhamento da eficácia das ações corretivas).
Desenvolver Planos de Melhoria da Qualidade de Fornecedores.
Reportar periodicamente ao RQM o status das atividades de Qualidade, utilização e demais tarefas atribuídas.
Requisitos e Qualificações
Formação superior em Engenharia.
Experiência como Engenheiro(a) de Qualidade, Manufatura, Fabricação ou Soldagem, ou equivalente, Inspetor(a) / Supervisor(a) da Qualidade.
Conhecimento de normas para projeto de equipamentos de processo para o setor de óleo e gás.
Conhecimento de requisitos de inspeção e Ensaios Não Destrutivos.
Experiência com ferramentas e técnicas da Qualidade.
Inglês avançado.
Diferenciais
Experiência em ambientes industriais de médio a grande porte, com processos de usinagem, soldagem e montagem de skids, módulos offshore e vasos de pressão, Ensaios Não Destrutivos e inspeções especiais, além de jateamento e pintura/revestimento.
Qualificação como Auditor Interno.
Histórico comprovado de melhoria de desempenho em Qualidade.
Capacidade de criar requisitos de qualidade alinhados aos critérios de projeto.
Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de PFDs e P&IDs complexos.
Conhecimento de diferentes materiais de construção.
Conhecimento das normas ASME Seção VIII Divisão 1, AWS D1.1 e ASME B31.3.
Experiência em vasos de pressão e soldagem estrutural.
Certificação CWI (desejável).
Certificação NACE (desejável).
Certificação de Inspetor de Soldagem Nível 1 ou 2 (AWS, FBTS ou CSWIP) – desejável.
Certificação END Nível 2 (ABENDI) – desejável.
Domínio de ferramentas como Word, Excel e PowerPoint.

title: Especialista de Campo Direccional o MWD
description:
¿Quiénes somos?
Somos una empresa tecnológica que abre el acceso a la energía en beneficio de todos. Como innovadores, esa ha sido nuestra misión durante casi un siglo. Hoy enfrentamos el imperativo global de crear un futuro con más energía, pero menos carbono. Nuestros diversos e innovadores agentes de cambio están enfocados en avanzar en la innovación e inventar las nuevas tecnologías energéticas que necesitamos para lograrlo.
SLB ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Las solicitudes son consideradas sin distinción de raza, color, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, origen nacional, edad, discapacidad u otras características protegidas por la ley.
Descripción del puesto:
¡Tenemos una oportunidad para vos! Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de una persona para el puesto de Especialista de Campo Direccional O MWD. Sus principales tareas son la realización de servicios de perforación direccional, incluyendo la planeación y ejecución de todas las fases de un trabajo direccional para la entrega de servicios que cumplan con las expectativas del cliente.
Desafíos:
Planificar el trabajo en yacimiento; incluyendo coordinación de herramientas, movilización, preparación y programación de los equipos, instalación de sensores.
Armado/ desarmado de BHA, monitoreo y optimización de parámetros de perforación, toma de surveys, ejecución de la trayectoria acorde a lo planificado, implementar estrategias para mejorar ROP.
Escalar y reportar fallas o problemas a oficina cuando sea necesario, asegurar la calidad de la ejecución en sitio.
Actuar como punto focal entre SLB y el cliente durante las operaciones de perforación en el sitio de trabajo.
Preparar los reportes finales del pozo y la entrega de los productos finales del cliente.
Requisitos mínimos:
3 a 5 años de experiencia mínima en empresa de servicios en el área de direccional o de mediciones.
Experiencia como dual (Conocimientos de MWD y Direccional), deseada.
Experiencia en la cuenca neuquina con pozos no convencional, deseada.
Nivel intermedio de idioma inglés.
Consideraciones para tener en cuenta:
Diagrama 14x7
Turnos de Trabajo: 12 horas, alternando un diagrama de día y uno de noche.
Locación: Neuquén, pernoctando en yacimiento
Esta posición se realiza en locaciones remotas y es 100% presencial
Requiere realizar tareas físicas o manuales y manejo de datos.
En caso de que requieras algún ajuste razonable para cubrir la posición, por favor no dejes de aclararlo tu postulación.

title: Automation Engineer
description:
Description
Technology Automation Engineers are responsible to design, develop, document, test, and commission automation systems within constraints such as development cost, product quality, product safety, and time. In this job, the engineer is expected to work effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with other engineering domains, such as mechanical, electrical, and IT, to solve cross domain problems that automate equipment, processes and business workflows related to the use of sensors, actuators, software, and IT infrastructure to accomplish a specific task.
Automation Engineers Effectively Employee Expertise Related To
Manufacturing Engineering
Mechatronics Engineering
Software Control System Engineering
Responsibilities
Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis to ensure manufacturing production continuity
Create intuitive human-machine interfaces using FactoryTalk ME and Ignition
Develop database applications using Ignition and SQL for tracking downtime, performance, etc.
Program and debug ladder logic and structure text code on Allen-Bradley controlLogix PLC
Maintain and configure industrial ethernet network of automation devices as Robots, PLC, VFD, hydraulic press, etc.
Program and debug Fanuc robot programs
Manage and support automation projects that involve cross functional teams such as manufacturing, sustaining and IT teams
Assist maintenance & production personnel in operation and maintenance of equipment
General Skills
Walk and stand for prolonged periods of time in a loud manufacturing environment that is not always climate controlled.
Ability to promptly respond to, and address issues within a timely manner
Possesses a high degree of initiative
Adaptable and willing to learn new technologies
Keeps abreast of key developments in relevant technologies and existing standards
Able to work under pressure
Excellent oral, written communication, and interpersonal skills
Able to work independently or as part of a team
Effectively analyzes and solves problems with attention to the root cause

title: Data and Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job Title:
Data and Infrastructure Engineer
About Us:
We are a global technology company, driving energy innovation for a balanced planet.​
Together, we create amazing technology that unlocks access to energy for the benefit of all.​
Our inclusive culture is the key to our success. We collaborate with our internal community of colleagues, alumni, and our valued external partners to support each other and achieve our goals. We aim to raise the bar high. We look for people who are committed to innovation and success and act with integrity to become and be a part of one of the most diverse group of experts in our industry, anywhere around the globe.
Global in outlook, local in practice – and with a united, shared passion for discovering solutions, we hire talented, driven people and support them to succeed, personally and professionally.
More than 98,000 employees over 120 countries already started their SLB journeys. Start yours now!
If you would like to know more, please visit our website at
https://www.slb.com/
Job Summary:
Data and Infrastructure Engineer responsibility is in two main aspects; First, responsible for organizing, collecting, processing, and storing of data from different sources and transforming raw, unstructured data into formats that can be used for analysis including architectures such as databases, servers, and large-scale processing systems. Second, responsible for the design, planning, management, maintenance, and support, and any other technological duties associated with an organization’s cloud computing environment including support of an application on any SLB supported cloud.
Other Reports to:
Service Delivery Engineer - SIS (82720011) or D&I Solutions Delivery Manager (82940262)
Tasks and Responsibilities:
Managing cloud environments in accordance with company security guidelines.
Act as focal point for gathering system requirements from application architects and owners to ensure seamless transformation and loading of data across different cloud vendors such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
Responsible for Data loading, data migration, and data retrieval.
Be customer advisor on data governance, policies, roles, and dataflow.
Responsible for assembling large, complex sets of data that meet non-functional and functional business requirements.
Perform data mapping, data quality control for one to multiple data sources.
Run assessment of a company data and infrastructure environment with proposed improvement and recommendations.
Work with stakeholders including data, design, product and executive teams and assisting them with data-related technical issues.
Use API knowledge to design RESTful services, and integrate them with existing data providers, using JSON or XML as needed.
Responsible for maintaining existing company databases using experience; which includes a working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL, and related data stores such as Postgres.
Resopsible for debugging technical issues inside a complex stack involving virtualization, containers, microservices, etc.
Collaborates with the engineering teams to enable digital applications to run on cloud infrastructure correctly, performantly and efficiently.
Responsible for the deployment using container technologies: Docker and Kubernetes.
Gather/Keep experience working with OpenStack, Linux/UNIX, Rackspace, Docker and Microsoft Azure as applicable for the customer and Schlumberger implementation.
Responsible for having a working knowledge of web services, APIs, REST and RPC.
Handle incoming incidents change requests and problems as a first line of support.
Responsible for operating, designing development, testing and implementing of infrastructure systems and hardware with automation in mind.
Responsible for estimating project value/development plans, evaluating from an infrastructure point-of-view and maintain close liaison with the customer.
Responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date documentation on all activities.
Participates in out-of-office on-call rotation as required.
Responsible for installing and configuring IOT Agora solutions including Infrastructure, network setup & SDK Implementation.
Maintains and supporting existing on-premises applications from licensing, installation, and configuration if applicable.
Responsible for gather/developing experience working on OSDU community code and Schlumberger Enterprise Data Management (EDM) workflows.
Qualifications and Experience:
Full Australian working rights.
Bachelors or Masters of Engineering, Software Engineering/ Data Science is preferrable
SLB is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status. We are committed to providing employment opportunities for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people.

Implement actions to continuously reduce wasted time, money and resources.
Comply with Schlumberger and local procedures applicable to the job function.

Previous experience in Supply Chain, Purchasing or Expediting of 10 years.
Previous experience in managing teams.

Effective business communication (written and oral).

Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, or Manufacturing (or comparable degree) or requisite work experience.

description:

Drilling Data Analyst
Job Summary:
As a Drilling Data Analyst, you will provide technical expertise and support to deliver exceptional services for data capture, management, and reporting throughout the entire lifecycle for wellsite drilling & workover operations. valuate new invention disclosures and recommends disposition to management.

s

title: Commercial and Business Internship
description:
An internship is your opportunity to understand how we work and whether our culture is right for you. It’s also your chance to show us that you have the right skills and attitude to succeed here. Our internships are paid positions offering opportunities to use what you’ve learned at university on real projects.
When you join one of our Commercial and Business teams, you’ll see firsthand the expertise that goes into building and sustaining a leading energy company. Be a part of business decisions that accelerate us on the path to the next big win, working alongside the best talent to take us there.
Finance
Help our finance team provide global support to every business area and keep key stakeholders on track for excellent financial performance. Interning here is your opportunity to understand how a global organization manages its business and finances in one of the most dynamic industries in the world. You’ll rotate through different functions and always work on live projects alongside professional accountants. If you’re looking for truly complex challenges with real impact, this internship will give you the opportunities and support to start solving them.
To apply, you must be studying for a bachelor’s degree in accounting or a professional qualification in accounting (e.g. ACCA, ICAEW, CPA etc.).
Human Resources
If you’re interested in working in Human Resources (HR), our internships offer unique insights into a business that has succeeded by recruiting talented people and putting them in a position to succeed. You’ll contribute to innovative projects that are key to helping our people do great work. You’ll work across the business and collaborate with different areas giving you a greater understanding of the role of HR in a global business and where your skills could make a difference.
To apply, you must be studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in an HR-related discipline.
Supply Chain
You’ll work on a varied range of projects to understand how we manage our complex, international supply chain and get the essential items our people need in the right place at the right time. It’s an important part of any business but especially ours. The experience you gain will help you progress in an exciting supply chain career in an international environment.
We have opportunities many areas including but not limited to Procurement, Sourcing, Logistic, Material Management, Supply Planning, Warehouse Management, and Facility Management
To apply, you must be studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in supply chain management, industrial distribution, business administration, engineering, or management.

Geophysicist

title: Early Careers - Geoscience&Petrotechnical
description:
On our Geoscience and Petrotechnical teams, proven expertise and intelligent tech meet, powering our legacy and future of subsurface solutions. Whether in the field or our learning centers, your unique skills and understanding of hydrocarbons will help solve the toughest challenges for clients every day. And with a start at SLB, you’ll be set up for a bright future making a real impact across our business and industry.
As a
Geologist
, you will combine your understanding of earth sciences with a comprehensive knowledge of the latest logging technologies to determine reservoir architecture and hydrocarbon potential. You will become adept at multiple software systems and work closely with customers to find innovative ways to solve some of their most complex challenges.
As one of our
Geophysicists
, you will apply your knowledge and expertise of the earth’s properties to enhance interpretations of geological data and greater define how we understand the subsurface. We acquire huge amounts of often previously unseen seismic and geophysical data around the world and you will help transform it into the knowledge that powers better decision-making and more effective, more efficient services. You will be involved in the acquisition, processing and interpretation of that data and we offer a range of career opportunities to develop your skills and get exposure across the data lifecycle.
As a
Petrophysicist
, you will combine logging data from multiple downhole sensors with sample data to determine hydrocarbon production capacity, lithology and fluid saturation of the reservoir to ultimately help us optimize its production. You will incorporate data from multiple wells and additional sensors to consider acoustics, spectroscopy and magnetic resonance to enhance overall accuracy or build a clearer picture of the reservoir by understanding its permeability and mechanical properties.
As a
Reservoir Engineer
, you will use data and our leading software products and solutions to create reservoir models that help clients make decisions that deliver safer, optimized, long-term production for each reservoir by simulating fluid flow phase behavior and reservoir physical properties.
As a
Production Optimization Engineer
, you will deliver performance improvements to our clients’ assets worldwide though virtual representations of our downhole products which incorporate calculations, finite element analysis (FEA), computation fluid dynamics (CFD), costing and parametric modeling into one cohesive system.
Requirements
Meet
minimum degree requirements
Technically curious and determined to improve approaches and methods of discovery
Ambitious and looking to take on responsibility
Able to effectively contribute to a team

title: Early Careers - Field Operations
description:
Join the frontier of energy innovation. In a range of career paths, you’ll gain real experience on-site while using your expertise to deliver leading tech solutions.
As a
Field Engineer
, you will be involved in every part of our business. From acquiring essential data to planning long-term well development, you will organize, run, and report operations in the field environment and assist Specialists and other Engineers with key decisions. Your training will be hands-on as you learn about the energy industry and become an expert in the various tools and services in your business line. With the help of management and a comprehensive development program, you will be given responsibility and support to make your impact and start becoming a leader in our business.
Our
Field Specialists
focus on the vital technical and operational procedures that ensure our sites are safe and our customers get exceptional service. You will receive intensive instruction in troubleshooting, safety, and client interaction to develop a deep technical understanding of what we do. Through a combination of hands-on learning and formal training, you will become the company’s representative on-site, with supervisory responsibility, working through a range of complex, practical challenges and developing innovative strategies to solve them.
As a
Field Technical Analyst
, you will provide technical expertise to teams across the site and use your knowledge to help them deliver exceptional service. Using a variety of tools and techniques, you will apply your theoretical understanding to the practical challenges we face on-site every day. This includes creating formation evaluation logs and helping to analyze and interpret cuttings to determine rock type and hydrocarbon presence. You will also help monitor the well parameters and maintain sensors to understand well conditions. An extensive development program will expand your technical knowledge and hands-on skillset.

Perform operations, operate equipment, and be accountable for team wellsite performance by the end of your training
Manage field operations, including engineering design, maintenance, job planning, and operational reporting
Learn the well construction process and understand the role of different service companies
Support engineers and specialists on-site and help with essential duties, such as risk analysis
Effectively manage a crew and/or processes within a year
Help prepare wellsite reports and post-job debriefings
Actively contribute to continuous improvement culture across the business
Qualifications and Experience
Meet
minimum degree/experience requirements
Good verbal and written communication skills
Fluency in written and spoken English
Quick learner able to use logic to solve problems
Be personally committed to continuous improvement
Evidence of leadership and teamwork skills

title: Early Careers - Geoscience&Petrotechnical
description:
On our Geoscience and Petrotechnical teams, proven expertise and intelligent tech meet, powering our legacy and future of subsurface solutions. Whether in the field or our learning centers, your unique skills and understanding of hydrocarbons will help solve the toughest challenges for clients every day. And with a start at SLB, you’ll be set up for a bright future making a real impact across our business and industry.
As a
Geologist
, you will combine your understanding of earth sciences with a comprehensive knowledge of the latest logging technologies to determine reservoir architecture and hydrocarbon potential. You will become adept at multiple software systems and work closely with customers to find innovative ways to solve some of their most complex challenges.
As one of our
Geophysicists
, you will apply your knowledge and expertise of the earth’s properties to enhance interpretations of geological data and greater define how we understand the subsurface. We acquire huge amounts of often previously unseen seismic and geophysical data around the world and you will help transform it into the knowledge that powers better decision-making and more effective, more efficient services. You will be involved in the acquisition, processing and interpretation of that data and we offer a range of career opportunities to develop your skills and get exposure across the data lifecycle.
As a
Petrophysicist
, you will combine logging data from multiple downhole sensors with sample data to determine hydrocarbon production capacity, lithology and fluid saturation of the reservoir to ultimately help us optimize its production. You will incorporate data from multiple wells and additional sensors to consider acoustics, spectroscopy and magnetic resonance to enhance overall accuracy or build a clearer picture of the reservoir by understanding its permeability and mechanical properties.
As a
Reservoir Engineer
, you will use data and our leading software products and solutions to create reservoir models that help clients make decisions that deliver safer, optimized, long-term production for each reservoir by simulating fluid flow phase behavior and reservoir physical properties.
As a
Production Optimization Engineer
, you will deliver performance improvements to our clients’ assets worldwide though virtual representations of our downhole products which incorporate calculations, finite element analysis (FEA), computation fluid dynamics (CFD), costing and parametric modeling into one cohesive system.
Requirements
Meet
minimum degree requirements
Technically curious and determined to improve approaches and methods of discovery
Ambitious and looking to take on responsibility
Able to effectively contribute to a team
Good written and verbal communication
Focused on quality

title: Estágio - Banco de Talentos | Taubaté/SP
description:
Programa de Estágio – Banco de Talentos | Taubaté/SP
Descrição da vaga
Você gostaria de construir sua carreira em uma das maiores empresas de energia e tecnologia do mundo?
Estamos criando um
Banco de Talentos de Estágio (Evergreen)
para a OneSubsea. Isso significa que manteremos esta vaga
aberta de forma contínua
, recebendo candidatos ao longo do ano, para atender oportunidades futuras em nossa unidade de Taubaté.
Se você busca aprendizado, desafios reais, ambiente diverso e grandes possibilidades de desenvolvimento, queremos conhecer você!
Responsabilidades
As responsabilidades podem variar de acordo com a área que abrirá a vaga, mas podem incluir:
Apoiar rotinas administrativas e operacionais da área;
Contribuir com análises, controles e relatórios;
Participar de reuniões e projetos internos;
Colaborar com melhorias de processos e iniciativas de inovação;
Auxiliar no planejamento e execução de atividades específicas da área de atuação.
Importante:
durante o processo seletivo, você será considerado(a) para as áreas que melhor se alinhem ao seu perfil, formação e interesses.
Requisitos
Estar regularmente matriculado(a) em curso de nível superior (Bacharelado, Técnico ou Tecnólogo);
Previsão de formatura a partir de 2028;
Disponibilidade para estagiar 6h/dia na unidade de Taubaté (modalidade híbrida ou presencial, conforme área);
Conhecimento do pacote Office;
Boa comunicação, organização e vontade de aprender.
Diferenciais
Inglês intermediário ou avançado;
Participação em projetos acadêmicos, iniciação científica, empresas júnior ou atividades extracurriculares;
Vivência prévia em estágios ou atividades práticas.
O que oferecemos
Bolsa-auxílio compatível com o mercado;
Vale-transporte;
Refeição no local
Acesso a plataformas de aprendizagem;
Assistência Social e Psicológica
Consultoria Jurídica e Financeira
Possibilidade de participar de projetos reais e relevantes;
Ambiente colaborativo, diverso e com foco no desenvolvimento profissional.
Como funciona a vaga evergreen?
Esta vaga permanecerá ativa durante todo o ano para compor nosso
Banco de Talentos de Estágio
.
À medida que as áreas abrem novas oportunidades, os candidatos inscritos podem ser chamados para as próximas etapas do processo seletivo.
Local de atuação
Taubaté/SP
– Unidade OneSubsea
Como se candidatar?
Clique em “Aplicar” e envie seu currículo atualizado.
Seus dados serão analisados continuamente, e entraremos em contato assim que houver uma oportunidade compatível com o seu perfil.
A SLB é uma empresa comprometida com a igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os candidatos qualificados são considerados independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou condição de veterano.

title: Operaciones de Fractura
description:
¿Quiénes somos?
Somos una empresa tecnológica que abre el acceso a la energía en beneficio de todos. Como innovadores, esa ha sido nuestra misión durante casi un siglo. Hoy enfrentamos el imperativo global de crear un futuro con más energía, pero menos carbono. Nuestros diversos e innovadores agentes de cambio están enfocados en avanzar en la innovación e inventar las nuevas tecnologías energéticas que necesitamos para lograrlo.
SLB ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Las solicitudes son consideradas sin distinción de raza, color, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, origen nacional, edad, discapacidad u otras características protegidas por la ley.
Descripción del puesto:
¡Tenemos una oportunidad para vos! Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de una persona para el puesto de
Operaciones de Fractura
. La posición es responsable de identificar oportunidades para mejorar la prestación de servicios y ayuda a los equipos de campo y mantenimiento a preparar el equipo para las operaciones.
Desaf
í
os:
Operar y mantener equipos de fractura en yacimiento.
Supervisar y realizar los ajustes necesarios para cumplir con las especificaciones del proyecto.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de las normativas de salud, seguridad y medio ambiente (HSE).
Mantener registros precisos y detallados de las operaciones.
Requisitos:
Secundario finalizado (excluyente), preferentemente en una escuela técnica.
Preferentemente 3 años de experiencia en la industria de hidrocarburos, en el área de fractura
Licencia de Manejo De Vehículo Pesado E1, Cargas Generales y Peligrosas Vigentes
Residencia en Neuquen, Añelo o zonas aledañas
Ingles básico o intermedio no excluyente

title: Operations Internship
description:
An internship is your opportunity to understand how we work and whether our culture is right for you. It’s also your chance to show us that you have the right skills and attitude to succeed here. Our internships are paid positions, and last between a few months to a whole year—offering opportunities to use what you’ve learned at university on real projects.
Our Operations internships are the best way to understand whether life in the field is for you. We often work in challenging locations where extreme weather and intense pressure are common. It’s demanding, but if you have a sense of adventure and are willing to work hard while getting your hands dirty, it’s a unique and fulfilling opportunity. You’ll work on live projects on active sites and be exposed to the challenges we face every day.
We offer two different internships in Operations. If you’re applying for a Field Engineer internship, you must have completed your second year of an undergraduate degree in engineering or a relevant science. If you’re applying for a Field Specialist internship, you must be working towards a two-year technical diploma or associate degree.
